list.productDescriptionEn:
Guided by intelligent quality upgrading, Yili has consistently leveraged digital intelligence to optimize its products and services, striving to deliver premium "AI-infused genuine milk" to consumers.

Keeping abreast of the wave of the "Artificial Intelligence Plus" era, Yili puts consumers at the core of its development. It integrates digital and smart technologies across the entire industrial chain, consolidates confidence in domestic dairy products, and builds emotional bonds that deliver tangible product quality and thoughtful services.

list.productDescriptionCn: ATOM 口袋 AI 私教机是一款面向个人运动训练场景的智能硬件产品。它拥有小巧便携的机身，内置 1.43 英寸 AMOLED 屏幕、160° 广角摄像头与 AI 动作识别能力，可识别人体关键点与训练动作，在训练中提供自动计数、实时语音提醒、动作反馈与训练复盘。相比传统运动记录设备，ATOM 不只记录“练了什么”，更关注“练得是否标准、是否有效、还能如何提升”。用户可通过 ATOM 生成个性化训练计划，并在训练后查看训练数据、动作完成情况和改进建议。无论在家、健身房还是差旅场景，ATOM 都能帮助用户更高效、更安全地完成自主训练。
list.productDescriptionEn: BodyPark ATOM is a pocket-sized AI Fitness Companion designed for independent training. With a compact body, a 1.43-inch AMOLED display, a 160° wide-angle camera, and AI-powered motion recognition, ATOM helps users track reps, receive real-time voice feedback, review workout performance, and generate personalized training plans. Unlike traditional fitness trackers that mainly record workout data, ATOM focuses on training quality—helping users understand whether their movements are accurate, how well each set is completed, and where they can improve.

Through its own brand, Nuromova, the company uses wearable brain-computer interface smart devices as an entry point to provide athletes, coaches, and organizations with reference, understanding, and feedback on human performance states.

list.enterpriseName: 京东集团
list.productDescriptionCn:
NUNA AI智能吊坠是一款专注于生活记录与自我觉察的AI智能穿戴设备，希望帮助人们在快节奏的生活中重新关注自己的状态与节律。
NUNA搭载多模态AI感知技术，结合人体生理信号与环境声音特征，在无需主动记录的情况下，持续感知用户状态，并通过App将情绪变化、生活片段与时间轨迹转化为可回顾、可理解的记录。它既是一份关于生活的数字记忆，也是一种帮助用户建立自我觉察的温和陪伴。NUNA延续极简设计语言，整机仅重17g，兼具智能科技与日常饰品属性，曾荣获德国iF设计奖等国际设计奖项。
list.productDescriptionEn:
"NUNA AI Pendant is an AI-powered wearable that helps you better understand yourself through continuous, effortless self-awareness. Using multimodal AI sensing, it quietly captures physiological signals and environmental context to transform emotions, daily moments, and personal patterns into meaningful insights over time.

Designed to be worn every day, NUNA weighs just 17 grams and combines minimalist design with privacy-first, on-device AI. We believe technology should do more than collect data. It should help people better understand themselves, one moment at a time.

list.productDescriptionCn: 农业采摘机器人H1识别准确率超过99%，抓取成功率超过95%，作物破损率低于5%，采摘峰值速度接近2倍人效，可完成双孢菇采摘、切根、分类全流程作业。适配通用场景，可高效采摘蘑菇、蓝莓、草莓等多种高经济价值作物，有效解决农业劳动力短缺问题。机器人回本周期短，目前已得到多家上市公司数千万订单。
list.productDescriptionEn:
The H1 robot achieves >99% recognition accuracy, >95% grasp success, and <5% crop damage. It harvests at nearly twice the speed of humans.
It fully handles button mushroom picking, trimming, and sorting, and works efficiently on blueberries and strawberries.Designed to solve agricultural labor shortages, it offers a short ROI and has secured tens of millions in orders from listed companies.

list.productDescriptionEn: This dual robotic arm model features a 7-degree-of-freedom design, supporting a wide range of postures and smooth, fluid movements; it integrates real-time collision detection and a flexible motion control system, enabling safe operation in complex environments; equipped with intelligent voice interaction and head pedestrian tracking functions, it provides a natural and efficient human-machine collaboration experience.

list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: “驭理”是由南方电网自主研发的电力行业首个科学智能体系，实现AI从“聊天工具”到“科研主力”的跨越。它整合大规模算力、亿级知识库和超千个专业工具，构建业界首个AI-Ready电力科研资源底座，打破知识库、数据集、工具、设备与算力的壁垒，形成弹性扩展的科研资源池，实现资源统一汇聚、高效调度与跨团队复用。其核心模块“AI研究员”可自主理解问题、规划路径、调用工具并总结反思，实测能力远超通用大模型。目前，“驭理”已在新型电力系统运行机理、新能源控制保护、新型电工材料研发等场景落地，为新型电力系统安全运行提供硬核支撑，在全球能源复杂系统智能科研中树立了中国标杆。
list.productDescriptionEn: AxiMaster, developed by China Southern Power Grid, is the power industry's first AI-for-Science system, elevating AI from chat tools to research mainstay. Integrating massive computing, a billion-scale knowledge base, and 1,000+ specialized tools, it builds the first AI-Ready research infrastructure. Its "AI Researcher" agent autonomously plans and executes, outperforming general-purpose LLMs. Deployed in power system analysis, renewable control, and material R&D, it won the Global MIKE Award and Digital China First Prize, setting a global benchmark.

list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn:
AI互联时代，南网推出自主可控的“大瓦特”系列产品，含手机端与电脑端，基于电力行业首个自研大模型打造，服务30万南网员工。
产品汇聚多源数据，搭载九大核心功能，兼具专业与安全双重优势。内置万余个专业智能体，精准解答各领域专业问题；支持个人知识库上传，自动完成文档处理；AI写作可联动多数据源，实现专业创作与内容溯源；智听功能跨端同步，一键生成会议纪要；Ebot基于自主可控Harness架构，深度融入专业领域日常工作。
数据、算力全部署于南网云，数据不出网、安全可控。打通公共、内网、个人三大知识域，构建专属知识流，真正实现千人千面，让AI高效服务每一位南网员工。
list.productDescriptionEn: In the era of AI connectivity, China Southern Power Grid has launched its independently developed and controllable “MegaWatt” product series, available on both mobile and desktop client. Built on the power industry’s first self-developed large language model, MegaWatt serves 300,000 employees across China Southern Power Grid.

list.productDescriptionCn:
立足电力行业数智化转型需求，自主研发“大瓦特·知音”电力客服大模型，构建“对外服务、对内赋能”的人工智能融合应用核心体系，推动AI技术深度融入用户服务、一线作业、运营管理全领域，实现客户服务全渠道覆盖、业务办理全环节贯通，持续提升用户体验、提高一线作业效率、支撑管理科学决策。
依托“大瓦特·知音”大模型，在6月17日正式上线行业首个用户服务智能体南网在线“小赫兹”智能体。作为全新超级服务入口，它打破传统菜单式交互，以自然语言为核心，打造“综合用能管家”，提供电费查缴、停电报障、业扩报装等一站式服务，全面开启用电“张口即办”新时代。
list.productDescriptionEn: Based on the digital and intelligent transformation needs of the power industry, we independently developed the "Mega Watt·Bosom friend" , promoting the in-depth integration of AI technology into user services, front-line operations, and operation management. Relying on the "Mega Watt·Bosom friend" ，the "Hertz"Intelligent Assistant has been created. It breaks the traditional standardized processing mode of click-based and menu-based apps and can provide residents with services such as inquiry, consultation, and handling.

list.productName: 大瓦特·闪电侠具身智能机器人
list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: “大瓦特·闪电侠”是南方电网自研的人形通用智能体，采用“自研大脑+定制具身”路线。其具身大模型采用双层架构：上层VLM理解场景规划，下层VLA精准执行，实现任务拆解、环境感知、语音交互、自主导航与任务编排，已用于展厅讲解。团队自建数据-仿真-模型全工具链及管控平台，用海量自采数据训练VLA，远程下发指令完成开门、验电、巡检等标准化作业。后续将拓展至变配电巡检、倒闸操作，替代高危重复人工操作，赋能电力智能化升级。
list.productDescriptionEn: "Davatt" power embodied intelligent robot, a humanoid general-purpose agent developed by CSG, leverages large models for environment perception, voice interaction, autonomous navigation, and intelligent task orchestration. It has been deployed in exhibition halls and business presentation. The team has built a full-chain data-simulation-model management platform, integrating proprietary power data with the VLA model to enable the robot to autonomously perform door opening, and equipment inspection.

list.productNameEn: DaWatt · Fixwin AI Operations and Maintenance Pioneer
list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.

industries.industryPrimaryName: 电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业
industries.industryPrimaryNameEn: Electricity, Heat, Gas and Water Production and Supply Industry

list.productDescriptionCn: 南方电网面向电力运维打造的具身智能机器狗成果，以“多构型产品矩阵+电力智能”为核心，形成从智能巡检到自主操作、现场处置的产品体系。自2022年应用以来，已规模化部署40台、稳定运行3-4年，是国内电力机器狗应用数量最多、覆盖最广、落地最久的智能巡检装备；已出口澳门2套，并推进智利等海外合作。首创电力重载机器狗“吠云·泰坦”，载重200kg、可牵引2.55吨汽车。依托规模应用推动技术迭代，同时也反哺了头部具身智能企业，形成“应用牵引技术、技术反哺应用”的双向促进格局，构建场景、技术、资本聚合的共生创新生态。南网场景已成为技术验证与商业展示标杆，获主流媒体报道20余次，接待国内外企业考察超60批次
list.productDescriptionEn: Developed by CSG,Fixwin is an embodied-AI robotic dog solution for power O&M.Built on“multi-form portfolio+power-domain intelligence”,it covers inspection,operation and on-site handling.Since 2022,40 units have operated stably for 3-4 years,making it China’s most mature power robotic dog application.Fixwin Titan,its heavy-duty model,can carry 200kg and tow a 2.55-ton vehicle.Large-scale grid use creates a loop where applications drive technology and technology feeds applications,making CSG scenarios a benchmark for technical validation and commercial demonstration.

list.productName: “大瓦特·天璇”电网断面控制智能体
list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.

industries.industryPrimaryName: 电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业
industries.industryPrimaryNameEn: Electricity, Heat, Gas and Water Production and Supply Industry

list.productDescriptionCn:
背景与痛点：针对断面越限后人工决策耗时长、压力大且难兼顾多因素效益的难题，自研AI调控模型。
亮点与成效：
1. 技术领先：采用强化学习，5秒内生成策略（较人工提速36倍），有效性超90%，实现网省两级“AI+人工”双轨运行。
2. 综合效益显著：优先保障新能源消纳助力低碳转型；大幅降低调度成本与误判风险；缩短处置时间，有效减少停电风险，保障民生用电安全。
list.productDescriptionEn: The organisation has built an advisory artificial intelligence system for proactive grid regulation. LLM+Safe RL Agent to perception, prediction, decision-making。5-minute rolling analysis with average strategy generation in 5 seconds；Severe overloads reduced by ~90% vs. manual dispatch。Establishes a new paradigm of flowgate regulation combining AI, physics, and human-in-the-loop governance, providing a deployable, scalable, and continuously evolving intelligent path for secure and efficient operation of new-type power systems.

list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.

industries.industryPrimaryName: 电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业
industries.industryPrimaryNameEn: Electricity, Heat, Gas and Water Production and Supply Industry

list.productDescriptionCn: 面向电力复杂建模、海量数据治理和高精度预测等深水区难题，打造电网调度AI负荷预测平台，夯实上层智能应用的数据与算法根基。平台具备三大核心特性：一是高质量数据驱动，建成负荷预测高质量数据集，入选国务院国资委首批央企高质量数据集建设成果；二是大小模型协同、多算法融合，集成数十种AI算法并突破预测偏差归因分析等可解释技术，融合“大瓦特·天象”气象能力后，预测准确率提升至98.78%；三是开放竞优、全自动运行，首创AI预测赛马机制，实现未来14天自动预测。成果已在南方五省区及六十余个地市规模化单轨应用，预测结果直达现货出清系统，有力支撑新能源消纳、电网安全运行和重大保电。
list.productDescriptionEn: Addressing complex power-system modeling, data governance, and high-precision forecasting, Watt·Tianyan (AI Load Forecast) provides a robust data and algorithm foundation. It integrates high-quality datasets, large-small model collaboration, AI algorithms, and interpretable deviation attribution.Its benchmarking mechanism enables automated 14-day forecasting. Deployed across five southern provinces and over 60 cities, it supports spot-market clearing, renewable energy integration, secure grid operation, and power-supply assurance.

list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.

industries.industryPrimaryName: 电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业
industries.industryPrimaryNameEn: Electricity, Heat, Gas and Water Production and Supply Industry

list.productDescriptionCn: 南方电网基于盘古全球气象大模型，融合本地多源高分辨率数据，自主研发区域高精度气象预测AI模型“大瓦特-天象”，实现关键技术跃升：逐小时更新（传统方法为3–12小时）预报，空间分辨率精细至1公里（传统方法3–9公里），预报准确率较传统方法提升10%–30%，预见期从7天延长至15天。面对6月雨热交替、天气转折急的复杂考验，“大瓦特-天象”为电网负荷、新能源功率及来水预测提供高可信数据支撑，使负荷预测准确率提升1.2%，达98%。这一跨越式突破，将气象预测与电网运行深度融合，显著增强调度安全裕度，成为新型电力系统韧性升级的智慧引擎，为能源保供与绿色低碳转型筑起数智化坚强防线。
list.productDescriptionEn: Based on the Pangu global meteorological foundation model, China Southern Power Grid independently built Watt-Tianxiang, a regional high-precision AI forecasting model integrated with local multi-source high-resolution data. It updates hourly at 1km resolution, lifting accuracy by 10–30 percentage points and extending lead time to 15 days. In June’s alternating rain-heat weather, it raised load forecast accuracy to 98%, deeply fusing meteorological sensing and grid operation to bolster new power system resilience and secure low-carbon energy supply.

list.productName: “大瓦特·云睿”配电网规划智能体
list.enterpriseName: 中国南方电网有限责任公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: China Southern Power Grid Co., Ltd.

industries.industryPrimaryName: 电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业

list.productDescriptionCn: 本项目面向新型配电网运行与规划协同决策场景，针对云南配电网分布式能源、充电桩、储能等新型源荷快速接入带来的运行特性多变、随机波动增强、潜在问题累积等挑战，破解传统“运行发现问题、规划事后解决”模式响应滞后，以及规划依赖人工调用多工具、流程割裂、效率偏低等问题。成果以规划全流程为主线，围绕数据治理、源荷预测、运行推演、问题诊断、智能规划和报告编制等环节，研发一体化智能功能模块，构建运行规划深度协同、持续闭环迭代的决策智能体体系，推动规划由人工主导向AI驱动转变，实现“智能驱动、即问即得、动态优化”，提升云南配电网规划决策的科学性、规范性和实施效率。
list.productDescriptionEn: This project supports collaborative operation and planning decision-making for Yunnan’s new distribution network. Addressing challenges from the rapid integration of distributed energy, EV charging and energy storage, it develops integrated AI modules for data governance, source-load forecasting, operation simulation, problem diagnosis, intelligent planning and report generation. The project enables closed-loop coordination between operation and planning, shifting planning from manual workflows to AI-driven, dynamic and efficient decision-making.

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn: 本專案由香港生產力促進局（HKPC）開發的 AI 賦能製造智能平台，透過大語言模型（LLM）及工業化適應性調節，結合代理式 AI 與檢索增強生成（RAG）技術，打造專業工業應用平臺。平台能根據客戶需求整合 APS、MES、WMS、ERP 等業務系統及企業知識庫，透過自然語言交互實現 Cpk、OEE、品質成本（CoQ）等核心指標的多源關聯分析與根因診斷，並支持預測性維護、品質預警與過程優化。平台將 SOP、標準及經驗知識結構化沉澱，降低對個人經驗的依賴，有效提升製造企業的品質水準、運營效率和 AI 規模化落地能力。
list.productDescriptionEn: The AI-Powered Manufacturing Intelligence Platform, developed by the Hong Kong Productivity Council (HKPC), leverages large language models (LLMs) with industrial adaptability tuning, integrated with agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technologies, to deliver a professional industrial application platform. Tailored to customer requirements, the platform integrates business systems such as APS, MES, WMS, and ERP, along with enterprise knowledge bases.

list.productNameEn: AI-Defined Humanoid Robot: Bringing Generalisation to Automation
list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn: 香港生產力促進局透過與頂尖院校及科創企業的合作研發，成功開發了多項核心技術，包括融合觸覺反饋的多模態VTLA模型、基於強化學習的全身協調控制以及低成本的Sim2Real仿真遷移等具身智能相關核心技術。這些技術已在工廠入庫拆箱和倉儲分揀等特定工業應用場景中得到初步驗證，為具身智能在複雜環境中的高效部署與規模化複製提供了可靠的解決方案。
list.productDescriptionEn: Through collaborative R&D with top-tier academic institutions and innovative technology enterprises, HKPC has developed core technologies—including a multimodal VTLA model integrated with tactile feedback, reinforcement learning-based whole-body coordinated control, and cost-effective Sim2Real simulation transfer. Validated in specific industrial scenarios such as factory inbound unpacking and warehouse sorting, these innovations provide robust solutions for the efficient deployment and scalable replication of embodied AI in complex environments.

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn:
隨着數碼轉型加速，製造企業逐步引入感測器、機械臂、PLC、SCADA、HMI、MES及數據分析等智能製造技術，以提升生產效率、產品品質及決策能力，並實現即時監控產線。
然而，當設備、辦公網絡及雲端平台日益互聯，網絡安全風險同步增加。營運技術（OT）涵蓋工業控制及監控系統，一旦受攻擊，可能影響生產運作、產品品質及業務持續性。
因此，企業不僅要保護傳統IT系統，亦需針對OT環境特性制定專門保安措施，全面提升整體防護能力。如欲快速掌握重點，可參閱相關短片了解主要風險與建議。
list.productDescriptionEn: With the acceleration of digital transformation, manufacturing enterprises are increasingly adopting smart manufacturing technologies, including sensors, robotic arms, PLC, SCADA, HMI, MES, and data analytics systems. These technologies help improve production efficiency, product quality, and decision-making through real-time monitoring of production lines. However, as production equipment, office networks, and cloud platforms become more interconnected, cybersecurity risks also increase. list.productDescriptionCn:
展示在量子計算領域的創新研究與應用探索

1. 量子經典混合計算框架可解決極其復雜的、傳統AI算法無法求解的組合優化問題

To demonstrate novel researches in Quantum Computing and its industrial applications

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn: Facility Inspector - 由香港生產力促進局（HKPC）與港鐵公司（MTR Corporation）聯合開發的全自主式設施巡檢與偵測解決方案，配備人工智能強化三維視覺掃描技術及先進感測器，可實現全自動、無損且穩健的檢測作業。透過深度學習技術，能精準辨識車站設施與建築結構的異常狀況，並高效提供預測性維護建議。
list.productDescriptionEn: Facility Inspector – Fully Autonomous Robotic Solution for Facility Inspection: Co-developed by HKPC and MTR Corporation, the solution features AI-enhanced 3D visual scanning, advanced sensors for a fully autonomous, non-destructive, and robust inspections. Leveraging deep learning, it can accurately identify defects and anomalies of station facilities and building structure while efficiently providing predictive maintenance recommendations.

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局

industries.industryPrimaryName: 交通运输、仓储和邮政业

list.productDescriptionCn:
WareMind是一種新型倉庫智能軟體，有助於簡化倉庫營運和倉庫規劃流程。
在倉庫營運階段，WareMind啟用VR監控以提高透明度，並利用AI監測、預測和分析物料搬運瓶頸的根本原因，以提供即時決策支援並減少物流延誤。
在倉庫規劃階段，WareMind提供無縫整合的虛擬模擬環境。這讓倉庫管理員能夠透過虛擬環境測試設備、佈局、邏輯上的改動，從而確保倉庫設計能夠針對快捷物流進行優化。
list.productDescriptionEn: WareMind is a novel warehouse intelligence tool which helps to streamline warehouse operation and warehouse planning processes. During the warehouse operation stage, WareMind enables VR monitoring for increased transparency, and utilises AI to detect, predict, and analyse the root causes of material handling bottlenecks to provide real-time decision support and reduce logistic delays. During the warehouse planning stage, WareMind provides a seamlessly integrated simulation environment. This allows warehouse managers to test equipment, layout, and logic changes digitally before implementing.

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn: AI 制造平台旨在展示如何利用边缘 AI 统一碎片化的制造数据，无缝衔接 ERP/PLM/MES 等多维系统，构建端到端的工业数据闭环。其目标是实现在制造现场实时的自动化预测与智能决策，降低延迟、提升数据质量，并实现自适应生产控制。
list.productDescriptionEn: The AI Manufacturing Platform demonstrates how edge AI unifies fragmented manufacturing data, seamlessly bridges ERP/PLM/MES systems, and establishes an end-to-end industrial data closed loop. The objective is to showcase real‑time automation prediction and intelligent decision‑making on the shop floor, reducing latency, improving data quality, and enabling adaptive production control.

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn: 開放式AI平台「HKPC天工開物」由香港生產力促進局自主研發，結合實時視覺AI監控、RAG技術及物聯網設備，為企業提供智能決策、任務分派及流程優化等一站式解決方案，推動智能工廠升級提速，協助企業實現高效且符合國內外合規標準的智能化轉型，從而加速AI技術在各行各業的普及與落地應用。
list.productDescriptionEn: The “HKPC Picasso” multipurpose AI platform is developed by Hong Kong Productivity Council. It integrates real-time visual AI monitoring, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology, and Internet of Things (IoT) devices to provide enterprises with a one-stop solution for intelligent decision-making, task assignment, and process optimization. The platform accelerates smart factory upgrades, empowering enterprises to achieve efficient, standards-compliant intelligent transformation, thereby accelerating the adoption and implementation of AI technology across industries.

list.enterpriseName: 香港生產力促進局
list.productDescriptionCn: 香港生產力促進局自主研發的開放式AI平台「HKPC天工開物」，旨在回應大部分企業在AI轉型時普遍面臨的「整合困難」，以 「易用為本」 為核心理念，針對不同行業的共性需求，提供一套端到端、可執行的AI轉型支持體系。此處展示其中一個無代碼計算機視覺人工智能線上解決方案模组，提供多個行業專用模型的訓練、部署及實際應用的一站式人工智能視覺平台，涵蓋數據整合、自動標記、直觀的模型管理和即時的數據分析。完整平台總共提供6個大型語言模型（LLM）模組、超過30種常用功能模組，以及約40種應用程式，支援各類智能化方案的快速開發與部署，顯著降低開發成本與技術門檻，實現數週內完成企業專屬AI系統部署與上線。
list.productDescriptionEn: HKPC’s self-developed multipurpose AI platform “HKPC Picasso,” aims to respond to the “integration challenges” commonly faced by most enterprises in AI transformation, with "ease of use" as the core concept, providing an end-to-end and executable AI transformation support system for the common needs of different industries. Here shows one of the modules on the HKPC Picasso platform, the groundbreaking no-code online solution for training, serving, and deploying various industry focused AI vision models. Features include data integration, auto-labelling, intuitive model management, and real-tim

list.enterpriseName: 科大讯飞
list.productDescriptionCn: 讯飞AI眼镜是一款轻量化硬件设计、强大的翻译能力以及多模态AI技术深度融合的高端智能眼镜，集成多场景翻译能力，并首创唇动识别多模态降噪方案，可在复杂多人环境中精准锁定发言人并过滤环境噪音。讯飞AI眼镜不仅是随身同传翻译官，还能进行智能提词，更是随时在线、帮你高效办公的超级AI助理。从功能调用、生态服务调用，到多模态理解，再到GlassClaw，构建起一条完整的AI能力闭环。同时，它还是一副全天候舒适佩戴的好眼镜，重量仅40克，是目前全球最轻的双目单色显示多模态智能眼镜。
list.productDescriptionEn: The iFLYTEK AI Glasses combine a lightweight 40g design, powerful translation and multimodal AI in one device. Featuring the industry’s first lip-recognition noise reduction, they accurately identify speakers and suppress background noise for multi-person conversations. Beyond translation and teleprompting, they function as an always-on AI assistant with multimodal understanding, function invocation, ecosystem integration and GlassClaw technology. Among the world’s lightest binocular monochrome display smart glasses, they deliver all-day comfort and productivity.

list.enterpriseName: 科大讯飞
list.productDescriptionCn: GuideX是基于科大讯飞自研大模型的新一代企业级一体化交互 Agent 平台，区别于传统单一语音助手、独立数字人或大屏工具，产品构建 “眼耳 - 形象 - 大脑 - 手脚 - 记忆” 五维完整交互架构，是集多模态硬件、虚拟数字人、大模型交互智能体、RPA 流程自动化、企业知识库于一体的软硬兼备的标准化 SaaS / 私有化产品。
list.productDescriptionEn: GuideX is a next-generation all-in-one enterprise interactive Agent platform powered by iFLYTEK’s self-developed large language model. Unlike standalone voice assistants, digital human systems or large-screen tools, it features a five-dimensional architecture: Eyes & Ears, Avatar, Brain, Limbs and Memory. Available as a standardized hardware-software solution via SaaS or on-premises deployment, GuideX integrates multimodal hardware, digital humans, LLM-powered Agents, RPA automation and enterprise knowledge bases.

list.enterpriseName: 科大讯飞
list.productDescriptionCn: 讯飞蝉翼AINOTE 2，是以极简专注为核心的AI墨水屏平板，凭借4.2mm超薄机身斩获吉尼斯“全球最薄墨水屏平板”认证，整机仅295g，轻盈便携，便于随身携带记录与阅读。设备搭载10.65英寸柔性墨水屏，300PPI高清分辨率，拥有接近纸张的观感与书写触感，弱化屏幕视觉干扰，助力沉浸式专注。搭配Wacom定制电磁笔，书写低延迟、支持多种笔触，书写体验贴近真实纸张。内置强大AI能力，可实现录音转写、内容智能摘要、多语种同传翻译，适配会议洽谈、灵感速记、阅读批注、跨语言沟通等场景。NoteOS系统整合笔记功能，支持手写、语音、键盘多种输入方式，内容可多端同步管理。
list.productDescriptionEn: iFLYTEK AINOTE 2 is an AI-powered e-ink tablet designed for minimalist focus. At just 4.2 mm thick and 295 g, it holds the Guinness World Record as the world's thinnest e-ink tablet. Its 10.65-inch flexible 300 PPI e-ink display delivers a paper-like reading and writing experience with reduced visual distraction. Paired with a custom Wacom EMR stylus, it offers natural, low-latency handwriting. AI features include speech transcription, smart summaries, multilingual interpretation, and seamless note management across devices.

list.enterpriseName: 荣耀终端股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Robot Phone 作为全新品类终端，深度融合具身智能交互、多自由度运动执行与电影级专业影像系统。传统移动终端仅通过屏幕、语音实现单向信息反馈，而荣耀为新一代智能设备在算力 “大脑” 之外，搭建实体运动执行机构；依托机械传动与摄像模组协同联动，完成人工智能与实体化、高表现力物理交互的深度耦合。产品打破传统固定式智能手机形态桎梏，面向消费级终端实现拟人化情感交互体系，支持视角自主实时动态调节；依托全域多模态感知矩阵完成声源识别、目标轨迹追踪、持续视觉感知，构建高自然度、三维化、直觉式人机交互架构。
list.productDescriptionEn: Robot Phone is a new species of smartphone, combining embodied AI with robot-grade motion and cinematic imaging. Rather than reacting through screens and voice commands, HONOR is, figuratively, giving its next generation of devices not only a brain, but also hands and feet, enabling AI to interact through motion and camera movement. It goes beyond static smartphones, adjusting its perspective in real time. With multimodal perception, it identifies sounds, tracks motion, and maintains visual awareness, creating a more natural and intuitive interaction model.

list.enterpriseName: 人工智能之旅
list.productDescriptionCn:
GigaAgent是一款具备自主运行、自我迭代能力的智能体。它将在展台现场实时完成进化过程，所有到场参观者均可观看。
整个展台如同一个鲜活生命体：白天期间，GigaAgent 公开处理参观者提出的各项任务；到傍晚时分，它的智能水平相比上午会有明显提升。这种迭代变化会在屏幕上直观呈现，恰似生物不断成长。
每日闭展以及展会落幕之后，展台工作人员会开展成果复盘：对比上午 9 时和傍晚 6 时版本的智能体，展示它习得的全新运行模式，以及性能优化的具体方面。
本次现场演示印证核心理念：GigaAgent 是全球唯一能够在实际工作过程中发生实质性能力蜕变的智能体。
list.productDescriptionEn: GigaAgent is an autonomous, self-evolving agent that demonstrates its evolution live at the stand, visible to all. The stand functions as a living organism: throughout the day it solves visitors' tasks, and by evening it is noticeably smarter. The evolution is visible on screen, like a living creature's growth. At the end of each day and the conference, staff review how the agent at 9 AM differs from the agent at 6 PM—what new patterns emerge and what it does better. This live demonstration proves GigaAgent is the only agent in the world that actually becomes different as it works.

list.enterpriseName: 人工智能之旅
list.productDescriptionCn:
帮助城市预见风险、洞悉市民需求、守护安全并加快响应速度的技术。
在“安全智慧城市”方向上，语音技术中心整合了面向城市安全、可信身份识别及市民诉求智能处理的人工智能解决方案。视频分析、面部与声纹生物识别、语音分析以及基于AI的诉求处理等技术，可协助市政部门识别风险、更快速地响应事件、通过远程渠道安全地服务市民，并获取关于城市服务质量的客观分析数据。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Technologies that help the city see risks, understand people's needs, protect them, and act faster.
In the "Safe Smart City" direction, Speech Technology Centre unites AI solutions for urban security, trusted identification, and intelligent processing of citizen requests. Video analytics technologies, facial and voice biometrics, speech analytics, and AI-powered request processing help municipal services identify risks, respond to events more quickly, securely serve citizens through remote channels, and obtain objective analytics on the quality of urban services.

list.enterpriseName: 人工智能之旅
list.productDescriptionCn: GigaChat 是一款基于神经网络的通用多模态人工智能助手，兼顾个人与专业用途。您只需用自然语言提出需求，便可即时获得响应。尽享从提出请求到获取解决方案的端到端交互体验。
list.productDescriptionEn: GigaChat is a neural network and a universal multimodal AI-assistant for personal and professional purposes. Bring in your request in a natural language and get an immediate response. Experience the end-to-end interaction scenario: from request to solution.

list.enterpriseName: 人工智能之旅
list.productDescriptionCn: Devices是一家俄罗斯 IT 公司，拥有从研发到生产的完整产业链，核心业务涵盖家用 AI 设备和企业级计算硬件的自主开发与制造。公司在硬件设计、固件开发（含 BIOS 和 BMC）以及外壳工业设计方面均掌握自有技术，可全程把控生产质量。产品线包括面向消费者的多媒体设备、智能家居组件、服务器、笔记本电脑、一体机和迷你电脑，全部符合俄罗斯监管标准。
list.productDescriptionEn: This is a young, full-cycle Russian IT company. We independently develop and manufacture AI-powered devices for the home and computing hardware for corporate clients. We possess our own expertise in hardware design, firmware development (BIOS/BMC), and industrial design of enclosures, ensuring complete control over production. Our portfolio includes B2C multimedia devices, smart home components, servers, laptops, all-in-one PCs (monoblocks), and mini-PCs (nettops) created in compliance with the requirements of Russian regulators.

list.enterpriseName: 人工智能之旅
list.productDescriptionCn: Kandinsky 3D 是一款生成式神经网络模型，可根据文字描述或图片快速生成三维立体模型。用户只需用自然语言描述物体或上传一张图片，神经网络即可在 1 分钟内输出可直接使用的 3D 模型。该技术为俄罗斯自主研发，已成功将创意设计转化为可触摸的实体产品。
list.productDescriptionEn: Kandinsky 3D is a generative neural network developed that creates three-dimensional models from text descriptions or images. The user describes an object in natural language or uploads a picture, and the neural network builds a ready-to-use 3D model in less than a minute. This is a proprietary Russian technology brought to practical application: from idea to a physical object you can hold.

list.enterpriseName: 人工智能之旅
list.productDescriptionCn: Green 是一款人形机器人，专为执行现实世界中的各类体力任务而设计。它可自主完成空间导航、障碍规避，支持自然语言交互，能执行简单操作并具备运行中的纠错能力。该机器人广泛适用于零售、制造、实验室及酒店服务等场景，涵盖货物组装上架、配套包装、样品搬运及场地清洁等具体工作。
list.productDescriptionEn: Green is an anthropomorphic robot designed to perform real-world physical tasks. Green navigates in space, avoids obstacles, communicates in natural language, performs simple tasks, and can correct errors during operation. Potential application areas for the robot include retail, manufacturing, laboratories, and room service: from assembly and shelving of goods to kitting, packaging, handling samples, and servicing premises.

list.enterpriseName: 哔哩哔哩
list.productDescriptionCn: Toy 是B站推出的网页内容发布平台，也是B站内一种新的互动形式。UP主可以在这里发布人格测试、小游戏、互动故事、实用工具、AI 创意作品等轻量网页内容，在视频简介、评论区、动态、活动页等场景中分发，并承接浏览、评论、分享等互动行为。平台同时提供发布管理、数据统计和内容治理能力，让网页作品从一次性的外链，变成可以在 B站生态中传播、沉淀和持续运营的互动内容形态。
list.productDescriptionEn: bilibili Toy is a web-based content publishing platform.  Creators can publish lightweight web content such as personality tests, mini-games, interactive stories, utility tools, and AI-powered creative works,  and support user interactions including views, comments, and shares. The platform also provides publishing management, data analytics, and content governance capabilities, turning web-based works from one-off external links into interactive content that can be distributed, accumulated, and continuously operated within the Bilibili ecosystem.

list.productDescriptionEn:
Aligned with China's “AI + Energy” initiative, State Grid has upgraded the HyperBrain Rover 2.0 – Intelligent Boundless Operations Robot based on Version 1.0 to address key challenges in conventional inspection operations, including labor-intensive mission planning, limited performance in complex environments, and inefficient multi-equipment collaboration. The upgraded platform features five core “Boundless” capabilities.
Boundless Collaboration – It pioneers a Vehicle-Drone-Robot-Dog collaborative operation model, enabling flexible drone de

list.enterpriseName: 国家电网有限公司

industries.industryPrimaryNameEn: Electricity, Heat, Gas and Water Production and Supply Industry

list.productDescriptionCn: 聚焦全球能源转型和气候治理，针对能源、电力、碳排数据割裂等痛点，从全球、国家视野建立了可视化数字平台——“全球电碳一张图”。平台以三维地球为基础，汇聚21万条多维数据，动态呈现“能源-电力-碳排放”全景脉络。通过创新的分时因子模型，直观体现中国风光装机对降低全球电碳因子的减排贡献，为优化用电与促进新能源消纳提供精准信号，并为国际气候治理提供中国样本。
list.productDescriptionEn: Focusing on global energy transition and climate governance, and addressing the pain point of fragmented data across energy, electricity, and carbon emissions, we have established a visual digital platform—the “Global Electricity-Carbon Map”—from both global and national perspectives. Built on a 3D globe, the platform aggregates over 210,000 multi-dimensional data points to dynamically present a full panoramic view of the “energy–electricity–carbon emissions” nexus.

list.enterpriseName: 国家电网有限公司

industries.industryPrimaryName: 电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业
industries.industryPrimaryNameEn: Electricity, Heat, Gas and Water Production and Supply Industry

list.productDescriptionCn: 随着新型电力系统加快建设，新能源大规模并网、负荷波动增强、运行场景愈加复杂，电力行业对认知、计算、推演能力提出更高要求。光明电力大模型融合语义、多模态、视觉、气象、时序与分析计算能力，贯通感知、理解、预测、计算和决策环节，为规划、运行、运检与应急处置提供智能支撑，提升电网安全、经济、高效运行水平。
list.productDescriptionEn: As the development of new-type power systems accelerates, large-scale integration of renewable energy, increasing load volatility, and growing operational complexity are placing higher demands on the power industry’s capabilities in cognition, computation, and simulation. The Guangming Large Model integrates semantic, multimodal, visual, meteorological, time-series, and analytical computing capabilities, connecting the entire chain of perception, understanding, forecasting, computation, and decision-making.

list.enterpriseName: 国家电网有限公司

list.productDescriptionCn: 除冰机器人是国家电网落实能源安全战略、筑牢新型电力系统防灾韧性的核心智能装备，聚焦高寒山区输电线路覆冰灾害难题，突破绝缘行走、设备自适应、复合式机械除冰等关键技术。设备适配35kV至1000kV多电压等级架空地线，依托振动切削等多种除冰模式，可高效清除重度雨凇、雾凇覆冰，全程实现带电无人作业。该装备彻底替代传统高空登塔除冰高危作业模式，规避人员安全风险，大幅缩减传统直流融冰的停电时长。现已广泛应用于川西南高海拔覆冰重灾区多条超特高压关键输电通道，多次在覆冰应急处置中实战落地。
list.productDescriptionEn: The de‑icing robot serves as core intelligent equipment for the State Grid Corporation of China to implement the energy‑security strategy and bolster disaster‑resistance resilience of the new‑type power system. Targeting icing‑induced hazards plaguing transmission lines in frigid mountainous areas, it achieves breakthroughs in key technologies including insulated traveling, equipment self‑adaptation and composite‑type mechanical de‑icing.

list.productName: 具身智能-先进制造超级大脑
list.productNameEn: Embodied Intelligence - Advanced Manufacturing Super Brain
list.enterpriseName: 安徽神玑技术有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 具身智能域控制器， 搭载神玑NX9031U 5nm 车规智能计算芯片，可提供高达800TOPS 等效算力，接口丰富、风冷散热，是面向具身智能、智能计算, 先进制造的首选旗舰平台。 轻松部署具身主流VLM/VLA/WM，及Diffusion、Transformer、CNN 网络模型；最大支持16路相机接入，接口丰富，支持全量传感器数据闭环。
list.productDescriptionEn: The integrated intelligent domain controller, equipped with the Genitech NX9031U 5nm automotive-grade intelligent computing chip, can provide up to 800TOPS equivalent computing power. It features rich interfaces and air cooling, making it the preferred flagship platform for integrated intelligence, intelligent computing, and advanced manufacturing.Easily deploy mainstream VLM/VLA/WM, as well as Diffusion, Transformer, and CNN network models. It supports up to 16 camera channels for connection, with rich interfaces and full sensor data closed-loop support.

list.enterpriseName: 安徽神玑技术有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Agent BOX是搭载新一代Agent推理芯片的大算力AI终端，为边缘推理、生成式AI的本地化部署、大模型推理本地加速提供强劲紧凑的计算能力。搭载自研分布式推理引擎后可以实现多机互连，运行高至400B的大模型（DeepseekV4 284/Qwen3.5-397B），可应用于大模型推理、Agent 智能体、生成式 AI、视频生成。高效支持agent框架（Harness，Hermes，Openclaw）
list.productDescriptionEn: Agent BOX is a high-computing AI terminal equipped with the new generation of Agent inference chips, providing strong and compact computing capabilities for edge inference, local deployment of generative AI, and local acceleration of large model inference. After being equipped with a self-developed distributed inference engine, it can achieve multi-machine interconnection and run large models up to 400B (DeepseekV4 284/Qwen3.5-397B), which can be applied to large model inference, Agent agents, generative AI, and video generation. Efficient support for agent framework，Harness, Hermes, Openclaw

list.productNameEn: Intelligent driving controller for unmanned vehicles
list.enterpriseName: 安徽神玑技术有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 搭载NX9031C 5nm车规智能大算力芯片，综合性能超越行业旗舰方案，提供400K DMIPS CPU算力和500TOPS AI算力和546GB/s 超高带宽，可支持VLA/LLM等大模型的部署，是一款面向物流车的高性价比域控平台；全自研ISP图像处理器，16路RAW相机和3D相机接入；兼容各主流系统框架
list.productDescriptionEn: Equipped with the NX9031C 5nm automotive-grade intelligent high-computing power chip, its comprehensive performance surrenders that of industry flagship solutions. It offers 400K DMIPS CPU computing power, 500TOPS AI computing power, and an ultra-high bandwidth of 546GB/s. It can support the deployment of large models such as VLA and LLM, and is a cost-effective domain control platform for logistics vehicles. Fully self-developed ISP image processor, 16-channel RAW camera and 3D camera connection; Compatible with all mainstream system frameworks

全球首颗5nm 世界模型原生设计的旗舰级智驾和旗舰具身智能芯片，量产发货超30万颗 
超高算力：行业最高端侧推理算力，全自研GPGPU 高效计算系统，强大Transformer引擎，高效运行LLM语言模型 和 WM世界模型算法

list.productDescriptionEn: The world's first flagship intelligent driving and flagship body-mounted smart chip with a native 5nm world model design has been mass-produced and delivered with over 300,000 units;The industry's most advanced side inference computing power, fully self-developed GPGPU efficient computing system, powerful Transformer engine, and efficient operation of LLM language models and WM world model algorithms;Abundant computing resources, 32-core CPU, the highest performance in the industry, 615K DMIPS; 546GB/s Ultra-high bandwidth, 2 to 4 times higher than that of industry competitors

list.productName: Proton L6：泛函数技术流片产品
list.enterpriseName: 上海泛函数智能科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 核芯互联Proton L6 精密模拟微控制器是泛函数实现技术商业落地、成功完成流片量产的标志性芯片产品。Proton L6 的成功量产落地，证明 AI 驱动芯片设计模式可稳定支撑实体芯片量产交付，为集成电路行业开辟全新研发范式，加速国产高端芯片智能化自主研发进程。
list.productDescriptionEn:
The Proton L6 precision analog microcontroller developed by CORELINK is a landmark taped-out and mass-produced silicon product that marks the commercial implementation of Functech’s technologies.
The successful volume production of Proton L6 verifies that the AI-driven chip design methodology can reliably support physical chip delivery. It pioneers a brand-new R&D paradigm for the integrated circuit industry and accelerates the intelligent independent research and development of domestic high-end chips.

list.productName: AI 赋能全流程全自动芯片设计技术平台
list.enterpriseName: 上海泛函数智能科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 本次展出核心展品为 AI 赋能全流程全自动芯片设计技术平台。平台依托自研大模型与多智能体协同架构，深度释放 AI 核心能力，贯穿芯片设计全部环节。依托人工智能优化设计方案，有效提升芯片设计质量、大幅缩短研发周期、降低技术准入门槛、开拓集成电路产业全新发展空间。该平台兼容上海国产算力硬件，可本地化部署国产大模型。展品采用一体机或云平台交互形态，现场参观者能够通过屏幕直观见证 AI 自主完成下一代芯片设计全过程，充分展现 AI 技术与软硬件深度融合优势，以 AI 赋能芯片自主研发，补全高端芯片设计生态链重要一环，为芯片创新注入智能化动力。
list.productDescriptionEn:
The core exhibit showcased this time is an AI-powered full-flow fully automatic chip design technology platform. Built upon self-developed large models and a multi-agent collaborative architecture, the platform unlocks core AI capabilities across all phases of chip design.
Leveraging artificial intelligence to optimize design solutions, it effectively improves chip design quality, drastically shortens R&D cycles, lowers technical entry barriers, and opens up brand-new development prospects for the integrated circuit industry.

list.productDescriptionCn:
昆仑芯超节点以超高计算密度为核心优势，单机柜可实现32卡及64卡的全互联部署。相较于传统8卡或16卡服务器，其单机柜XPU Link互联带宽最高可提升8倍，为大模型训练与推理提供强劲的通信支撑。该产品支持基于IB/RoCE的网络架构，可快速构建万卡级超大规模集群，并适配大规模专家并行（EP32/64）策略，在MoE模型训练场景下性能最高可提升10倍，单卡推理效率最高提升可达13倍，显著加速AI工作负载。
能耗方面，该产品采用冷板式液冷技术，整柜功耗控制在120kW以内，配合智能漏液监测系统，在确保散热效能的同时显著降低PUE指标。为满足智算集群建设需求，机柜间支持IB/RoCE跨柜通信。
list.productDescriptionEn:
The Kunlunxin Supernode delivers ultra-high computing density with fully interconnected 32- or 64-accelerator deployments, providing up to 8× higher XPU Link bandwidth than conventional servers.
Supporting InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, it scales to ultra-large clusters and is optimized for EP32/64 workloads, achieving up to 10× higher MoE training performance and 13× greater inference efficiency.
Cold-plate liquid cooling keeps rack power consumption below 120 kW, while future 256- and 512-accelerator configurations will enable clusters of up to 4,000 accelerators.

list.productDescriptionCn:
算家云是贵州算家计算服务有限公司自研、依托“东数西算”贵安枢纽打造的算力租赁平台。平台打通全国 11 大算力中心，汇聚万张异构 GPU 算力卡，支持 AI 训练、模型微调、内容创作、科学计算等场景。
依托自研智能调度与容器隔离技术，实现即开即用、按秒计费，算力价格低至市场均价五成，有效解决科研团队、中小企业算力成本高、短期租用难的痛点。配套自研算桥 API 打通算力上层应用链路，直接复用算家云全域算力集群，统一封装各类主流大模型 调用接口。
平台已服务近 6 万名用户，交付 4000 万 + 卡时算力，覆盖高校、政企、AI 开发者群体，以低成本、易上手的全栈算力服务践行算力普惠。
list.productDescriptionEn: Suanjiayun, a self-developed rental platform of Guizhou Suanjia Computing Service Co., Ltd., runs on Gui’an’s East Data West Computing hub, connecting 11 national computing centers with massive heterogeneous GPUs for AI training, model tuning and scientific computing. Its proprietary tech offers cheap second-billed computing to solve expensive rigid rentals for researchers and SMEs. The Suanqiao API unifies mainstream large model access. It serves 60,000 users with 40 million GPU hours of affordable full-stack computing for academia, governments and AI developers.

list.productNameEn: Super Intelligent Agent for Cranial CT
list.enterpriseName: 上海影禾医脉智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Medical Image Insights Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 依托专业医学影像基座大模型，颅脑CT智能体报告自动生成系统可广泛应用于就医影像辅助诊断、疾病早筛及体检健康等场景。该系统覆盖95%以上头颅常规检查病种，能精准识别脑出血、脑梗死等94种颅脑病变。检查完成后，系统可自动完成病灶识别与影像信息梳理，快速生成标准化、清晰规范的影像辅助报告，为用户提供高效、精准、安全的智能筛查与辅助诊断服务，让头颅影像检查更加高效、更令人安心。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Powered by our medical imaging foundation model, our Cranial CT AI auto-report system serves clinical diagnosis, early disease screening and physical exams. It detects 94 cranial lesions like cerebral hemorrhage and infarction, covering over 95% routine cranial conditions.
Post-scan, it auto-analyzes lesions and generates standardized imaging reports, delivering fast, accurate, secure AI-assisted diagnosis for safer, more efficient cranial scans.

list.productNameEn: A New Research Paradigm for Medical Imaging AI
list.enterpriseName: 上海影禾医脉智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Medical Image Insights Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 依托自研的“影禾觅芽”医学影像基座模型，我们构建了集“数据、科研、应用”三位一体的底层研发与成果孵化体系。通过打通数据治理、模型训练至AI应用落地的完整技术闭环，创新打造了“医生主导+标准数据+小样本模型训练”的生成式AI科研模式。该模式有效沉淀了专业医疗能力，推动医学影像AI服务持续迭代，精准契合医患需求。同时我们倾力打造“AI应用商店”，汇聚80余款医学影像AI应用，让前沿医疗技术真正落地于民、服务于民，为患者提供更专业、便捷、智能的常态化健康影像服务。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Built on our proprietary MIIA® medical imaging foundation model, we have an integrated R&D system for data, research and AI deployment. Our clinician-led generative AI solution uses standardized data and small-sample training to accumulate clinical expertise and continuously optimize imaging AI products.
Our AI Application Store offers over 80 medical imaging AI tools, delivering professional, convenient and intelligent routine imaging services to patients.

list.productDescriptionCn:
慧管理是面向AI研发时代打造的AI原生体系诊断、建设与运营一体化系统，聚焦管理体系智能化升级，融合多Agent协同、知识工程与体系管理方法论，帮助企业从“被动文件建设”走向“主动智能治理”。
系统纵向贯通战略、架构、流程、组织、IT，横向集成制度、质量、风险内控等合规要求，智能识别管理体系短板、断点与风险隐患，自动形成诊断结论与改进建议。
在此基础上，输出可落地、可追溯、可持续优化的体系建设方案，支撑流程架构设计、文件生成、职责协同与运行监控。
通过诊断、建设、运营全周期贯通，构建适配AI研发模式的现代化管理体系，持续提升运营效能与合规水平，为数字化转型和高质量发展提供智能化支撑。
list.productDescriptionEn: HuiManage is an AI-native platform for management system diagnosis, construction, and operations. Combining multi-Agent collaboration with knowledge engineering, it shifts enterprises from passive compliance to intelligent governance. It connects strategy, processes, organization, and IT vertically, integrating quality, risk, and compliance horizontally. It identifies gaps, generates diagnostics and traceable plans for process design, document generation, and closed-loop monitoring. Through full-lifecycle integration, HuiManage builds modern systems that boost efficiency and compliance.

list.productDescriptionCn: 形意mimosaAR99是全球首款采用体全息光波导技术的智能眼镜，通过独特的光栅设计与制造工艺，将正面漏光比例控制在1:140以下，并大幅弱化彩虹纹，实现了更清晰、更具隐私性的屏幕显示效果。以精研29克的超轻时尚框型，带给人们轻若无物，智慧敏捷的智能体验。搭载信息通知、提词显示、实时翻译、AI问答、AR导航等功能，打造未来潮流穿搭新范式。
list.productDescriptionEn: The Mimosa AR99 is the world’s first smart eyewear built with volumetric holographic waveguide technology. Its proprietary grating design and premium manufacturing cap front light leakage under 1:140 and greatly reduce rainbow fringing, delivering crisp, privacy-protected visuals.Boasting an exquisitely refined 29g ultra-light fashionable frame, it offers weightless comfort and snappy smart interactions. Packed with message alerts, teleprompter, real-time translation, AI Q&A and AR navigation, it creates a brand-new template for futuristic wearable style.

C100将增强现实与人工智能深度融合，以全能之姿应对工作与生活的多元场景——实时翻译、AR导航、演讲提词、AI问答，一应俱全。指尖轻触镜腿，智能世界即刻唤醒，科技如空气般融入日常。

list.productDescriptionEn: The C100 integrates AR and AI to cover real‑time translation, AR navigation, teleprompting, and AI Q&A. A tap on the temple activates the smart system, embedding technology into everyday life. The binocular display projects information into your natural view, enabling navigation without looking down, teleprompting with eye contact, and translated text synchronized on‑screen—keeping focus and conversations uninterrupted. The design ensures lasting comfort for extended use. A built‑in HD camera captures first‑person perspectives—whiteboards, sketches, scenery—with a single press.

list.productDescriptionCn: Hyper3D是影眸科技推出的全球领先AI 3D生成平台，也是唯一支持用文字直接编辑3D模型的平台。用户可通过文字或图片快速生成模型，也能上传已有模型进行深度再创作。旗舰产品Rodin Gen-2.5作为全球首个千万面级3D生成模型，仅需4秒即可生成百万面级模型，并支持原生12K高清PBR贴图。其首创类LLM Thinking的可控生成机制，生成精度可在4至80秒间灵活调节。目前，Hyper3D已服务拓竹、网易、Unity等B端客户，覆盖游戏、影视、电商、3D打印、工业设计、XR及具身智能等多个领域。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hyper3D, by Deemos Technology, is a world-leading AI 3D generation platform—and the only one that edits 3D models directly via text. Generate models in seconds from text or images, or refine uploaded ones. Its flagship Rodin Gen-2.5 is the world's first ten-million-polygon-class model: million-polygon output in 4 seconds, with native 12K PBR textures. Its LLM-style "Thinking" mechanism makes generation controllable, with precision adjustable from 4 to 80 seconds.

list.productDescriptionCn: DataFlow AI 数据准备系统面向AI数据侧全流程，贯通数据采集解析、清洗治理、合成增强、模型训练、自动评估与反馈优化，支持最新 Skills 与 Agent 技术编排，覆盖大模型训练数据、智能体交互数据及世界模型多模态物理数据构建，帮助行业数据快速转化为可训练、可评测、可持续迭代的 AI-ready 数据。
list.productDescriptionEn: The DataFlow AI Data Preparation System is built for the full AI data lifecycle, spanning data acquisition and parsing, cleaning and governance, synthetic data generation and augmentation, model training, automated evaluation, and feedback-driven optimization. It supports orchestration with the latest Skills and Agent technologies, and covers the construction of training data for large language models, agent interaction data, and multimodal physical-world data for world models. It helps transform industry data into AI-ready data that is trainable, evaluable, and continuously iterable.

list.enterpriseName: 上海元枢智汇技术有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 基于 DataFlow 的 AI4S 数据研发平台以材料数据处理为核心，面向论文、专利、实验记录和测试报告等多源数据，自动完成文献解析、自定义指标抽取、质量校验和证据溯源。平台将材料组成、结构、制备工艺、测试条件、性能指标和应用场景统一建模，形成可检索、可分析、可训练的材料基因数据库。在此基础上，支持材料体系对比、性能规律挖掘和后续 AI 模型训练，为膜材料、电池材料、催化材料等研发方向提供高质量数据底座。
list.productDescriptionEn: Built on DataFlow, the AI4S Data R&D Platform focuses on materials data processing. It parses papers, patents, lab records, and test reports, extracts custom metrics, validates quality, and traces evidence. It models composition, structure, synthesis, test conditions, performance, and applications in a searchable, analyzable, trainable materials genome database. The platform supports material comparison, performance-pattern mining, and AI model training, providing a high-quality data foundation for membrane, battery, and catalytic materials R&D.

list.enterpriseName: 上海元枢智汇技术有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 大规模多模态融合的 AI 数据湖，具备 SQL 多模态融合数据库；多尺度向量索引算法，结合分层树+图数据结构，提供高性能、高准确性，和快速的索引构建时间；自适应标量过滤 & 稠密、稀疏向量、文本和结构化数据的混合检索；PB 级多模态数据的亚秒级检索等能力。面向企业多源、异构、分散的数据资产，提供统一管理、数据血缘追踪、版本管理和 Git-like 数据管理能力，支撑数据资产的可追溯、可复用与持续迭代。
list.productDescriptionEn: A large-scale multimodal AI data lake with SQL-based multimodal fusion and multi-scale vector indexing that combines hierarchical tree and graph structures for high performance, accuracy, and fast builds. It supports adaptive scalar filtering and hybrid retrieval across dense and sparse vectors, text, and structured data, enabling sub-second search over PB-scale multimodal assets. For diverse, heterogeneous, distributed enterprise data, it provides unified management, lineage tracking, versioning, and Git-like operations to make data traceable, reusable, and continuously iterative.

list.enterpriseName: 深圳市形意智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shenzhen Xingyi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: AR99 PRO延续了AR99时尚、轻量化的基因，核心围绕商务用户的痛点从纤薄、性能、功耗三大核心全面革新；更纤细的镜腿、更轻盈的重量、更新可拆卸电池及小巧精致充电盒拥有长时间续航、同时搭配专属智能戒指配件，还可以实时监测心率、血氧等健康数据，把交互与健康同时装进办公场景。六大实用功能串起完整商务办公动线，让AR眼镜不再只是单一的显示终端，而是延伸成了覆盖“办公辅助+健康监测”的个人随身入口。
list.productDescriptionEn: AR99 PRO builds on the stylish, lightweight AR99 with core upgrades in slimness, performance, and power efficiency. Thinner temples, lighter build, detachable battery, and a compact charging case ensure extended runtime. An exclusive smart ring tracks heart rate and blood oxygen, embedding health monitoring into office use. Six practical features streamline workflows, transforming the glasses from a mere display into a personal gateway for both productivity and wellness.

list.productName: Q-Gen 生成式空间叙事引擎
list.enterpriseName: 趣致集团
list.productDescriptionCn: 现场生成以你为主角的 AI 短剧！Q-Gen引擎基于与自身丰富的营销数据库，以多模态叙事大模型与多智能体协同架构，打通创意短剧制作、产品卖点植入、场景适配、终端投放全链路体系，引导用户深度参与品牌互动，同时为品牌提供可快速落地、高交互性的 AI 营销内容。依托软硬协同、数实融合能力，实现数字内容在物理场景实景演绎，打造 AI 赋能线下营销的全新交互范式，赋能品牌线下场景化传播升级。
list.productDescriptionEn:
On site, the Q Gen Generative Spatial Narrative Engine generates AI driven short dramas that feature you as the protagonist. Built upon its own extensive marketing database, the engine leverages a multimodal narrative large model alongside a multi agent collaborative architecture to seamlessly orchestrate the entire end to end pipeline—spanning creative short drama production, product selling point embedding, real time scenario adaptation, and terminal deployment. This integrated system not only guides users toward deeply engaged brand participation but also provides brands with AI marketing content that is both rapidly deployable and highly interactive.
By capitalizing on the synergy between software and hardware, as well as the convergence of digital and physical realms, the engine brings digital content to life through authentic performances in real world physical settings. This establishes an entirely new interactive paradigm for AI powered offline marketing, enabling brands to upgrade their scenario based communication strategies in brick and mortar environments. The multi agent framework ensures that each module—from narrative generation to environmental sensing and content delivery—works in concert, adapting in real time to user responses and contextual cues. As a result, consumers are immersed in personalized stories that seamlessly blend virtual effects with tangible sensations, while brands gain actionable insights and measurable lifts in engagement, dwell time, and conversion rates. Ultimately, the Q Gen engine empowers brands to transform every offline touchpoint into a dynamic, memorable brand encounter, driving both emotional resonance and business outcomes.

list.productName: Q-Agent 端侧全自主营销智能体
list.enterpriseName: 趣致集团
list.productDescriptionCn: 趣致率先将AIoT 集群式多智能体原生部署于智能终端，采用端云协同架构，以集团营销大数据为核心支撑。智能体可自主完成场景感知、商品推荐、设备运营、界面迭代等工作，落地千机千面、一场一策的柔性运营模式。有效提升终端运营效率，助力品牌开展精细化场景营销。作为数物融合的前沿应用，重新定义智能商业终端价值，推动实体商业智能化升级。
list.productDescriptionEn: Qunabox Group pioneered deployment of AIoT-based multi-agent systems on smart terminals with an device-cloud architecture, using its marketing big data as core backbone. The agents perform scene perception, product recommendation, device operation, interface iteration, enabling terminal-level personalization . This improves terminal efficiency and helps brands implement refined scene-based marketing. As a cutting-edge digital-physical integration, it redefines smart terminal value and drives intelligent upgrading of physical commerce.

list.productName: Q-Sense 全感多模态交互引擎
list.enterpriseName: 趣致集团
list.productDescriptionCn: 趣致集团推出 Q-Sense 全感多模态交互引擎，打破传统线下营销的体验边界。该引擎通过AI算法与多模态传感器融合，实时联动视觉、听觉、触觉、嗅觉、味觉，为消费者构建多维沉浸式品牌体验，让用户可以在互动中同步感受视觉画面、品牌香氛、触觉反馈及产品试用，有效提升用户停留时长、实现品牌转化率大幅提升。
list.productDescriptionEn: Qunabox Group's Q‑Sense Omni‑sensory Multi‑modal Interaction Engine breaks traditional offline marketing boundaries. By fusing AI algorithms with multi‑modal sensors, it synchronizes vision, hearing, touch, smell, and taste in real time, delivering multidimensional immersive brand experiences. Users simultaneously perceive visuals, fragrances, haptic feedback, and product trials, extending dwell time and significantly boosting conversion rates. Interaction data—gaze, gestures, dwell patterns—feeds back for continuous AI optimization. This paradigm shift transforms passive reception into active participation, turning every offline touchpoint into a memorable, high‑impact narrative that bridges digital precision and physical authenticity.

list.enterpriseName: 上海六联智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Sixunited Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 适用于办公、教育、工业控制、家庭自动化、物联网网关等多种场景。SixClaw 智能体支持本地化智能决策与任务执行，有效降低云端依赖和网络延迟问题，同时减少人工操作负担。小巧机身灵活部署，帮助各类设备和系统更高效地协同运行。
list.productDescriptionEn: It is applicable to a wide range of scenarios including office work, education, industrial control, home automation, IoT gateways and more. The SixClaw Agent enables local intelligent decision-making and task execution, effectively reducing reliance on the cloud and network latency, while lowering manual operation workload. Its compact chassis allows flexible deployment, facilitating more efficient collaboration between various devices and systems.

list.productName: 模力通办公写作智能体
list.enterpriseName: 蜜度科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
模力通办公写作智能体在高质量时政资料库的支持下，能写出100多种格式公文、3万字的深度研究报告、自带演讲备注的PPT、模拟任何文风的稿件，还可以实时转写会议纪要、内容格式双校对、翻译与知识问答。
1、6大专家组团，精修每一篇文章
2、自定义文风助手，精准复刻每一篇范文
3、一个指令，自动生成带备注的PPT
4、一句话，生成3万字深度研究报告
......
list.productDescriptionEn:
MLT Office Writing Agent
Backed by a high-quality political and policy database, it generates over 100 types of official documents, 30,000-word in-depth reports, PPTs with speaker notes, and manuscripts in any writing style. It supports real-time meeting transcription, dual proofreading of content and format, translation, and Q&A.
1.6 expert teams refine every document
2.Custom writing styles to accurately replicate samples
3.One-click PPT generation with speaker notes
4.30,000-word in-depth report from a single prompt
......

list.productName: 校对通编校审核智能体
list.enterpriseName: 蜜度科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 基于文修5.0能力，校对通编校审核智能体2.0正式上线。该智能体首次开放Chat模式：用户仅需自然语言对话，智能体即可自主完成需求理解、任务拆解、工具调用与结果交付，实现自动校对与核稿、审稿统计与分析、权威信息检索、审稿报告生成等围绕校对场景的复杂任务——一句话即可完成。它将重复、复杂的校对工作转变为对话式智能协同，显著提升内容安全与作业效率。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Based on the Wenxiu 5.0 large model, the JDT Editing & Reviewing Intelligent Agent 2.0 has been officially launched.
It introduces a conversational mode for the first time. Using natural language, it can understand requirements, execute tasks and deliver results. A single instruction completes the entire workflow, including automatic proofreading, review statistics, authoritative information retrieval and report generation.
It transforms complex proofreading work into conversational intelligent collaboration, significantly enhancing content security and editorial efficiency.

list.enterpriseName: 超聚变数字技术股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
超聚变智企 ERP 是面向中大型企业（千亿级）、新锐企业（百亿级以下）的云原生一体化管理平台，以 “通用性 + 行业适配” 为设计理念，构建适配企业复杂管理的数智化底座，利用AI提升企业经营效率和管理水平。
产品具备高性能、安全可信、原生AI演进、灵活扩展、全域DRP智能化升级、生态开放六大特性：依托云原生微服务架构，全面兼容国产软硬件，可支撑多产业、多组织、多业务场景协同，在千亿级营收规模下仍可高并发、高可用、低延迟稳定运行。
平台深度实现业财一体化、流程固化与智能决策，助力企业打通数据壁垒、规范管理、提升效率，满足国资监管、内控合规与数字化转型需求。
list.productDescriptionEn: xFusion SapientTM Enterprise ERP is a cloud-native integrated management platform for medium and large enterprises (with hundreds of billions of RMB in revenue) and emerging enterprises (with less than ten billion RMB in revenue). Adhering to the design concept of "Universality + Industry Adaptation", it builds a digital intelligent base suitable for complex enterprise management, and uses AI to improve enterprise operational efficiency and management level.

list.productNameEn: xFusion TokenBox™ Enterprise Token Generation Platform
list.enterpriseName: 超聚变数字技术股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
TokenBox™ 是全球首款 Token 原生企业级 AI 生产平台：
硬件突破：数据中心级液冷设计，主流负载低于 35dB， 达图书馆级静音；单机支持满血版 DeepSeek V4 1.6T；打造全新 PCIe Fabric Gen6 互联架构 TokenFabric™，支持多节点全互联扩展；Pack 模块化设计，资源按需弹性扩展。
软件融合：FusionOne AI 全栈软硬一体，超长上下文性能提升超 100%；ModelEver 模型永新，持续更新优化；内容防护与行为管控确保数据安全。
TokenBox™ 让企业拥有自己的 AI Factory，把顶级算力带到业务现场。
list.productDescriptionEn:
TokenBox™ is the world’s first token-native enterprise AI production platform.
It combines data-center-grade liquid cooling with sub-35 dB quiet operation, supports the full DeepSeek V4 1.6T model on a single system, and features TokenFabric™—a PCIe Fabric Gen6 architecture for full-mesh multi-node scaling. Its modular design enables flexible resource expansion on demand.
FusionOne AI delivers full-stack hardware-software integration, boosting ultra-long-context performance by over 100%. ModelEver keeps models continuously updated, while built-in safeguards ensure data security.

list.enterpriseName: 上海云脉芯联科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: YSA-100是云脉芯联首款全自研支持高性能网络的网络互联芯片，能够满足AI智算中心、高性能分布式存储、高性能云等各类应用场景的核心业务需求。
list.productDescriptionEn: YSA-100 is Yunsilicon’s first fully self-developed network interconnection chip that supports high-performance networking. It is designed to meet the core business demands of various application scenarios, including AI intelligent computing centers, high-performance distributed storage, and high-performance cloud computing.

list.enterpriseName: 华为技术有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 基于灵衢打造的Atlas 950 SuperPoD智算超节点，以单柜64卡为基本单元，最大可支持8192张NPU卡高速互联，为超大规模AI训练与海量推理并发场景提供最优选择。相比传统集群，大模型训练效率、可靠性与推理性能均大幅提升。Atlas 850E超节点服务器能够适配现有风冷机房，支持从8到1024卡的灵活扩展和快速部署，支撑运营商从小规模推理到集群推理的分阶段业务升级，实现应用快速上线。
list.productDescriptionEn: For AI computing, the Atlas 950 SuperPoD, powered by UnifiedBus, integrates 64 NPUs per cabinet and can scale up to 8,192 NPUs, delivering superior performance for large-scale AI training and high-concurrency inference. It significantly boosts model training efficiency, reliability, and inference performance compared to conventional clusters.

list.enterpriseName: 大连博涛文化科技集团股份有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Dalian Betop Culture and Technology Group Stock Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 博涛科技打造的国内顶尖全智能机器人乐队展品，聚焦 AI + 机器人技术与文旅文娱场景深度融合，破解行业高质量智能娱乐产品稀缺的痛点。展品核心技术实现多项行业突破：金属 3D 打印打造精密结构，创新融合齿轮传动与钢丝连杆结构，兼顾精度与紧凑性；搭载定制拟人化眼部系统，神态立体生动；改用微型 PWM 舵机搭配专属控制板，降本同时大幅提升场景适配性；创新六杠 PWM 推杆结构复刻人类颈部多自由度运动，动作自然流畅；配套 25kW 小型专用电源，保障多关节大扭矩电机全场景稳定运行。展品构建了完整科幻世界观与鲜活角色人设，适配展厅、文旅景区、商业综合体等全场景，可完成协同演奏与实时智能互动。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Botao Technology’s cutting-edge domestic intelligent robot band exhibit merges AI + robotics with cultural tourism & entertainment, solving the industry’s shortage of high-quality intelligent entertainment products.
Its industry-leading tech includes metal 3D printing, custom anthropomorphic eyes, micro PWM steering gear control, six-bar natural neck structure, 25kW power supply for stable multi-joint motor operation.
Adaptable to exhibition halls, tourism sites and commercial complexes, it supports ensemble shows and real-time intelligent interaction.

list.enterpriseName: 广州趣丸网络科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Guangzhou Quwan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn:
TemPolor 天谱乐AI吉他是全球首款生成式 AI 吉他，开创"生成式 AI 乐器"这一全新品类——首次将生成式 AI 音乐大模型嵌入乐器硬件本体，让创作与演奏在一把琴上同时发生。
今年更新的核心交互玩法-AI 即兴演奏，支持用户在吉他端直接生成专属音乐并即兴合奏，把作曲到演奏的过程，压缩成一次上手操作；配合 AI 转谱、哼唱成曲等AI音乐大模型能力，零基础用户也能即时弹奏与创作。
本届 WAIC，年度焕新款将迎来国内首次公开亮相。在交互硬件上进一步升级：彩虹琴弦灵敏度全面提升，同时升级自定义和弦，让用户的自定义演奏上限显著提高——这是天谱乐AI吉他面向进阶体验的旗舰之作。
list.productDescriptionEn:
TemPolor Melo-D is the world’s first generative AI guitar, pioneering the new category of “generative AI instruments.” It embeds a generative AI music model directly into the guitar hardware, enabling creation and performance on a single instrument.
At this year’s WAIC, the Obsidian Black edition will make its first public debut in China. Its interactive hardware has also been upgraded with more responsive Rainbow Strings and customizable chords, greatly raising the ceiling for personalized performance. It is Melo-D’s flagship model for an advanced playing experience.

list.enterpriseName: 广州趣丸网络科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Guangzhou Quwan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 天谱乐AI Agent “Tunee”是面向全球创作者的新一代对话式 AI 音视频创作 Agent，由“国产 AI 音乐三巨头”之一的天谱乐团队打造，也是国内首个对话式音乐创作 Agent。它像一位专业音乐制作人与视频创作搭档，能通过聊天理解想法、追问细节，并结合热点趋势给出创作方案。新版本升级无限画布、MV 创作与剪辑能力，支持从灵感、歌曲到分镜与成片打磨的一体化流程，一站式解决 AI 音视频制作门槛高、工具流程割裂的创作痛点。
list.productDescriptionEn:
TemPolor AI Agent is a next-generation conversational AI audio-video creation agent for creators worldwide, developed by TemPolor, one of China’s top three AI music teams. With million-plus monthly visits to its official website, TemPolor AI Agent is one of the fastest breakout products in China’s AI Agent space.
Building on TemPolor AI Agent’s strengths in conversational music creation, TemPolor AI Agent adds an infinite canvas, MV generation, and final editing, offering an all-in-one solution to the high barriers and fragmented workflows of AI audio-video production.

list.enterpriseName: 宇泛智能科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
宇泛灵猫（Cyvet）是一款专为具身智能科研与极客团队打造的具身智能底盘载具。它将满血的 NVIDIA Orin 算力与 15Kg 工业级满载底盘完美融合，凭借极致的物理冗余和深层开放的 API，成为开发者低门槛拥抱物理世界的最佳外设。
        随着大模型（如 Claude/GPT 等）极大地降低了软件代码的门槛，具身智能的开发群体正从传统的“高精尖实验室”迅速向外围扩张。我们的愿景是：用硬件的极致堆料，承载软件的无限可能。 我们不定义灵猫的上限，而是为经费受限但极具创造力的学生、开发者及注重经济性的小型创业公司，提供一台“抗造、懂事、接口全透”的重型物理沙箱。
list.productDescriptionEn: UNIUBI AI's Cyvet is an embodied intelligence chassis platform built for robotics research and developer teams. It integrates full-performance NVIDIA Orin computing power with a 15kg industrial-grade heavy-duty chassis, combining strong physical redundancy with a deeply open API architecture, making it a low-barrier hardware platform for developers to access and interact with the physical world.

list.productDescriptionCn:
瘴气吞噬山灵，五欲化妖为祸。百毒不侵的至纯小鼠被选为天命之子，拜入猫掌教门下，踏上讨伐五大妖王、寻觅破障药引之途。
第二季直指五欲之首"嗔"念。小鼠曾将"一窍"神力视为立身之本，却在与嗔念妖王的交锋中失去这份倚仗，被迫直面"无窍即无能"的恐惧。在与同伴的生死羁绊中，他挣脱"天选"枷锁，从依赖神力到觉醒本心。
当他甘愿为守护同伴献祭最后一丝神力时，终于领悟——破障之引从非外物，而是直面己心、坚守道义的勇气。一介凡鼠，以血肉意志铸就没有替身可言的英雄之路。
list.productDescriptionEn: Rage shatters the jade formation, yet mortal resolve turns the tide of fate. The inherently pure little mouse embarks once more on an adventure to seek the medicinal catalyst. As apocalyptic miasma resurfaces, old allies turn traitor, and an evil force wielding overwhelming power stands in its way—stripped cruelly of its "Chosen One's power", how will the mouse confront rampant desire with nothing but mortal flesh and bone? Can it forge an authentic path to heroism by clinging tenaciously to hope amid an inescapable dead end?

该作品在 AIGC 领域建成了可复用的院线动画 AI 工业化管线，验证了 AI 降低高概念原创内容落地门槛的产业价值，实现了技术创新与故事情感内核的深度统一。

The film builds a reusable theatrical AI pipeline, lowering barriers for high-concept originals while uniting innovation and emotional storytelling.

Through the city brain framework, it will extend to subordinate districts, sharing digital dividends and driving both economic returns and social value.

超薄机身设计，轻松穿越≤58cm狭窄过道，灵巧贴边不卡顿，复杂空间全覆盖无死角。搭载高能量密度电池组，洗地续航3.5小时，尘推续航10小时，持久动力从容应对大面积清洁需求。

Its high-pressure scrubbing system with vibrating pads removes stubborn grease and shoe prints instantly, leaving floors streak-free. The ultra-slim design navigates aisles as tight as 58cm, ensuring full coverage in complex spaces. With 3.5h scrubbing or 10h dust-mopping battery life, it delivers sustained performance for large areas. Ideal for factories, restaurants, subway stations, and hospitals.

list.productDescriptionEn: The EVO Max 4T V2 brings powerful technologies and advanced autonomy to users. EVO Max 4T V2 assesses complex environments to create real-time 3D flight paths for unparalleled obstacle avoidance. Advanced sensors make flight in GNSS unavailable areas possible and the incredible new thermal payload unlocks new object identification and tracking scenarios. With a foldable, weather-resistant design, the EVO Max 4T V2 is as portable as it is capable.

list.productDescriptionEn: The next-gen Dragonfish-25 continues Autel Robotics’ unique tilt-rotor design, combining the versatility of multi-rotor vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) and fixed-wing’s long-endurance.

Powered by a high-performance computing platform, it supports multimodal intelligent interaction, autonomously plans flight routes, and executes missions with exceptional efficiency. Equipped with the Autel OmniLink video transmission system; it enables multi-unit task coordination, real-time information sharing, and all day intel

It unifies service standards, cuts costs, boosts efficienc

list.productName: 中国烟草烟叶分级系统
list.productNameEn: AI-powered Tobacco Leaf Grading System for China Tobacco
list.enterpriseName: 上海派动科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 派动科技自主研发的烟叶分级系统，基于深度学习计算机视觉技术，针对传统人工分级存在的主观判断、标准不统一、效率低下等痛点，提供智能化解决方案。系统采用多分支卷积、Transformer编码器与动态注意力融合模块，实现对烟叶的精准分级。核心成果包括：Feature-reinforced dual-encoder aggregation网络、多感受野特征自适应融合技术。已发表中科院1区Top期刊论文2篇、EI T1期刊论文1篇，授权发明专利5项。系统可替代人工进行全量品质监控，大幅提升分级效率与一致性，为烟草生产提供可靠的质量保障。

Integrating multi-branch CNNs, Transformer encoders, and dynamic attention fusion, it enables accurate tobacco leaf grading. The project has produced two CAS Q1 Top journal papers, one EI T1 journal paper, and five authorized invention patents, improving grading efficiency, consistency, and quality control.

list.productNameEn: AI Safety Risk Monitoring and Early Warning System
list.enterpriseName: 上海派动科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 派动科技自主研发的AI危险监测及预警系统，融合计算机视觉、多视角感知、多范式视觉融合、5G高速通信、边缘计算及动态预警逻辑等先进技术。系统可对建筑工地、工厂等场景进行实时危险监测，不仅能发现违反安全操作规范的行为，更能提前预见危险并及时预警。核心价值：减少误伤事故、保护工人生命安全；减少停产损失；AI替代人眼盯防降低90%以上人力成本；长期数据积累用于安全评估、保险评级、合规审计。已发表中科院1区Top期刊论文1篇，授权发明专利3项。
list.productDescriptionEn: Pydance’s AI safety risk monitoring and early warning system integrates computer vision, multi-view perception, 5G communication, edge computing, and dynamic warning logic. It enables real-time hazard detection in construction sites and factories, identifying unsafe operations and issuing early alerts. The system helps reduce accidents, protect workers, cut downtime losses, lower manual monitoring costs by over 90%, and support safety assessment, insurance rating, and compliance auditing. It has produced one CAS Q1 Top journal paper and three authorized invention patents.

list.productDescriptionCn: 派动科技自主研发的AI建筑外墙缺陷智能巡检系统，深度融合无人机高空巡检、红外与可见光双光融合、深度学习视觉算法及大数据分析平台等前沿技术。系统可对高层建筑外墙进行高效、全覆盖的自动化巡检与分析，精准识别并定位空鼓、渗漏、开裂等在可见光下难以察觉的潜在缺陷，自动量化缺陷面积、分类归档，形成全面检测报告。改变了传统"蜘蛛人"高危、低效的作业模式，极大提升检测效率与安全性。适用于建筑施工交付与质量验收、既有建筑巡检与维护、高层建筑桥梁等复杂工程安全检测、政府/物业单位安全监管等场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Pydance’s AI-powered building façade defect inspection system integrates drone-based high-altitude inspection, infrared–visible light fusion, deep learning vision algorithms, and big data analytics. It enables efficient, full-coverage automated inspection of high-rise façades, accurately detecting hidden defects such as debonding, leakage, and cracks, while quantifying defect areas and generating reports. Replacing high-risk manual rope-access inspection, it improves efficiency and safety for project acceptance, building maintenance, infrastructure inspection, and safety supervision.

list.productDescriptionCn: 派动科技自主研发的AI肠衣缺陷检测系统，深度融合高精度光学成像、深度学习视觉算法、高速数据处理与实时剔除联动技术。系统专为肠衣生产线设计，能够在线、高速、精准地识别破洞、异物、斑点、结节及粗细不均等各类微小瑕疵。可取代传统人工目检，解决因疲劳、主观因素导致的漏检和误判问题，并对缺陷数据进行实时统计与分析，赋能前端工艺持续优化。系统以远超人类的精度与效率，守护每一米肠衣品质，为食品安全与生产标准化提供坚实技术保障。
list.productDescriptionEn: Pydance’s AI sausage casing defect detection system integrates high-precision optical imaging, deep learning vision algorithms, high-speed data processing, and real-time rejection control. Designed for casing production lines, it detects tiny defects such as holes, foreign matter, stains, nodules, and uneven thickness online and at high speed. Replacing manual inspection, it reduces missed and false detections, enables real-time defect statistics, supports process optimization, and improves product quality, food safety, and production standardization.

list.productDescriptionEn: The system addresses missed diagnosis and difficult quantitative assessment in pediatric trichiasis. Using computer vision, deep learning, and medical image analysis, it automatically detects, segments, grades, and assesses eyelid and eyelash images. It supports standardized image processing, trichiasis grading, risk assessment, and report generation, improving screening efficiency by 3–5 times, reducing missed diagnoses, and helping identify high-risk children early to prevent corneal damage and abnormal visual development.

系统依托四大核心技术：搭载六款自研核心芯片与国产高速无损网络，保障十万计算卡协同运转；采用层次化异构并行架构，搭配智能管控平台，实现资源高效调度与故障自愈，系统可用性达99.99%；运用浸没式液冷技术，PUE低至1.04，年减碳约4万吨，绿色节能优势突出。
平台集成60余个科学模型与百套数据集，大幅缩短科研模型开发周期，全面赋能生命科学、材料、气象等多领域创新研究。

With 60+ scientific models and 100+ datasets, it accelerates R&D in life sciences, materials, meteorology, and beyond.

The system achieves three breakthroughs: unified supercomputing and AI computing, full precision from 8 to 64 bits, and scalable scheduling for 100,000-card clusters via self-developed scaleFabric network. list.productName: 具身智能语义化操作系统
list.enterpriseName: 上海具识智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Jushi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn:
上海具识智能科技发布国内首个具身智能语义化操作系统insightOS-Semantic，并展示双机器人自主协同拆码垛场景，实现机器人从“按指令执行”到“按目标思考”的升级。
本次展示涵盖五大核心优势：可实时更新的动态语义地图、无需重复编程的自主任务规划能力、跨型号机器人自主协同与故障无缝接管功能、工况异常自愈处置能力，以及EAP（具身智能体安装）小时级快速部署能力。同时，大会正式开源该系统，开放全维度生态，覆盖多行业应用场景。
现场还设实操互动区，可供观众体验智能垛型规划、异常处理等技术优势。具识智能由哈工大科研团队2024年孵化成立，此次产品发布进一步强化了国产机器人操作系统的自主可控实力。
list.productDescriptionEn: The system boasts five core competitive strengths. It builds real-time updated dynamic semantic maps for automatic on-site environment identification. It supports autonomous task planning without repeated programming for various stacking types. It enables cross-model robot collaboration, route conflict avoidance and seamless fault takeover. It delivers independent self-healing to handle operational anomalies without manual intervention. It also supports hour-level rapid deployment via EAP.

list.productDescriptionCn: 上海具识智能科技有限公司正式展出国内首个具身智能语义化操作系统insightOS-Semantic，并展出基于语义化操作系统驱动的“多台机器人自主协同拆码垛”场景。本次展出场景采用两台不同型号的机器人智元精灵 G2 与星海图R1 Pro，覆盖从机器人自主识别料箱、拆垛、码垛到多机协同的全流程，让机器人从"按指令执行"实现"按目标思考"。本次展出还设置了“垛型智能调整实操互动区”，参观者可现场自主搭建垛型，自由切换多层拆码垛、标准规整垛等堆叠样式。现场上手体验系统智能垛形规划、垛型异常处理，直观感受拆码垛方案灵活可调、高效适配的核心技术优势。

Two robots Agibot G2 and Starsea R1 Pro finish bin detection, destacking, stacking and coordination, letting robots think by goals instead of executing commands. Visitors tested an interactive zone to build stacks, switch stacking types, and experience intelligent planning & anomaly handling to see its flexible adaptability.

list.productDescriptionCn: 骐骥T1000整备额定负重 1000kg，是市面主流轻载机器狗的 20 倍，可承载小型整车大批量救援物资，是全球首款量产级吨级四足重载平台。自研 QDD 准直驱关节，单关节峰值扭矩 2000N・m，为人形机器人大腿关节的 5 倍，全部自主设计电机、减速器、力控结构；配套专属液冷散热系统，解决高负载长时间运转电机过热抱死行业通病，保障连续重载工况稳定运行。搭载 45kW 超高压电池动力平台，满电续航 1–2 天，支持野外无市电环境全天候作业；适配低温、高原电压损耗优化设计，零下极寒环境动力衰减可控，搭载全身动态平衡力控算法，可稳定通行雪地、冰面、40° 以上陡坡、泥泞、碎石、地震废墟、狭窄栈道.
list.productDescriptionEn:
The Qiji T1000 boasts a rated payload of 1000 kg when fully configured, 20 times that of mainstream light-load quadruped robots available on the market. Capable of hauling large batches of rescue supplies equivalent to small vehicle loads, it stands as the world’s first mass-produced ton-class heavy-duty quadruped platform.
It features self-developed QDD quasi-direct drive joints with a peak torque of 2000 N·m per joint—five times the torque output of the thigh joints in humanoid robots. All motors, reducers and force control structures are independently designed in-house.

list.enterpriseName: 深圳市睿研智能控制有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: RY-E1是一款面向科教体验、互动展示与家庭娱乐场景的一体化智能仿生交互平台。RY-E1集强劲算力与极致灵活性于一体。它不仅是领先的机械装置，更是融合了英特尔酷睿ULTRA处理器与工业级6自由度灵巧手的智慧结晶。配合13.3寸彩色触控屏，RY-E1实现了毫秒级的手势跟随与极富趣味的人机博弈。无论是“猜拳游戏”的博弈互动，还是“随音舞动”的节拍律动，它凭借1080/S的响应速度与直观的图形化示教界面，重新定义了人机交互与动态演示的新高度，让前沿机器人技术变得触手可及、寓教于乐。
list.productDescriptionEn: RY-E1 is an integrated intelligent bionic interactive platform designed for science education, interactive displays, and home entertainment. Combining powerful computing with exceptional flexibility, it integrates Intel Core Ultra processors, an industrial-grade 6-DOF dexterous hand, and a 13.3-inch color touchscreen. RY-E1 enables millisecond-level gesture following and engaging human-machine games, from Rock-Paper-Scissors to dancing with sound, redefining human-computer interaction and dynamic display experiences.

list.enterpriseName: 浙江中坚科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
本届waic中坚科技将展示全新人形机器人概念机——Zero。它是对具身智能的全新探索，我们希望它成为AI认知范式下的一场思想启蒙。

在数学与哲学中，“0”与“∞”相辅相成，正如《道德经》所言“道生万物”，“道”即是原初的“Zero”。因此，我们没有预设它是助手、伙伴或工具，而是选择为它“留白”，把定义的权利交还给大众。我们希望与大家一起探讨：在具身智能时代，人与机器人究竟该是一种怎样的关系？
list.productDescriptionEn:
At this year's WAIC, Zhongjian Technology will unveil its brand-new humanoid robot concept — Zero. It represents a fresh exploration into embodied intelligence, and we hope it will serve as an intellectual awakening within the AI cognitive paradigm.
In mathematics and philosophy, '0' and '∞' complement each other, just as the Tao Te Ching  states: 'The Tao gives birth to all things.' The 'Tao' is the primordial 'Zero.' Therefore, we do not predefine it as an assistant, companion, or tool.
