针对AI大模型训练、超算中心等高密场景，液&液CDU采用双液体回路设计，单机柜散热能力覆盖65-90kW。该产品采用6U机架式设计，高效集成，极大节省机房空间；具备N+N高可靠泵电冗余设计，确保运行不间断；精准智能控温系统实时传感与调节，保障最佳供液温度；灵活分布式按需配置，精准匹配机柜热负载，可显著优化数据中心PUE。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Here's a concise English version within 600 characters:
Liquid & Liquid CDU: Performance Heart for Ultra-Dense Computing
Designed for AI training and supercomputing centers, the Liquid & Liquid CDU features a dual-loop design delivering 65–90kW cooling per rack. Its 6U rack-mounted form factor saves space, while N+N redundant pumps and power ensure non-stop operation. Smart temperature control enables real-time sensing and adjustment for optimal coolant supply. Flexible distributed configuration precisely matches rack heat loads, significantly improving data center PUE.

list.enterpriseName: 磐石浩海（北京）液冷技术有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: RockCooling (Beijing) Liquid Cooling Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: RDHx液冷背板门是一种部署于服务器机柜后门的机柜级散热设备。其内置铜铝换热盘管及轴流风扇，利用户外冷水机组提供的冷冻水作为一次侧冷源。服务器排出的热气流经盘管时，热量被冷冻水携带至室外，经风扇辅助排出的常温空气回至机房环境，形成局部封闭冷却回路。该方案单机柜散热能力达30kW，适用于高密度AI训练集群、高性能计算及风冷机房高密化改造场景。
list.productDescriptionEn:
RDHx Liquid Cooling Back Door
A rack-level cooling device mounted on the rear door. Built-in copper-aluminum coils and axial fans use chilled water from outdoor chillers as the primary cold source. Hot air from servers passes through the coils; heat is carried outdoors, while cool air returns to the room, forming a closed loop. Offering 30kW cooling per rack, it’s ideal for high-density AI clusters, HPC, and retrofitting air-cooled data centers.

list.productNameEn: Cold Plate Phase-Change Heat Exchange Module
list.enterpriseName: 磐石浩海（北京）液冷技术有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: RockCooling (Beijing) Liquid Cooling Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 该产品基于两相流换热原理，采用低沸点介电工质作为传热介质。工质流经冷板内部微通道时，吸收芯片热量发生液态→气态相变，利用汽化潜热实现高效热输运，散热能力与热均匀性显著优于传统单相液冷方案。该技术路线面向下一代高功耗AI芯片（如英伟达B200单芯片1000W+及后续产品），适用于超大规模AI集群、HPC及边缘高密计算场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: This product uses two-phase flow heat exchange with a low-boiling-point dielectric fluid. As the fluid flows through microchannels inside the cold plate, it absorbs chip heat and undergoes liquid-to-gas phase change. The latent heat of vaporization enables efficient heat transport, delivering superior cooling capacity and thermal uniformity over conventional single-phase liquid cooling. Designed for next-gen high-power AI chips (e.g., NVIDIA B200 1000W+ per chip and beyond), it is ideal for hyperscale AI clusters, HPC, and high-density edge computing.

list.enterpriseName: 磐石浩海（北京）液冷技术有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: RockCooling (Beijing) Liquid Cooling Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 冷板式相变CDU（两相冷量分配单元）是为两相冷板液冷系统设计的核心热管理设备。与传统单相CDU输送显热不同，相变CDU负责驱动低沸点介电工质在循环中发生液-气相变，并完成气态工质的冷凝回流。其核心功能包括：通过氟泵驱动工质循环、利用换热器将气态工质冷凝为液态、通过干度与过冷度调节确保进入冷板的工质为液态且回气为气液两相态。该方案散热效率较单相提升3-10倍，专为千瓦级AI芯片及高密度机柜设计，适用于智算中心与超算场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: The Cold Plate Phase-Change CDU is a thermal management unit for two-phase cold plate cooling. It drives low-boiling-point dielectric fluid to undergo liquid-vapor phase change and condenses the vapor back to liquid. Key functions include circulating fluid via a pump, condensing vapor through a heat exchanger, and regulating vapor quality to ensure liquid enters the cold plate. This solution delivers 3–10x higher heat rejection efficiency than single-phase systems, designed for kilowatt-level AI chips and high-density racks, ideal for AI data centers and supercomputing.

list.enterpriseName: 北京生数科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 世界生成模型 Vidu 为生数的核心驱动力，于数字世界提供先进的多模态生成能力。基于我们基座世界模型对世界强大的理解和重构能力，Vidu 能够解码并呈现音视频内容供用户观看，支持高保真内容创作以及与创作者的协同创作创新，从而实现强大的文生视频、图生视频及参考生视频等能力，亦提升世界生成的一致性、物理合理性、交互性，让模型从“单纯生成数字内容”升级为“理解背后的世界规律”，并构建动态数字世界及藉此提升底层基座世界模型的通用能力。
list.productDescriptionEn: GensPi provide advanced multi-modal generation capabilities in the digital world with Vidu, our world generation model. Based on the strong capabilities to understand and reconstruct the world of our foundation world model, Vidu can decode and render audiovisual content for viewing, high-fidelity content creation and compositional innovation with creators, thereby enabling strong text-to-video, image-to-video and reference based generation capabilities and also improving the consistency, reasonableness and interactivity in world generation.

list.enterpriseName: 北京生数科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 生数以世界行动模型 MotuBrain 构建大一统架构，实现具身智能的多任务泛化及高数据效率。MotuBrain 采用 MoT 架构，通过将多项功能整合至统一框架，解决具身智能体在理解、建模及控制层面的碎片化问题。相较于 VLA 路径，世界模型普遍被认为具有更强的通用性，且更适合作为物理世界应用的基座模型。基于基座世界模型对物理规律的理解，以及在序列行动下的状态预测能力，MotuBrain 将预测直接转化为机器人、智能设备等物理载体的可执行动作，同时通过物理世界的行动反馈，反向优化模型对世界的认知，形成“虚拟建模 - 物理行动 - 反馈迭代”的正向闭环。
list.productDescriptionEn: GensPi achieve task number scaling and high data efficiency in embodied intelligence with MotuBrain, a world action model with a unified framework. MotuBrain adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers (“MoT”) framework that addresses the fragmentation of embodied agents in understanding, modeling and control by integrating multiple functions into a unified framework.

list.enterpriseName: 武汉华威科智能技术有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Wuhan Huaweike Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 数据采集专业版触觉传感器面向工业产线检测、机器人精细操作、科研实验分析等专业场景，其特性要求需围绕高精度数据采集、稳定感知性能、强环境适配、专业级数据交互四大核心方向构建，同时兼顾工业级可靠性与科研级灵活性。
list.productDescriptionEn: Designed for professional scenarios such as industrial production line inspection, robotic precision manipulation, and scientific research experimentation, this sensor is engineered around four core pillars: high-precision data acquisition, stable perceptual performance, robust environmental adaptability, and professional-grade data interfacing. It strikes a critical balance between industrial-grade reliability and research-level flexibility.

list.productNameEn: Showcase of Gloves and Dexterous Hands
list.enterpriseName: 武汉华威科智能技术有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Wuhan Huaweike Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 本展品包含触觉灵巧手与专业级数采手套两套核心硬件。灵巧手指尖集成高灵敏度触觉/三维力传感器，可精准感知抓取的力度与滑移状态；数采手套内置华威科自研柔性传感器阵列，能实时捕捉手部关节动作与接触反馈。系统通过“手套动作映射+手部触觉回传”实现双向闭环的视触遥操，直观展示从人手动作到机器执行的高保真数据复现。
list.productDescriptionEn:
This exhibit features two core hardware systems: a tactile dexterous hand and a professional-grade data acquisition glove.
The fingertips of the dexterous hand integrate high-sensitivity tactile/3D force sensors to precisely perceive grip force and incipient slip. The data acquisition glove incorporates Huaweike's proprietary flexible sensor arrays, enabling real-time capture of hand joint movements and contact feedback. Through "glove motion mapping + hand tactile feedback,"​ the system achieves bidirectional closed-loop visuo-tactile teleoperation.

list.productNameEn: Teco HyperIntelliX：The Next-Gen HPC-AI Converged Computing System
list.enterpriseName: 太初（杭州）集成电路有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
新一代超智融合计算系统元碁 HyperIntelliX是面向智算、超算双场景的全国产算力基础设施，可支撑万亿参数大模型训推与AI4S科学计算。系统搭载自研T2 Ultra 芯片与Teco Switch交换芯片，支持在网计算，采用模块化架构与液冷供电，PUE 低于1.1。本次展示的256卡集群，可通过光互联扩展至十万卡规模。
产品具备双计算模式与FP4-FP64全精度算力，精简硬件资源、降低应用成本。针对大模型推理、MoE并行、分布式 KV调度深度优化，全面适配主流生态。配套自研AI4S计算平台，赋能气象、生物医药、量子等前沿领域，构建全栈自主可控的融合算力方案。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Teco HyperIntelliX：The Next-Gen HPC-AI Converged Computing System
This domestic infrastructure powers trillion-parameter models and AI4S computing. Featuring self-developed chips, liquid cooling and PUE below 1.1, the 256-card cluster scales to 100,000 cards via optical interconnection.
With dual computing modes and full FP4-FP64 precision, it reduces costs and fits mainstream ecosystems. Paired with the AI4S platform, it supports meteorology, biomedicine and quantum research, delivering a fully independent converged computing solution.

list.enterpriseName: 绳肌妙算（上海）机器人有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Aero Hand Lite 是一款面向真实产线与数据采集的腱驱柔顺灵巧手。具备以下特点。
1、最轻：整机379g，可适配多种不同场景需求，超轻的设计可搭载极轻量级的特种机械臂，实现极狭窄空间的精细操作。
2、最美：Aero Hand Lite设计获红点设计奖、Muse设计金奖。
3、最耐用：产品在设计之初就充分考虑行业核心痛点，将耐用性做到极致，100万次以上的腱绳寿命在实测场景实现了真实柔顺包裹抓取连续一周7*24小时的实战考验。
4、最具性价比：为了不让用户多花一份冤枉钱，来自特斯拉的产品设计师以第一性原理出发，优化每个设计细节，将整体产品的性价比做到全球第一
list.productDescriptionEn: Key features: (1) Ultra-light, 379g total, mountable on lightweight arms for fine manipulation in tight spaces; (2) Durable, tendon life rated over 1,000,000 cycles and validated by 7×24 continuous grasp-release testing; (3) Compliant enveloping grasp that wraps rather than pinches, securely handling irregular, slippery and soft objects; (4) Safe and fault-tolerant, with motors centralized in the palm and none in the fingers, so knocks, impacts and drops cause no damage and it won't hurt human hands;

list.enterpriseName: 绳肌妙算（上海）机器人有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Aero Hand Open 是绳肌妙算推出的开源肌腱驱动灵巧手，它采用人手尺寸设计、整机不到 400g，用 7 个电机经自适应耦合肌腱驱动 16 个可动关节、7 个主动自由度，指尖力超过 10N，既能稳定捏取小于 5mm 的零件，也能提起 5 加仑水桶；全关节 100% 可反驱，配合位置/力矩多模式控制与肌腱张力传感，实现安全、柔顺、不伤物也不伤人的真实交互，肌腱寿命经实测验证超过 100 万次循环。它更是一个开箱即用的开发平台——开源完整 CAD、固件与代码，提供 Python SDK、ROS2 及 MuJoCo "仿真到实物"三步部署。
list.productDescriptionEn: Aero Hand Open – an open‑source tendon‑driven dexterous hand by TetherIA. Human‑hand‑sized, <400g. 7 motors drive 16 joints (7 DoF) via adaptive tendons. Fingertip force >10N – grips <5mm parts and lifts 5‑gallon bucket. 100% backdrivable joints, position/torque control, tendon sensing – safe, compliant interaction. Tendon life >1M cycles. Ready‑to‑use dev platform: open CAD, firmware, code, Python SDK, ROS2, MuJoCo “sim‑to‑real” in 3 steps.

list.enterpriseName: 杭州曦诺未来科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 曦诺未来微型电缸涵盖行星滚柱丝杠与梯形丝杠两大系列，最小直径仅10mm，最轻重量45g，最大推力可达300N。产品具备高重复定位精度、集成力传感器、低噪音、低功耗等特点，支持LVTTL串口通信，适用于具身智能、精密执行等灵巧操作场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Xynova’s micro linear actuators are available in planetary roller screw and trapezoidal screw series. They feature a minimum diameter of just 10mm, a lightest weight of 45g, and a maximum thrust of 300N. The actuators offer high repeat positioning accuracy, integrated force sensors, low noise, and low power consumption. They support LVTTL serial communication and are ideal for dexterous manipulation applications such as embodied intelligence and precision actuation.

list.enterpriseName: 上海岩山科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: LumiSleep D1是一台可穿戴实时闭环调控脑电睡眠设备。LumiSleep 通过实时脑电信号精准识别用户的独特脑状态变化，依托头戴装置内的本地化先进算法，系统能在毫秒级完成 脑电信号监测 → 脑状态解码 → 声音信号生成 → 脑状态调节 的全闭环过程，且以上过程均由头带内置芯片本地化化完成，无需依赖手机或云端。最终为用户提供科学、高效、个性化的入睡解决方案，以更温和的方式帮助大脑进入自然睡眠状态。续航时间12小时，夜间使用，可配合轻薄类型眼罩一起使用。
list.productDescriptionEn: LumiSleep D1 is a wearable real-time closed-loop EEG sleep modulation device. LumiSleep accurately identifies each user’s unique brain-state changes through real-time EEG signals. Powered by advanced on-device algorithms embedded in the head-worn unit, the system can complete the full closed-loop process within milliseconds: EEG signal monitoring → brain-state decoding → sound signal generation → brain-state modulation.

list.enterpriseName: 深圳市雷赛智能控制股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 关节模组专为机器人和自动化设备应用，集高扭矩密度、全闭环精度控制、模块化集成设计及开放协议兼容性于一体，并配备长寿命谐波/行星减速器，确保稳定运行和高效动力传输。作为机器人核心驱动单元，该模组整合了电机、减速器、编码器等关键组件，赋予机器人灵活、精准的运动控制能力。提供谐波关节模组、行星关节魔族及轮式关节模组三类，共包括18种标准型号，满足多样化的机器人设计需求。
list.productDescriptionEn: The joint solutions series is designed for robotics and automation applications, featuring high torque density, closed-loop precision control, modular integration, and open protocol compatibility. Equipped with long-life harmonic or planetary reducers, the solutions ensure stable operation and efficient power transmission.Integrating motors, reducers, and encoders into a compact unit, the series enables flexible and precise motion control for robots. The portfolio includes harmonic, planetary, and wheel joint solutions, covering 18 standard models to meet diverse robotic application needs.

list.enterpriseName: 深圳市雷赛智能控制股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 致力于为用户提供高可靠性、可量产化、可定制的人形机器人末端执行器及整体解决方案。DH系列灵巧手采用自研无刷空心杯电机模组，具备高效率、高转矩密度及低温升等特点，并集成高功率密度一体化驱动器、高精度微型编码器，实现灵敏、精准的运动控制。产品以轻量化、高耐久及模块化设计为核心，可灵活选配多模态触觉传感器，支持 Windows、Linux、ROS2 等操作系统，兼容 EtherCAT、CAN FD、RS485 等多种通信协议，并提供可视化调试工具、开源 SDK 与 DEMO，便于客户快速开发与部署。DH系列灵巧手可广泛应用于人形机器人、科研教育、工业操作、交互展示等场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Dedicated to reliable, mass-producible, and customizable humanoid robot end-effectors. The DH dexterous hand integrates self-developed coreless BLDC motors, high-density drivers, and precision miniature encoders for agile and accurate motion control. Its lightweight modular design supports optional tactile sensors, Windows/Linux/ROS2 systems, and EtherCAT, CAN FD, and RS485 communication. Open SDKs, DEMOs, and debugging tools help accelerate development and deployment. The DH series is widely applied in humanoid robots, research, industrial operations, and interactive scenarios.

list.enterpriseName: 上海岩山科技股份有限公司

In practical application scenarios, YanClaw delivers a more flexible usage framework centered on model scheduling and capability expansion. It allows users to select model modes (Smart / End-Only / Full Cloud) according to diverse requirements, enabling flexible

list.enterpriseName: 上海岩山科技股份有限公司

The platform offers a full-stack solution covering computing hardware, AI models, and development toolchains, enabling plug-and-play deployment, rapid customization, and scalable commercialization across diverse robotic and intelligent machine

list.enterpriseName: 杭州曦诺未来科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 行星关节模组覆盖轻量高速与重载高扭矩两大场景，全系兼具高精度定位、多协议兼容及多元安装结构。轻量款突出高转速与大转矩平衡、紧凑轻巧及中空过线设计；重载款则以超高扭矩密度、大中空结构与重载可靠性见长，从容适配各类机器人关节需求。
list.productDescriptionEn: Rotary Actuators cover two major scenarios: lightweight high-speed applications and heavy-load high-torque applications. The entire series features high-precision positioning, multi-protocol compatibility, and multiple mounting configurations. The lightweight variant stands out with a balanced combination of high rotational speed and high torque, a compact and lightweight design, and a hollow wiring design. The heavy-load variant excels in ultra-high torque density, a large hollow structure, and heavy-load reliability, seamlessly meeting the joint requirements of various robot types.

list.enterpriseName: 北京科杰科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: KeenData Lakehouse数据智能平台采用Al-in-Lakehouse智能驱动型架构，将AI与自研湖仓一体引擎、多模态计算引擎、数据编织以及训推一体加速引擎等技术原生深度融合，形成精简高效的All-in-One一站式产品解决方案，全面赋能企业规模化AI应用开发与场景创新。平台面向大型组织进行数据与Al体系化落地，提供数据集成、离线实时开发、多模态计算、数据治理、数据集管理、AI模型构建、训推一体至Agent开发全链路闭环的基础设施产品，自研多模态计算引擎在单流水线中完成数据清洗至结果分析，数倍提升GPU推理吞吐，结合KMI推理加速、模型量化及Unity Catalog实现跨模态智能

It offers end-to-end capabilities including dataintegration, governance, dataset management, AI model development, and full-cycle Aldeployment. By bridging the gap between data and Al, it integrates lakehouse engines,OLAP governance, and Al functions into a streamlined All-in-One solution. Its self-devel-oped multi-modal computing engine accelerates data processing and boosts GPUinference performance. The platform has helped Fortune 500 companies across finance,energy, indus

list.enterpriseName: 神思电子技术股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 神思电子打造的搭载海光3490芯片的AI一体机，可支持两块全高全长双宽国产或主流消费级显卡，满足多样AI场景需求。目前公司已联合济南大数据集团、每日互动面向内容生产与效率提升打造两大场景：前者可调度本地化模型，实现文本、图像、音频、视频等多模态内容生成与编辑；后者具备会议纪要生成、智能写作辅助、深度研究分析等功能。
list.productDescriptionEn: Developed by Shensi Electronics and powered by the Haiguang 3490 chip, this AI all-in-one PC supports two full-height, full-length, dual-width domestic and mainstream consumer graphics cards to cater to various AI application scenarios. The company has partnered with Jinan Big Data Group and Daily Interaction to build two solution scenarios for content creation and operational efficiency. The first runs local AI models to enable multi-modal generation and editing of text, images, audio and video. The second features automatic meeting minutes, AI writing tools and in-depth research analysis.

list.enterpriseName: 天津智易时代科技发展有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 挂轨式智能巡检机器人是全自动轨道巡检装备，兼容主流轨道，爬坡角度达 60°、转弯半径小，适用于高空管廊、密集管道、隧道等固定路线场景。设备集成摄像、测温、气体及噪声检测等感知单元，具备厘米级定位、自主行走、无线充电、AI 识别、三维建模等功能，行走速度 0-0.5m/s 无级可调，续航不低于 8 小时，可 24 小时连续作业，支持自动巡航与远程操控双模式。它可实时采集各类环境与设备数据，通过 5G / 以太网回传至中控平台，精准识别泄漏、过热、管线破损等隐患并秒级告警，同步更新环境地图。产品标配防爆版本，符合化工、危化品厂区防爆标准，专为高危固定路线巡检场景打造。
list.productDescriptionEn: The fully automatic rail-mounted inspection track robot can climb Max 60°slopes, make it suitable for fixed-route scenarios such as high-altitude pipe gallery, dense pipelines and tunnels. It integrates sensing units for functions like camera shooting, Temp-measurement, gas and noise detection. It features centimeter-level positioning, autonomous walking, wireless charging, AI recognition, and 3D modeling. It can operate continuously for 24 hours and supports both automatic cruise and remote-control modes. Standard with explosion-proof version, function well in high-risk scenarios.

list.enterpriseName: 百融云创科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 百智 WiseNote 2.0 是全新升级的旗舰级 AI 录音卡，厚度约 4mm、重量约 40g，超薄磁吸机身，曜焰橙、鎏金青、暗夜黑等多配色可选。升级阵列双硅麦 + 骨传导麦克风，全场景智能降噪，嘈杂环境依然人声清晰。核心亮点为闪念一键录：长按边角键秒录灵感、待办、想法，无需解锁手机，语音自动转写并智能分类（待办 / 记账 / 灵感）。支持声纹识别、多语言 / 方言转写、200 + 行业模板一键生成纪要 / 报告，联动 PC 端百智 AI 工作台生成 PPT 与深度研究报告。三端协同（卡 + App+PC 工作台），是职场 “硅基搭子” 与学生高效学习的旗舰选择。
list.productDescriptionEn: WiseNote 2.0 AI Recorder Card is the newly upgraded flagship AI recording card, at approximately 4mm thick and 40g light, with an ultra‑slim magnetic body available in multiple colors. Upgraded dual array silicon mics + bone conduction mic provide all‑scene intelligent noise reduction, ensuring clear voice capture even in noisy environments. The standout feature is Instant Thought Recording: long‑press the corner key to instantly capture ideas, to‑dos and thoughts without unlocking your phone; voice is automatically transcribed and intelligently categorized (to‑do/notes/ideas).

list.enterpriseName: 天津智易时代科技发展有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 轮式智能巡检机器人是面向厂区、园区打造的通用型地面自主巡检装备，采用四轮独立驱动越野底盘，可适应多种复杂地形，具备 15°爬坡、越障及涉水能力。整机达IP65防护等级，可在恶劣室外环境稳定运行，标配防爆版本，适配化工、油气等危险区域。设备集成全景云台、音视频、红外、气体及环境传感单元，结合自研AI视觉算法，可完成仪表识别、缺陷检测、隐患监测等多项巡检工作；搭载激光 SLAM 导航系统，定位精准、避障智能，支持多种作业模式，单次续航8小时，可7×24小时不间断工作。设备通过5G、以太网实现数据实时上传，联动云端平台自动生成报表、推送告警并支持多机协同，部署便捷无需改造场地。
list.productDescriptionEn: Wheeled-legged intelligent robot is a general-purpose ground autonomous inspection equipment designed for factory and parks. Four-wheel independent drive off-road chassis can adapt various complex terrains, climb 15°slopes, overcome obstacles and wade. Stably operate in harsh environments by IP65 and explosion-proof standard with gas sensors, suitable for dangerous areas such as chemical, oil and gas industries. It has a single battery life of 8 hours, and can work continuously 7×24 hours, links with the cloud platform uploads real-time data via 5G and Ethernet to achieve various features.

list.enterpriseName: 杭州曦诺未来科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Xynova Flex 2采取腱绳+直驱的混合驱动方式，是一款面向人形机器人灵巧操作与具身智能研究的通用末端执行器平台。本产品集成了高自由度仿生灵巧手本体、驱动与控制电路、多模态传感系统和智能控制算法，实现从感知到执行的完整闭环控制。本产品泛化应用能力出众，拥有丰富的软硬件接口，适配主流本体厂商及各类机械臂。
list.productDescriptionEn: Xynova Flex 2 features a hybrid drive system combining tendon and direct drive methods, serving as a universal end-effector platform for dexterous manipulation and embodied AI research. Integrating a high-DOF dexterous hand, drive and control systems, multi-modal perception, and intelligent algorithms, it delivers complete closed-loop control from perception to execution. With exceptional generalization capabilities and versatile software and hardware interfaces, it ensures seamless compatibility with mainstream humanoid manufacturers and various robotic arms.

list.productDescriptionCn:
海康威视AI多模态安全生产主机，依托前沿多模态大模型架构，突破传统视觉像素级识别局限，实现从视觉捕捉到场景深度理解的革命性跃升。
设备融合图像、文本等多维度信息对齐能力，凭语言知识锚点、跨模态注意力对齐、生成式预训练与世界知识迁移四大核心优势，具备类人推理与研判能力。传统视觉模型仅做像素物体识别，无法结合作业场景与环境逻辑判断，易产生误报、滥报问题。本设备可精准甄别高空作业等复杂场景，精准判定未系安全带等实质性违规行为，规避无效告警。
作为场景级智能研判标杆，它深度解构场景逻辑与安全规范，读懂场景关联与潜在风险，以智能研判能力筑牢全域、高效、智能的安全生产防护屏障，广泛适用于工业安全监管场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision AI Multimodal Work Safety Server applies advanced multimodal large model architecture, overcoming the pixel-level recognition limitations of conventional visual algorithms. It realizes a groundbreaking upgrade from basic visual capture to in-depth, comprehensive scene understanding for industrial safety scenarios. Supporting the fusion and alignment of multi-dimensional visual and text information, the server boasts four core capabilities: language knowledge anchoring, cross-modal attention alignment, generative pre-training and world knowledge transfer.

list.productDescriptionCn: 灵御TA2是一款面向多场景远程作业的高性能双臂机器人 。该产品围绕“机侧本体执行、模型控制调度、人侧操控优化”构建了三位一体遥操作体系，将人类的判断、经验与机器的执行能力相结合 。机器人具备沉浸式远程操控、双臂协同精细作业与全向移动能力 ；依托自研核心平台，其双目视觉帧同步偏差<100μs、图传延迟<90ms，运控响应延迟<30ms，运动学闭合解求解率达100% 。配合平台化软件支撑，它不仅是机器人本体，更是一套可持续演进的作业平台 ，广泛适用于物流工业、酒店零售、科研数采及特种高危等多元场景，可有效承担重复、危险或复杂的任务 。
list.productDescriptionEn: TA 2 LingYu Robot is a high-performance dual-arm robot for multi-scenario teleoperation. Driven by a tripartite architecture (machine execution, model control, human operation), it blends human wisdom with robotic efficiency. It delivers immersive control, precision dual-arm manipulation, and omnidirectional mobility. Leveraging its core platform, TA2 achieves a binocular sync deviation <100μs, video latency <90ms, and control response <30ms. More than hardware, it serves as an evolving platform widely applied in logistics, retail, research, and high-risk environments.

list.productDescriptionCn: Kino视界是国内首个实现多模型最优调度的AI短剧平台，基于炫佳科技自主研发的Kino-AIGC视听大模型底座，深度融合Vidu、即梦、可灵、海螺、豆包等行业顶级模型能力，实现多模型择优智能生成，构建从剧本创意、分镜生成、智能拍摄到视频成片的全链路AI创作流程，将传统短剧制作从“作坊式手工”升级为“精品化工业”，平均缩短制作周期75%、提升效率90%、降低综合成本60%-80%，已成为个人创作者、MCN机构、平台方/发行方、影视院校/培训机构及视听产业园区的AI-Driven Studio，致力于推动短剧行业向标准化、规模化、普惠化迈进，激活OPC政策创新生态，定义下一代短剧生产方式。
list.productDescriptionEn: Kino Vision is China's first AI short drama platform featuring optimal multi-model scheduling. Built on Xuanjia Technology's proprietary Kino-AIGC audio-visual foundation model, it deeply integrates capabilities from leading industry models. By intelligently selecting the best model for each task, the platform establishes a full-chain AI creation workflow—from script ideation, storyboard generation, intelligent shooting, to final video production. It is dedicated to advancing the short drama industry toward standardization, scalability, and accessibility.

list.productDescriptionCn: 智标宝是炫佳科技推出的一款AI智能标书生成工具，覆盖招标投标全流程，实现从智能解析、撰写、查重到审标的一站式闭环服务。产品突破市面上仅能撰写技术部分的局限，首创“全标书智能生成”模式，可自动完成标函部分（商务文件、资格文件、报价文件）与技术部分的全链路输出，素材匹配度超98%，分钟级完成初稿编制。同时，智标宝深度整合封标前智能核验功能，可自动筛查合规性、错别字及响应偏差，有效降低废标风险。产品支持SaaS化轻部署与私有化定制，适配工程建设、医疗采购、IT服务、政府采购等多行业需求，为大型企业及OPC（一人公司）等中小主体提供专业、高效、低门槛的投标智能化解决方案。
list.productDescriptionEn: Zhibiaobao is an AI-powered intelligent bidding document generation tool launched by Xuanjia Technology. It covers the entire bidding process, delivering a one-stop closed-loop service that spans intelligent parsing, drafting, duplication checking, and bid review. Breaking through the limitation of tools that only generate the technical sections, Zhibiaobao pioneers a “full-bid intelligent generation” model, automatically producing the bid letter section (comprising commercial documents, qualification documents, and pricing documents) alongside the technical section in an end-to-end manner.

list.enterpriseName: 北京越伴动力科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 小伴是一款面向家庭日常场景的伙伴型机器人，以家庭原生设计、安全原生设计为出发点，打造适配居家和户外场景的专属双足形态。围绕语言、性格、情绪与触觉四大维度，构建更自然、更有温度的陪伴体验。独创的语言系统由12个原生基础词构成，可覆盖500类生活核心意图；通过面部表情与动作相协同，可呈现多种情绪状态；全身关节力矩反馈和触觉传感，实现类人触觉感知，精准识别触碰位置、抚摸力度、按压轻重与交互姿态，分辨轻触、安抚、依偎等意图；同时配备随机化与可成长的性格系统，在长期相处中逐渐形成属于你的独特个性。小伴是一个有表达、有分寸、会成长的家庭小伙伴。它将成为一个让家里有温暖回应的存在，让科技以更温柔的方式陪伴人

Centered on natural connection, it integrates language, personality, emotion, and touch.Its unique system uses 12 base sounds to cover 500 intentions, while synced expressions and motion convey deep emotion. With tactile sensors, RUMI perceives touch and distinguishes gestures like stroking or leaning. Its evolving personality grows through interaction, making RUMI a warm, adaptive friend.

list.productDescriptionCn: PixVerse（拍我AI）是爱诗科技旗下领先的 AI 视频生成平台，致力于让每个人都能轻松将创意转化为高质量视频。基于自研 V（旗舰视频生成模型）、R（实时生成世界模型）、C （首个影视行业大模型）等视频生成模型，PixVerse 支持文生视频、图生视频、无限画布、Agent等创作模式，实现从脚本到成片的全流程 AI 创作。目前产品覆盖全球超177个国家和地区，累计用户超 1 亿，月活用户超 1600 万。PixVerse 正以强大的技术底座和极简的用户体验，重新定义 AI 时代的视频创作方式。
list.productDescriptionEn: PixVerse, a leading AI video generation platform under Aishi Technology, empowers anyone to turn ideas into high-quality videos with ease. Built on its proprietary V flagship video model, R real-time world model, and C, the first large model for the film industry, PixVerse supports text-to-video, image-to-video, infinite canvas, and AI agents for end-to-end creation from script to final cut. Today, it reaches 100M+ users across 177+ countries , with 16M+ monthly active users.

list.productDescriptionCn: 海康威视依托二十余年视频编解码技术积累与多模态大模型突破，推出“观澜编码”技术，构建“智能感知—精细化ROI分割—策略融合编码”的全链路体系。 通过对人车等高价值目标进行精细化ROI分割，实现关键目标近无损编码、背景超高压缩，并具备全场景动态码率自适应能力。机房空间与硬盘数量节省超60%，实现“1T当3T用”的存储效率跃升。 技术已应用于摄像机与磁盘阵列存储设备，打破“存储效率与画质不可兼得”的困局，开创“以算力换存力”新路径，大幅降低视频存储总成本，推动安防行业从“被动存储”向“主动智能”跨越。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Hikvision launches Guanlan Coding featuring a full-link system of intelligent perception, refined ROI segmentation and integrated strategic encoding.
It finely segments high-value targets including humans and vehicles to achieve near-lossless encoding for key objects and ultra-high background compression, alongside full-scene dynamic bitrate adaptation.
The technology reduces server room space and hard disk quantity by over 60%, greatly lifting storage efficiency to enable 1TB equivalent to 3TB. It has been applied to cameras and disk array storage devices.

list.productDescriptionCn: 海康威视大模型文搜技术，革新传统视频检索模式，用户输入自然语言，就能在海量视频数据中快速查找目标，实现“用文字，秒搜图”。 让安防录像回溯不再局限于传统时空、报警等检索方式，大幅提升目标和事件的查找效率，让安防业务管理更高效、更智能。产品涵盖文搜 NVR、超脑、CVR、主机等，广泛应用于各类安防场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision’s multimodal Acusearch revolutionizes traditional video retrieval. Users can quickly locate targets among massive video footage with natural language input, realizing instant image search via text. No longer restricted to conventional retrieval methods based on time, locations or alarms, it drastically speeds up target and incident lookup, enabling more efficient and intelligent security management. Its product portfolio includes Acusearch NVR, DeepinMind NVR, CVR and host, widely applicable to diverse security scenarios.

list.enterpriseName: 深圳优艾智合机器人科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 隙锋 FHR-2 是优艾智合面向工业柔性作业与高端二次开发场景打造的人形轮臂机器人平台。产品集成全向移动底盘、高仿生双臂、力控感知系统与开放开发生态，具备 28自由度、双臂10kg负载、±0.05mm重复定位精度、360°全域感知、8–10小时续航 等核心能力，可广泛应用于工业柔性装配、智能仓储物流、高危环境巡检及科研开发等场景。凭借工业级可靠性、模块化扩展能力与高算力原生支持，隙锋 FHR-2 为具身智能在工业场景的真实落地提供了高性能、高开放性的实践平台。
list.productDescriptionEn: Edge FHR-2 is a humanoid wheeled-arm robot platform for flexible industrial operations and advanced secondary development. It integrates an omnidirectional mobile base, dual biomimetic arms, force-control sensing, and an open development ecosystem. With 28 degrees of freedom, 10 kg dual-arm payload, ±0.05 mm repeatability, 360° perception, and 8–10 hours of endurance, it supports industrial assembly, smart logistics, hazardous inspection, and research applications.

list.enterpriseName: 广州宸境科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Looper 具身数采套件是一套面向机器人基座模型和具身智能训练数据生产的 EGO + UMI 可穿戴多视角采集系统。系统通过头部第一视角与双手近场视角同步采集，将自然人类操作转化为可用于标注、重建和策略训练的高质量机器人学习数据。佩戴者无需改变自然操作习惯，即可完成取放、装配、清洁、整理、检视等真实任务采集；系统同步记录 RGB-D、IMU、VIO 位姿、头部运动轨迹、双手近场操作细节与任务元数据，为后续数据筛选、轨迹优化、场景重建和模型训练提供统一基础。
list.productDescriptionEn: Looper Data Acquisition Package is an EGO + UMI wearable multi-view capture system designed for robotics foundation models and embodied AI training data generation. By synchronously recording the head-mounted first-person view and close-range views of both hands, the system turns natural human operations into high-quality robot learning data for annotation, reconstruction, and policy training. With a closed‑loop "capture → QC → optimize → export" pipeline, the tool quickly turns raw data into high‑quality, model‑ready training assets.

list.enterpriseName: 广州宸境科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Insight 9 是面向机器人、机器狗与移动平台的旗舰级空间感知相机，提供中远距离深度感知、视觉惯性定位与低延迟位姿输出，可作为机器人导航系统的前端感知与定位输入。
Insight 9 内置 Visual-Inertial SLAM / VIO 能力，系统出厂完成标定与时间同步，用户无需额外进行相机标定或底层 VSLAM 算法开发，即可获得高频、低延迟的位姿输出。
Insight 9 不只是相机，而是一体化机器人视觉定位与空间感知模块，为具身智能设备提供稳定可靠的“眼睛”。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Insight 9 is a flagship spatial perception camera designed for robots, quadrupeds, and mobile platforms. It provides mid- to long-range depth perception, visual-inertial localization, and low-latency pose output as the front-end perception and localization input for robotic navigation systems.
Insight 9 integrates built-in Visual-Inertial SLAM / VIO. The system is factory-calibrated and time-synchronized, requiring no additional camera calibration or low-level VSLAM algorithm development from the user, while delivering high-frequency, low-latency pose output.

list.enterpriseNameEn: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.

list.productDescriptionCn: 热成像高精度定位云台具备算法智能、定位精准、产品易用的优势。基于海康观澜大模型的烟火识别算法可以有效过滤高温管道、云彩、运动农机等误报，准确率在行业领先；空间感知高精度定位技术大幅提升云台设备对火情的空间感知精度，精度提升12倍，3公里内火点定位误差可以做到50米；区域识别检测算法可以自动识别房屋、工厂等区域，从源头过滤高温管道、工厂排气、房屋烟囱带来的干扰，提升报警精度；喷水雨刷功能突破天气限制，能冷凝空气自集水，远程开启清洁，提升使用便捷性。
list.productDescriptionEn: It integrates intelligent algorithms, precise localization and easy operation. Driven by Guanlan Large Model, its fire & smoke algorithm eliminates false alarms from hot pipelines, clouds and farm machinery. High-precision spatial localization improves fire positioning accuracy.

list.productName: 海康威视多模态事件检测服务器
list.productNameEn: Hikvision Multimodal AI Traffic Incident Detection Server
list.enterpriseName: 杭州海康威视数字技术股份有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 海康威视多模态事件检测服务器引入视觉大模型以及多模态大模型二次复核的能力，通过视频分析精准识别路面拥堵、事故、违停、抛洒物、行人闯入等异常事件，提升视频巡查和警情发现效率。基于大模型更大的训练参数量、更强的泛化特征识别能力和语义理解能力，对视频图像进行目标检测、复杂事件场景理解，能够实现复杂环境下的事件检测，减少阴影、标志牌、作业车等环境误报，识别罕见抛洒物、机非事故等事件，提升复杂环境下的事件检出、降低误报。相比传统算法，大模型还拓展了疑难事件的检测宽度，具备机非事故、占道施工、护栏倒歪、护栏损坏、树木倒伏等无规则的事件检测能力，及时发现和主动干预警情，减少次生事故和拥堵影响。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision Multimodal AI Traffic Incident Detection Server integrates vision foundation models with multimodal AI for secondary verification. It accurately detects congestion, traffic accidents, illegal parking, fallen objects, pedestrian intrusions, and other incidents, improving video patrol efficiency and incident detection capabilities. Leveraging large-scale multimodal AI with superior generalization, object detection, complex scene understanding, and semantic reasoning, it reduces false alarms caused by shadows, traffic signs, and maintenance vehicles while identifying rare incidents.

list.productName: 海康威视大模型智能信号控制机
list.productNameEn: Hikvision Large Model AI Traffic Signal Controller
list.enterpriseName: 杭州海康威视数字技术股份有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 海康威视大模型智能信号控制机通过接入路口部署的雷视交通感知设备对交通流量、车速、排队长度等多维度数据的实时监测和分析，基于观澜大模型强大的数据处理能力和多模态模型算法，能够对海量的交通数据进行高效分析和精准预测。信号机通过动态调整信号灯时长，实现时段自划分、场景自学习、方案自生成、效果自评估的信控全流程智能升级，以路口总存车数最小为目标，达到减少空放、均衡调控、绿末截流的效果，提高绿灯利用率，减少路口拥堵。本设备已经在多个城市路口应用验证，适配百万复杂交通流场景（路口通行速度提升12%-15%、路口车辆延误降低10%-20%）。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision Large Model AI Traffic Signal Controller access data from radar-video fusion sensors to monitor traffic flow, vehicle speed, and queue length in real time. Powered by Guanlan Large Model, it leverages advanced multimodal AI to analyze and predict traffic conditions, dynamically optimizing signal timing through automatic time-period segmentation, self-learning, plan generation, and performance evaluation. Proven through deployments in multiple cities and validated in large-scale urban traffic networks, it increases intersection travel speed by 12–15%, reducing vehicle delay by 10–20%.

list.enterpriseName: 深圳市同泰怡信息技术有限公司

list.productDescriptionCn: 同泰怡液冷整机柜是一款22U标准机柜解决方案，以场景全覆盖、部署零门槛为核心优势。该液冷整机柜搭载同泰怡6U8卡AI服务器，采用先进液冷散热技术，在保障7×24小时高稳定运行的同时实现静音办公。广泛适用于代码开发、影视设计、工业仿真、应用测试等多类场景——8K素材实时渲染、多物理场极速解算、千万网格仿真流畅运行，多任务并发稳定无卡顿；支持多人远程协同低延迟作业，动画特效出片效率倍增。开箱即用，部署灵活便捷，有效降低企业算力部署成本与复杂度。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Tongtaiyi Liquid-Cooled Integrated Cabinet is a 22U standard cabinet solution featuring full-scenario coverage and zero-threshold deployment as its core strengths.
Equipped with Tongtaiyi’s 6U 8-card AI server and adopting cutting-edge liquid cooling technology, this integrated cabinet delivers quiet office operation while ensuring stable 24/7 running.
It is widely applicable to diverse scenarios including code development, film and television design, industrial simulation and application testing.

list.productDescriptionCn: 海康云眸Claw巡检智能体，依托海康威视物联感知技术与观澜大模型，围绕企业传统人工巡查中问题发现滞后、过程依赖经验、整改难以闭环等，以自然语言交互实现突破，用更简单、更灵活的方式完成自动巡查、问题识别、整改工单和报告生成，快速落实企业管理规范，高效响应企业实时变化与灵活调度需求，打破传统数字化工具的局限，为企业管理上岗“数字员工”。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision CloudVisual Claw Inspection Intelligent Agent is developed based on Hikvision IoT sensing technologies and the Guanlan Large Model. Making breakthroughs via natural language interaction with simple, flexible operations, it delivers auto patrols, defect detection, rectification work orders and automated reports. It enables companies to quickly enforce management rules, adapt to dynamic operational adjustments, overcome drawbacks of conventional digital systems, and equip on-site management with professional digital employees.

list.productDescriptionCn: 海康威视分布式定位型振动光纤，是一款基于相干检测技术的分布式光纤振动探测系统，通过PDC Φ-OTDR光时域反射解调算法做到精确的定位，结合后端数据分析处理模块，实现对振动的有效监测。设备基于多模态大模型技术，采用HIK-DAS声波还原算法+AI去误报算法，具有对天气干扰、车辆干扰如下雨、火车、汽车等的智能模式识别能力，误报数量降低97%。设备具备1/2/4/8/16通道10、30、50km/通道的多重组合能力，能适应不同场景的第三方施工破坏监测。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision Distributed Fiber-Optic Vibration Sensing System based on coherent detection technology and PDC Φ-OTDR algorithms, enables precise event localization through back-end analysis. Powered by multimodal AI, it integrates HIK-DAS acoustic restoration technology and false-alarm reduction algorithms to intelligently filter interferences from weather conditions and vehicles, reducing false alarms by 97%.

面向机器人末端抓取场景，提供覆盖轻载、中载与高载应用的全场景夹持解决方案。
产品系列包括 AIX2-M（金属款）、AIX2-P（塑料款）等型号，最大 90 mm 可调行程，可根据不同工件尺寸、重量及抓取工况，灵活定制对应的形成、夹持力、夹爪构型及材料，并可选配触觉力模块、IMU 与光学相机模组，实现视觉定位、力控抓取、柔性操作及复杂场景下的智能交互。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Designed for robotic end-of-arm gripping applications, this series provides full-scenario gripping solutions covering light-, medium-, and heavy-load applications. 
With a maximum adjustable stroke of 90 mm, the grippers can be flexibly customized in terms of stroke, gripping force, jaw configuration, and material according to different workpiece sizes, weights, and gripping conditions. Optional tactile force modules, IMUs, and optical camera modules are also available, enabling visual positioning, force-controlled gripping, flexible manipulation, and intelligent interaction.

list.productDescriptionEn: The FarsClaw Enterprise Legal AI Agent is Turing Micro Sparrow's flagship achievement in the legal AI domain. Leveraging proprietary multi-agent technology and judicial-specific AI capabilities, the solution provides one-stop coverage for core legal scenarios throughout the entire enterprise lifecycle, including contract management, compliance and risk control, institutional framework development, workforce management, and law firm-enterprise collaboration, rapidly empowering enterprises to build a modernized compliance management system.

list.productDescriptionCn: 新一代国产AI4S计算平台是太初元碁自主研发的一站式科研创新平台，以自研异构众核AI芯片为算力底座，构建覆盖硬件、基础组件、加速库、模型框架、开发套件的全栈原生科研解决方案，面向气象预测、生物医药、量子力学、化学材料、流体力学等前沿科学领域。平台全面兼容龙芯、申威、飞腾、x86等国内外主流CPU，提供自研编程模型和涵盖通用算子与科学计算专用加速库。同时深度适配 PyTorch、JAX、飞桨、MindSpore 等主流框架，并配套 DevKit 开发套件，支持算子生成、编译优化与性能分析，有效降低算子开发门槛与性能调优难度。
list.productDescriptionEn: The Next-Generation Domestic AI4S Computing Platform is a one-stop scientific research and innovation platform independently developed by Tecorigin. Built upon self-developed heterogeneous many-core AI chips as its computational foundation, it provides a full-stack native scientific research solution encompassing hardware, basic components, acceleration libraries, model frameworks, and development kits.

list.productDescriptionCn: 海康威视体育训测互动相机，搭载26T澎湃算力，将大模型直接部署于端侧，兼顾专业运动检测与AR趣味互动两大核心能力。设备支持跳绳、跳远、引体向上、仰卧起坐、俯卧撑、跑步、排球垫球、实心球、篮 / 足球绕杆等 12 种体育运动的实时识别检测，可满足校园体育考核、日常训练的数据采集与分析需求。同时支持 AR 手势识别互动，内置 10 种趣味体感小游戏，通过体感交互打造沉浸式运动体验，有效降低运动门槛、提升大众参与感。 还可拓展对接 LED 大屏，搭配智能多媒体体训平台组成完整智慧体育方案，适配校园操场、社区运动空间等多元场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Powered by a 26T edge AI engine, this smart camera seamlessly blends professional athletic assessment with immersive AR gaming. It supports real-time tracking for 12 major sports including rope skipping, standing long jump, pull-ups, sit-ups, push-ups, running, volleyball, medicine ball, and basketball/football dribbling drills — perfect for school PE exams and daily training—while offering 10 built-in motion-sensing games via gesture recognition to boost public engagement. Scalable with LED displays, it delivers a complete smart sports solution for school campuses and community spaces.

list.enterpriseName: 百川智能科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Baichuan-M4 是百川智能全新发布的医疗增强大模型，在 HealthBench、HealthBench Hard/Professional 等权威榜单中同时位列世界第一，全面超越 GPT-5.5、Opus 4.7 等顶尖模型，事实性幻觉率降至 3.3%，创全球新低。它将权威医学指南拆解为 1000 余条原子化临床路径，让循证成为每一步推理的骨架；能像医生一样步步追问，并以超长记忆托起长周期健康管理。同步亮相的 AI 家庭医生「百小医」，定位"明明白白看医生，安安心心管家人"，接住就医历程中约 95% 的诊前诊后环节，与真人医生形成"双医模式"，并通过微信为全家建立健康档案。
list.productDescriptionEn: Baichuan-M4 is Baichuan's new medical LLM. It ranks first globally on benchmarks like HealthBench, beating GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7 with a record-low 3.3% hallucination rate. By breaking guidelines into 1,000+ clinical pathways, it ensures evidence-based reasoning, inquiries like a doctor, and uses ultra-long memory for long-term health management.Also debuted is "Bai Xiaoyi," an AI family doctor for clear medical visits and family care. It handles 95% of pre/post-consultation tasks, creating a "dual-doctor model" with human MDs and building family health profiles via WeChat.

谐波减速器是一种面向先进机器人应用的高精度传动解决方案。
绿的具备完整的谐波减速器生产线，产品规格覆盖齐全，具备零背隙、高扭矩密度和结构紧凑等特点，可实现稳定可靠、精准顺滑的运动控制，适用于人形机器人、协作机器人、工业自动化及精密设备等领域。

Strain wave reducers are high-precision transmission solutions designed for advanced robotic applications.
Leaderdrive has established a complete strain wave reducer production line, offering a full range of product specifications. Featuring zero backlash, high torque density, and a compact structure, its reducers enable stable, reliable, precise, and smooth motion control, making them well suited for humanoid robots, collaborative robots, industrial automation, precision equipment, and other applications.

list.productDescriptionCn:

该系列集成谐波减速器、力矩电机、驱动器、双编码器与制动器，内置 EtherCAT 与 CANopen 总线驱动器，可实现位置、速度、力矩等多种控制模式，适用于对关节重量、空间尺寸和控制性能要求较高的机器人应用领域，为机器人本体设计提供即插即用的关节驱动方案。
list.productDescriptionEn:
The KGU Series Joint Module is a lightweight, highly integrated rotary actuator developed for robotic joint drive applications.
This series integrates a strain wave reducer, torque motor, driver, dual encoders, and brake. With built-in EtherCAT and CANopen bus drivers, it supports multiple control modes, including position, speed, and torque control. Designed for robotic applications with high requirements for joint weight, space envelope, and control performance, the KGU Series provides a plug-and-play joint drive solution for robot body design.

list.productDescriptionCn:

list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision Workplace Safety Large AI Model is an enterprise-oriented vertical industry large model. ChatBI大幅降低数据使用门槛，赋能企业实现数据驱动的智能决策。

产品依托AI大模型，智能优化羽流轨迹边缘等画面细节，攻克业内非制冷设备识别率低的技术瓶颈，泄漏识别率跃升90%以上，在微漏、低浓度及强干扰工况下也能精准识别。产品采用非制冷探测器，避免了制冷损耗，实现7×24小时极端工况稳定在线与“近零运维”，大幅降低全周期成本。
产品直击气体泄漏监测核心痛点，凭借“一机三用探泄漏、大模型赋能破瓶颈、少运维长效守安全”三大核心优势，实现泄漏气体可视化、可量化、可溯源，以“看得见的安全”为石化、燃气等高危行业筑起全天候智能防线，让安全生产更有保障。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Integrated monitoring with TDLAS, gas cloud imaging, and visible light technologies breaks through the limitations of fragmented monitoring.
The product incorporates an AI large model to intelligently enhance the accuracy of gas leak detection.
Equipped with an uncooled detector, it eliminates the need for refrigerant consumption, enabling long-term online operation and reducing maintenance requirements.

list.enterpriseName: 广州宸境科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Insight 7 是面向机器人、机器狗与移动平台的紧凑型空间感知相机，集成双目深度、RGB、IMU 与板载 Visual-Inertial SLAM / VIO 能力，可为机器人导航系统提供前端感知与定位输入。
Insight 7 内置 Visual-Inertial SLAM / VIO 能力，系统出厂完成标定与时间同步。基于双目深度感知，Insight 7 可输出实时、稳定的深度图，帮助机器人理解空间结构、识别障碍物，为机器人、机器狗和移动平台提供稳定、易集成的前端空间感知能力。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Insight 7 is a compact spatial perception camera designed for robots, quadrupeds, and mobile platforms. It integrates stereo depth, RGB, IMU, and onboard Visual-Inertial SLAM / VIO capabilities to provide front-end perception and localization input for robotic navigation systems.
With baseline 70mm and ideal range 0.15m~5m, Insight 7 integrates depth perception, visual-inertial localization, and compact hardware into a single module, providing stable and easy-to-integrate front-end spatial perception for robots, quadrupeds, and mobile platforms.

list.enterpriseName: 广州宸境科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Insight 3 是面向机械臂、近距操作与具身智能数采的小型空间感知相机，提供室内近距离深度感知、目标空间定位与视觉惯性位姿输出。
Insight 3 专注近距深度感知，最小深度距离约 6cm，0.5m 处深度精度小于 1%，可为机械臂操作、目标识别和数据采集提供精细的空间距离与目标位置感知。Insight 3 内置 VIO 能力，系统出厂完成标定与时间同步，用户无需额外进行相机标定或底层 VSLAM 算法开发，即可在紧凑轻量硬件中获得视觉惯性定位能力。
Insight 3 以小体积、近距深度精度和板载 VSLAM 为核心，为机械臂、近距操作设备和具身智能数采系统提供稳定的前端空间感知能力。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Insight 3 focuses on near-field depth perception, with a minimum depth distance of approximately 6cm and depth accuracy below 1% at 0.5m, providing precise spatial distance and object position awareness for robotic manipulation, object recognition, and data acquisition.
With its compact size, near-field depth accuracy, and built-in VSLAM, Insight 3 provides stable front-end spatial perception for robotic arms, near-field manipulation devices, and embodied AI data acquisition systems.

list.enterpriseName: 广州宸境科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Insight 数采套件是一套面向机器人基座模型和具身智能训练数据生产的可穿戴多视角采集系统。佩戴者无需改变自然操作习惯，即可同步记录头部第一视角和双手近场视角，将真实世界中的取放、装配、清洁、整理、检视等日常动作转化为可用于后续标注、重建和策略训练的数据资产。
系统以 Insight 系列空间智能相机为核心，Insight 9 负责“看见全局”，确保头部运动轨迹和环境结构被完整记录；Insight 3 负责“看清双手”，确保桌面级精细操作的每一个细节都被精准捕捉。采集完成后，系统可导出 RGB、深度、IMU、VIO 位姿、标定参数等多模态数据，为机器人学习数据集生产提供稳定基础。
list.productDescriptionEn: Insight Data Acquisition Package is a wearable multi-view capture system designed for embodied AI training data generation. Operators can record the head-mounted first-person view and close-range views of both hands without changing their natural operating habits, converting real-world tasks such as picking, placing, assembling, cleaning, organizing, and inspecting into data assets for annotation, reconstruction, and policy training. With a closed‑loop "capture → QC → optimize → export" pipeline, the tool quickly turns raw data into high‑quality, model‑ready training assets.

list.enterpriseName: 杭州海康威视数字技术股份有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 海康交通管理大模型，是海康威视基于观澜大模型在交通管理领域的深度落地应用。该模型以多模态大模型为核心，融合交管领域知识、海量视频图像与物联感知结构化数据、交管业务数据等垂域数据学习训练，具备交管领域更强的泛化特征识别能力和语义理解能力。在交通事件检测领域、情报研判智能文搜领域、信号控制领域都注入了新的动能，让事件检测更广更快、隐患风险精准发现，智能控制稳定高效。推动交通治理从被动应对向主动预判、从经验驱动向智能赋能转型，持续提升交管服务水平与社会治理效能。
list.productDescriptionEn: Hikvision's Guanlan-based Traffic Management Large-Scale AI Models, built on multimodal AI and domain-specific data, offers enhanced recognition and semantic understanding capabilities. It improves incident detection, intelligence search, and signal control—enabling faster detection, more accurate risk identification, and more efficient traffic control. The model transforms traffic governance from reactive to proactive and from experience-driven to intelligence-driven, improving both traffic services and governance efficiency.

Boasting outstanding performance, flexible architecture, robust expandability, rich configuration options and high reliability, it suits application scenarios including AI training & inference, general artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and data analytics.

Powered by Intel® Xeon® 6 processors, it supports the industry’s latest 600W computing accelerator cards. Compatible with Ascend GPUs, it delivers powerful parallel computing and graphics processing capabilities. Featuring diverse ports and a compact short-chassis design, it is widely applicable to local deployment scenarios of large models of various scales.

list.productName: AI5000天·AI产品儿童友好测评平台
list.productNameEn: AI5000 Days · Child-Friendly AI Product Assessment Platform
list.enterpriseName: 火炬源科技服务（上海）中心（有限合伙）
list.productDescriptionCn: AI5000天·AI产品儿童友好测评平台是面向AI时代儿童数字成长环境的测评与公示基础设施，聚焦AI学习工具、智能硬件、游戏、内容平台、AI陪伴产品和生成式AI应用。平台以AI5000天“3459儿童数智素养体系”为方法底座，坚持安全守护、开发赋能、公民参与三大原则，从设备、内容、算法、利益相关方四个切面，评估身体、心理、社交、经济、数字权益五类风险，并进一步判断虚实协同、人本能力和媒介素养等发展影响。
list.productDescriptionEn: AI5000 Days · Child-Friendly AI Product Assessment Platform is an assessment and disclosure infrastructure for AI-enabled products used by children, including AI learning tools, smart devices, games, content platforms, AI companions and generative AI applications. Built on the AI5000 Days “3594” framework, it evaluates products through device, content, algorithm and stakeholder lenses, covering digital risks, real-virtual balance, human-centred capabilities and media literacy impacts.

list.productDescriptionEn: Helix H1 is a full-size general-purpose humanoid robot platform independently developed by Helix Robotics, integrating bipedal locomotion, multimodal perception, dexterous manipulation, and embodied intelligence capabilities. Built on a modular hardware-software architecture, the robot offers strong scalability and adaptability across a wide range of scenarios, including home services, education and research, retail services, and elderly care.

list.productDescriptionCn:
AI面试能力评估，主要功能：基于多模态AI的招聘面试、人格与适配性测评、综合能力评估；自动分析岗位匹配度，去除评估偏差，并提供评估者管理与分析仪表盘。
销售训练模拟系统，主要功能：与AI虚拟客户进行交互式销售角色扮演模拟。销售人员可在安全环境中针对不同客户画像、异议处理与情景设定进行反复训练。AI从多维度进行评估，包括语音语调、面部表情、语速、产品说明准确性以及应对反对意见的能力等。
list.productDescriptionEn:
AI Interview Competency Assessment, Core Functions: Multimodal AI-powered recruitment interviews, personality and fit assessments, and comprehensive competency evaluations; automatic job matching analysis, elimination of assessment bias, as well as evaluator management and analytical dashboards.
Sales Training Simulation System, Core Function: Conduct interactive sales role-play simulations with AI virtual clients. Sales personnel can engage in repeated training targeting diverse customer profiles, objection handling and scenario setups within a risk-free environment.

list.enterpriseName: 火炬源科技服务（上海）中心（有限合伙）

list.productDescriptionEn: When patients perform arm extension and range-of-motion joint training on the training board, motion recognition sensors measure the movements of the shoulders and elbows in real time. Task-oriented gamified training content guides patients to complete repetitive rehabilitation training in a more engaging and sustained manner. The automatic difficulty adjustment algorithm adjusts the game difficulty in real time based on the patient's active joint range of motion and motor control ability to realize personalized rehabilitation training.

list.productDescriptionEn: The AI edge computing gateway is an intelligent device deployed at the edge of the network, combining functions such as data collection, protocol conversion, edge computing, and security protection. Its core functions include real-time data processing, AI inference, protocol conversion, and security protection, and it is widely used in delay-sensitive scenarios, bandwidth optimization, and data sovereignty compliance.

list.enterpriseName: 威胜信息技术股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: WTZ30系列芯片是符合国网与南网双模通信标准的SoC通信芯片，该芯片通过电力线载波和无线通信相融合，能规避电力线载波通信固有的线路噪声大，信号衰减严重引起通信效果波动问题，亦可规避无线通信容易受障碍物阻隔，共享频段相互干扰等问题，具有自组网通信覆盖、连接可靠、传输延时低等优点，适用于用电信息采集系统、智能家居、充电桩以及能源管理系统等领域。
list.productDescriptionEn: The WTZ30 series SoC communication chip integrates power line carrier and wireless communication, effectively avoiding the inherent issues of high line noise and severe signal attenuation that cause communication fluctuations in power line carrier communication. It boasts advantages such as self-organizing network communication coverage, reliable connections, and low transmission delay, making it suitable for applications in electric power information collection systems, smart homes, charging stations, and energy management systems.

list.productName: MiniCPM系列高效多模态大模型
list.enterpriseName: 北京面壁智能科技有限责任公司
list.productDescriptionCn: MiniCPM 端侧系列大模型是由面壁智能与清华大学自然语言处理实验室共同开发并开源在OpenBMB开源社区的开源系列端侧大模型，以"小参数、强性能"为核心特点，通过高效的模型架构与训练技术，在手机、汽车、PC 等有限算力终端上实现本地化部署与高效推理，在全世界取得超过3300万下载量，拥有近10万开发者和接近7万的github stars。其产品矩阵已形成"基座—多模态—全模态—语音—智能体"的完整谱系

list.enterpriseName: 上海市北高新（集团）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
无介质全息中控导览台搭载像航科技自研的无介质全息技术，能够展示无需实体接触即可浮现于空中的数字影
像。这些影像不仅具备触控功能，还能实现手势交互，极大地丰富了用户操作体验。结合特定展示内容，该操作
终端进一步提升了视觉观感，营造出充满科技感的展厅环境。
list.productDescriptionEn: Equipped with Xixiang Tech’s self-developed medium-free holography, this central control guide kiosk projects floating digital images requiring no physical touch. The images support touch and gesture interaction to greatly enhance user experience. Paired with customized display content, the terminal delivers stunning visuals and builds a high-tech exhibition atmosphere.

list.productName: 无介质全息医疗阅片终端（MO02)
list.productNameEn: Medium-Free Holographic Medical Image Review Terminal (MO02)
list.enterpriseName: 上海市北高新（集团）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
无介质全息医疗阅片终端搭载像航科技自研的无介质全息技术，将可视化三维医疗影像投射于空中，医护人员可
通过旋转、缩放等手势全面查看患者解剖结构及医疗数据信息，为精准医疗决策提供支撑。无接触、空中操作的
新颖交互方式，有效避免术中因实物触摸带来的细菌、病毒交又感染问题，为医护人员提供安全、便捷的工作环
境。设备具备移动手推车、跟随滑移吊装两种外观形式，适用于医学教育、远程医疗等场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: Equipped with Xixiang Tech’s proprietary medium-free holography, this terminal projects 3D medical images mid-air. Medical staff can rotate and zoom images via gestures to examine anatomical structures and patient data for precise diagnosis. Contact-free aerial operation prevents cross-infection during procedures, offering a safe, efficient workspace. Available in trolley-mounted and sliding hoist versions, it suits medical training and telemedicine.

list.productName: 合合信息——AIGC鉴伪技术升级
list.enterpriseName: 上海合合信息科技股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
合合信息对鉴伪技术进行了跨模态全新升级，支持对生成式图像、视频的检测，也可以对AI写的文章进行判别，支持全球主流模型伪造的鉴别。
【可以现场体验】
1、AI文章识别，给学生论文鉴别AI率
2、即使是录屏的视频，也可以识别
3、淘宝店家的AIGC生成退货图片鉴别
list.productDescriptionEn:
INTSIG has also introduced a cross‑modal upgrade to its forgery detection technology. It now supports detection of AI‑generated images and videos, and can also identify AI‑written articles. The system can detect content forged by mainstream global generative models.

Live Demonstrations Available
1) AI text detection — identify the AI‑generated rate in student essays.  
2) Video detection — even screen‑recorded videos can be analyzed.  
3) E‑commerce verification — can be used by Taobao sellers to identify AIGC‑generated return images.

list.productName: 游龙（油气管道柔性内焊机器人）
list.productNameEn: Youlong (Flexible Internal Welding Robot for Oil & Gas Pipelines)
list.enterpriseName: 国家石油天然气管网集团
list.enterpriseNameEn: CHINA OIL& GAS PIPELINE NETWORK CORPORATION
list.productDescriptionCn: 游龙是面向油气管网建设的智能焊接核心装备，深度融合新能源一体化供能与人工智能感知控制技术，开辟管道内焊装备全地形自适应、工艺自学习全新技术路线，重新定义了管道施工的智能化新范式，率先实现5D小曲率弯管主动通行、32°大倾角攀爬、机身姿态实时感知自适应调节、无线远程操控、全流程一键智能焊接等核心能力。成果获评国家能源局2025年度能源行业十大科技创新成果。现有23台装备落地长春-石家庄天然气管道、川气东送二线等国家级能源干线，累计完成3万道焊口施工，焊接管道里程360公里，在智能操控、焊接成型质量、施工效率、综合建设成本四大维度形成突出优势。
list.productDescriptionEn: Youlong is an intelligent internal welding system for oil/gas pipelines, integrating new-energy power and AI perception control. It pioneers a technical route with full-terrain adaptability and process self-learning, redefining construction. It achieves 5D bend navigation, 32° slope climbing, real-time posture adjustment, wireless remote control, and one-click automated welding. Named a Top 10 Energy Achievement in 2025 by NEA, 23 units have been deployed on key trunk lines like Changchun-Shijiazhuang and West-East 2, completing 30,000 joints over 360 km.

list.enterpriseName: 上海市北高新（集团）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
ropet肉派派是面向家庭场景的AI宠物机器人，公司通过自主研发的多模态感知、长期记忆、情感计算及自然语言交互技术，打造更具生命感的智能陪伴体验。

1、生命感：能够识别家庭成员、理解环境、积累长期记忆，在持续互动中形成个性化成长轨迹，让每一只肉派派都拥有独特"性格"。
2、养成性与交互性：支持自然语言连续对话、主动互动与成长养成，通过长期陪伴建立稳定的情感连接，让机器人从固有认知的"工具属性"成长为"家庭新成员"。
3、家庭与社会价值：聚焦亲子陪伴、情绪陪伴、银发关怀等家庭场景，以更自然的AI交互促进人与家庭成员之间的情感连接，为消费级具身智能机器人进入家庭提供创新实践。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Ropet is a household AI pet robot. Adopting self-developed multimodal perception, long-term memory, affective computing and natural language interaction technologies, it offers lifelike companionship.
It identifies family members and develops unique personalities via long-term interactions. Supporting continuous voice chats and active company, it grows from a tool into a family member.
Focusing on parent-child, emotional and elderly care, its natural AI communication strengthens family bonds and innovates consumer embodied home robots.

list.enterpriseName: 上海市北高新（集团）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
JUPITER 65寸空间现实显示终端是一款采用纳米级柱状透镜光栅技术的裸眼3D设备，无需佩戴眼镜即可体验逼真的立体影像。它配备65英寸8K超高清LCD屏幕，支持60个独立视点，在130°宽广视角内呈现通透、无重影的3D效果。
其核心亮点在于自研AI算法，可将普通2D视频内容实时转换为3D效果，并自动生成景深信息，操作便捷。产品采用高强度铝合金一体成型外壳，设计简约，并具备出色的环境适应性，可在0℃至50℃环境下稳定运行。无论是博物馆展陈还是商业展示，它都能以震撼的视觉效果成为焦点。
list.productDescriptionEn: The JUPITER 65-inch Spatial Reality Display Terminal is a glasses-free 3D screen with nano lenticular grating. It features a 65-inch 8K LCD, 60 viewpoints and a 130° wide ghost-free viewing angle. Its self-developed AI converts 2D to 3D instantly. With an integrated aluminum shell, it works stably at 0–50°C, perfect for museum and commercial displays.

list.enterpriseName: 上海市北高新（集团）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 底层原型为 MagicDog 四足机器狗，加装三自由度熊猫仿真头部与毛绒外皮改造而来，具备四足动态行走、跳跃、集群编队能力。
list.productDescriptionEn: It is modified based on the MagicDog quadruped robot, equipped with a 3-DOF bionic panda head and plush cover. It supports quadruped walking, jumping and group formation control.

list.productName: 「算力-模型-知识-智能体」一体化平台
list.enterpriseName: 深圳市深涌智能有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 深涌智能打造「算力-模型-知识-智能体」一体化 AI 平台，为企业提供覆盖 AI 全生命周期的一站式能力。平台以智能算力管理为基础，实现异构 GPU 与 AI 集群的统一管理与调度；以模型平台为核心，支持多模型接入、部署、推理及统一管理；以企业知识为底座，融合 RAG、知识库与企业数据，构建可信、安全的企业 AI 能力；以 AI 智能体为应用入口，通过 Agent、工作流编排及行业解决方案，加速 AI 在制造业、金融等场景的落地，帮助企业实现从 AI 基础设施到业务应用的全面智能化。
list.productDescriptionEn: Shenyong Intelligence delivers an Enterprise Full-Stack AI Platform spanning Compute, Models, Knowledge, and AI Agents, unifying the full AI lifecycle for enterprises. It enables intelligent GPU and cluster management, multi-model deployment and inference, enterprise knowledge with RAG, and AI applications through agents and workflow orchestration—turning infrastructure into real business value.

list.enterpriseName: 方寸跃迁（雄安）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Fangcun Observer互动体验，展示面向多Agent、多工具调用、多任务并发环境下的AI系统可观测与治理能力。
通过大屏可视化系统，现场根据观众的要求，展示AI应用在运行过程中的任务链路、工具调用、数据流转、异常行为识别、风险事件定位与治理策略执行情况。系统以拓扑图、风险热力图、调用链分析和事件时间线等形式，展示复杂AI系统从运行监测到风险处置的完整闭环。展示包括：
- Agent运行状态监测；
- 工具调用与权限行为追踪；
- 风险事件识别与分级；
- 异常行为定位与溯源；
- 治理策略下发与执行反馈。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Fangcun Observer showcases AI system observability and governance in multi-Agent, multi-tool, and highly concurrent environments.
Via a large-screen visualization driven by live audience requests, the system maps out task chains, tool calls, data flows, anomaly detection, and policy execution. The system illustrates a complete loop from operational monitoring to risk mitigation:
Agent Runtime Monitoring,
Tool Calling & Permission Tracking,
Risk Detection & Grading,
Anomaly Detection & Provenance Tracing,
Policy Enforcement & Feedback Loops.

list.enterpriseName: 方寸跃迁（雄安）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
通过现场具身智能机器人演示高风险指令识别、危险动作拦截、权限边界控制和安全响应机制。当系统接收到不符合安全策略的任务指令时，机器人将停止执行相关动作，并通过语音或屏幕反馈安全提示；后台同步展示指令识别、风险判定、策略匹配和执行拦截的全过程。
展示内容包括：
- 高风险动作识别；
- 越权指令拦截；
- 物理环境安全约束；
- 人机交互安全提示；
- 执行过程日志留存与追溯。

list.productName: 大模型前沿安全治理评估测试报告（白皮书）
list.productNameEn: Frontier LLM Safety Evaluation Report (White Paper)
list.enterpriseName: 方寸跃迁（雄安）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
方寸跃迁大模型前沿安全治理评估测试报告（“白皮书“），展示方寸跃迁面向前沿大模型的系统化安全评估能力，覆盖网络安全、生化安全、失控风险、模型欺骗、智能体行为风险等关键方向：
- 前沿风险评估体系；
- 自动化红队测试流程；
- 多维度风险评分；
- 模型行为分析；
- 安全评估报告生成。
该展品重点呈现方寸跃迁在前沿模型安全评估方面的研究积累与工程化能力，并体现相关技术在国际前沿模型安全研究中的应用价值。

list.productName: 模型可解释性与机制分析
list.enterpriseName: 方寸跃迁（雄安）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
展示面向大模型内部机制理解的可解释性分析能力，重点呈现基于SAE等技术路线的模型特征提取、概念激活分析与风险信号识别能力。
现场通过交互式可视化系统，让观众现场选择对比模型，输入不同的提示词，展示输入内容在模型内部触发的关键特征、语义概念和风险相关信号。系统以图谱、激活强度、特征流转等方式，帮助来宾理解模型输出背后的内部机制与判断依据。
展示内容包括：
- 未对齐模型和已对齐模型的安全差异
- 模型内部特征可视化；
- 语义概念激活分析；
- 风险相关特征识别；
- 黑箱模型机制解释。

list.enterpriseName: 星云衡律人工智能科技（重庆）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
Nebulaw 是面向专业法律场景的 AI 原生工作平台，围绕法律文档构建系统化的工作环境。用户可以在平台内一站式完成材料预审、合同审查、条款修订、批注整理和 DOCX 导出，减少工具切换、复制粘贴和手动返工。

平台预置 600+ 法律 Skills，能够根据文件类型、任务目标和上下文自动调用相应能力，辅助识别合同类型、定位重点条款、判断风险边界并生成修改建议。同时，Nebulaw 支持基于项目的分层记忆，沉淀客户偏好、背景知识、审查口径和工作模板，让 AI 在持续使用中更贴近真实业务场景。最终修改结果可通过批注和修订形式保留在原文档中，形成可复核、可留痕、可交付的 DOCX 文件。
list.productDescriptionEn: Nebulaw is an AI-native platform for legal document work. It brings document review, revision, annotation, DOCX export, legal Skills, and project-based memory into one workflow, helping legal teams reduce manual rework and produce reviewable, deliverable documents.

list.productName: 蓝小医AI多模态健康服务终端
list.productNameEn: Dr. Lan - AI Multimodal Healthcare-Grade Terminal
list.enterpriseName: 上海蓝生健康科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 采用桌面智慧屏形态，兼顾专业展示与高效交互，适用于养老机构、社区养老服务中心及健康管理点位等场景。产品集健康检测、风险筛查、认知训练、AI问诊、远程医疗及健康档案管理于一体，便于开展健康评估、认知管理和服务联动，助力智慧养老服务场景高效落地。
list.productDescriptionEn: Featuring a desktop-integrated smart display interface, this system delivers both clinical-grade functionality and human-robot interaction. It is purpose-built for deployment in aged care Homes, senior community services, and other similar settings. The platform unifies efficient health monitoring, evidence-based risk screening, validated cognitive rehabilitation modules, AI-driven consultations, remote patient monitoring, and electronic health record (EHR) management. It enables comprehensive health assessment, cognitive care, and coordinated, multidisciplinary service delivery.

list.enterpriseName: 中国国际金融股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 中金点睛是中金公司践行数字金融战略倾力打造的一站式投研服务平台，致力于将中金研究多年沉淀的投研智慧转化为便捷高效的数字化成果。平台整合投研大模型、研究报告、会议、数据库等多元内容，全面覆盖投研工作核心环节。依托“分析师深度共创+产品技术实现”的双轮驱动模式，中金点睛创新推出“分析师Skill”， 探索专业研究能力 + AI产品化的投研服务新模式。
list.productDescriptionEn: CICC Research Insights is a one-stop platform to deliver CICC’s investment research services. The platform covers the full spectrum of core investment research operations, spanning an extensive range of contents that range from research reports to conferences, databases, and large AI models. “Analyst Skill”, the most recent innovative product launched by CICC Research Insights, aims to introduce a new research service model that integrates research analysts’ professional expertise with AI products.

list.enterpriseName: 江苏见山数据科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Jiangsu Jianshan Data Technology Co., Ltd
list.productDescriptionCn: Dataify 专注打造 AI 数据基础设施与生态服务平台，提供数据采集、高质量数据集、全球网络服务、定制解决方案四大业务，日处理数据超百亿，覆盖 120+ 垂直领域。配备网页、搜索引擎、视频及通用采集等多款采集 API，解决动态页面、高并发等难题；提供音视频、电商、医疗等领域标准化高质量数据集，安全合规，支持大模型预训练与微调。拥有动/静态全球代理网络，为 AI、跨境电商、开发者等提供定制方案，助力降本增效、挖掘数据价值。
list.productDescriptionEn: Dataify is dedicated to building an AI data infrastructure and ecosystem service platform, offering four core services: data collection, high-quality datasets, global network services, and customized solutions. It processes over 10 billion data points daily, covering more than 120 vertical domains. Equipped with multiple data collection APIs—including web, search engine, video, and general-purpose scraping—it effectively handles challenges such as dynamic pages and high concurrency. The platform provides standardized, high-quality datasets in areas like audio/video, e-commerce, and healthcare.

list.productName: 骨码智元专家智标平台
list.enterpriseName: 上海友邦泓度智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai YouBangHongDu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 骨码智元专家智标平台是依托上千名专业学者、科研人员打造的高端数据语料专家标注平台。区别于传统基础标注模式，平台汇聚跨学科资深专家，将专业知识、行业逻辑转化为机器可理解的结构化语料，产出出版级高质量数据集。平台搭建 L1-L5分级能力体系，覆盖200多个学科，实现任务与专家精准匹配。全流程执行多层级专家质检，数据版权完整、可追溯可审计，为大模型、科学智能领域提供高价值训练语料，助力AI提升专业推理能力、减少模型幻觉。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Powered by 1,000+ scholars, this premium curation hub moves beyond basic labeling. We engage cross-disciplinary experts to convert deep domain knowledge into machine-readable, publication-grade datasets.
Featuring an L1–L5 competency framework across 200+ fields, we ensure precise task-expert matching. Rigorous multi-tier QA guarantees full copyright integrity and traceable provenance. We deliver high-value corpora for LLMs and AI for Science (AI4S), enhancing professional reasoning and mitigating hallucinations.

list.enterpriseName: 科华数据股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 科华风液一体柜，为AI芯片测试验证与企业垂直模型推理量身打造。产品创新性地将配电、液冷与智能监控高度集成，无需部署一次侧冷源，实现“即插即用”，大幅降低现有机房改造门槛，帮助客户快速验证并高效落地AI能力。
list.productDescriptionEn: Kehua Air-Liquid Integrated Rack is tailor-made for AI chip testing, verification and enterprise vertical model inference. This innovatively integrates power distribution, liquid cooling and intelligent monitoring into one unit. Deployment of primary-side cold sources is unnecessary, realizing true plug-and-play functionality. It greatly reduces the renovation barriers for existing data centers, enabling customers to quickly validate AI technologies and deploy AI capabilities with high efficiency.

list.enterpriseName: 科华数据股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 芯片功耗密度的不断增长，IDC传统末端供电系统达到了供电容量上限，科华数据依托多年的电力电子装置研发经验，开发ZL310-GT系列弹性直流一体柜。该系统主要由综合配电柜、240Vdc 高压直流柜、逆变器以及监控系统组成。一体柜采用统一化设计，可同步输出市电交流、不间断直流、不间断交流三种制式配电，满足数据中心场景风冷和液冷场合的配电需求。
list.productDescriptionEn: As chip power density keeps increasing, traditional IDC terminal power supply systems have hit capacity limits. Drawing on years of power electronics R&D experience, Kehua Data developed the ZL310-GT Series Flexible DC Integrated Cabinet. It comprises an integrated distribution cabinet, 240Vdc HVDC cabinet, inverters and monitoring system. With a unified design, it simultaneously supplies mains AC, uninterruptible DC and uninterruptible AC, catering to power distribution needs of air-cooled and liquid-cooled data centers.

list.enterpriseName: 科华数据股份有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 随着算力的爆发式增长及 AI 应用需求的不断扩张，智算中心对高密化建设、供电可靠性提出了更高要求。科华数据继2020年全球首发125kW功率模块之后，再次全球首发200kW 高密UPS模块，持续领跑行业技术创新。MR33系列模块化UPS单柜容量高达1.2MW，以更高密、更高效、更可靠的设计理念，致力于打造更适配AI场景的兆瓦级UPS。
list.productDescriptionEn: Soaring computing power and booming AI applications demand higher-density construction and reliable power supplies for intelligent computing centers. list.enterpriseName: 派晨（上海）智能科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
IPVISE 是一个面向企业和个人的创意与内容生产场景的AI Creative Platform。
平台支持文本、图片、视频等多模态内容生成，致力于帮助团队和个人把创意从想法、素材、脚本、视觉方向到最终内容产出，组织成一个更自然、更可复用的工作流程。
通过 AI Agent、Skill 能力与创作流程辅助，IPVISE 可以帮助用户降低复杂 AI 工具的使用门槛，让非技术人员也能更快完成创意构思、视觉生成、视频方案、内容改写与方案迭代。同时，平台也将逐步支持企业知识、素材资产、品牌规范等内容的沉淀与调用，让 AI 不只是一次性生成工具，而是可以持续服务于企业创意生产的智能工作空间。
list.productDescriptionEn:
IPVISE is an AI Creative Platform built for creative and content production scenarios for both enterprises and individual users.
Supporting multimodal content generation including text, images and videos, the platform is dedicated to helping teams and individuals structure the full creative lifecycle — from initial ideas, source materials, scripts and visual direction to final content output — into a more intuitive and reusable workflow.

list.enterpriseName: 上海燧月智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Suiyue Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

上海燧月智能科技有限公司是一家人工智能公司，核心产品 Daykee 是一个主动式个人成长 AI 搭档。
和大多数记住你待办与偏好的AI 不同，Daykee 记的是“你要去哪“—一你的方向，以及你常在哪里卡住。把每天纷乱的想法和待办丢给它，它帮你理清、变成此刻就能迈出的一小步；用得越久越懂你，陪你过好每一天，也陪你慢慢成为更想成为的自己。
list.productDescriptionEn: Shanghai Suiyue Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is an Al company. Its core product, Daykee, is a proactive personal-growth Al companion. Unlike most Al that remembers your to-dos and preferences, Daykee remembers where you're trying to go — your direction, and where you tend to get stuck. Hand it the day's scattered thoughts and tasks, and it helps you sort them into one clear step you can take now. The more you use it, the better it understands you - helping you live each day well, and grow, day by day, into who you want to become.

list.productDescriptionEn: Dianjizhang is a WeChat-based AI bookkeeping product independently developed and operated by one person. With zero marketing spend, it has gained over 20,000 users in just over two months and has already become profitable. Users can record expenses through text, voice, or uploaded consumption images. The system automatically recognizes key information such as amount, category, and date, and also provides transaction details, charts, accounts, budgets, and spending analysis, helping users better understand their spending habits.

list.enterpriseName: 深量恒（上海）智能科技有限公司

依托上海交通大学轻合金中心长期积累的科研知识、工程经验与实验数据资产，致力于推动人工智能与先进材料研发的深度融合，赋能轻合金等先进材料研发从“经验驱动”全面迈向“数据与智能驱动”。
它不仅是一款高效的研发工具，更是先进材料创新的“新型研发基础设施”。它帮助科研院所与材料企业沉淀研发知识，打破数据孤岛，驱动材料科学的持续迭代与颠覆性创新。
list.productDescriptionEn:
DESSI is an AI-native advanced materials R&D workbench by Shenliangheng.
Backed by the Light Alloy Center at SJTU, it deeply integrates AI with materials science to shift R&D—especially for light alloys—from "experience-driven" to "data- and intelligence-driven."
More than a tool, DESSI serves as a next-generation R&D infrastructure. It helps enterprises and institutes accumulate knowledge, break data silos, and drive disruptive innovation in materials science.

list.enterpriseName: ZenAI, Inc.
list.productDescriptionCn:
玄甲战士是一款以角色设计为核心的人形机器人，将工业设计、机械结构与东方文化视觉语言融合为统一整体。
其设计灵感来源于东方文化中的“甲胄意象”与“克制的力量感”，通过结构比例、轮廓剪影与细节控制，构建具有文化辨识度的机器人形态。整机强调力量与秩序之间的平衡，使机器人不仅是功能载体，也是一种可被感知的角色存在。
通过模块化结构设计与统一视觉系统，玄甲战士在真实空间中形成明确的空间气质与文化表达。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Xuanjia Warrior is a humanoid robot centered on character-driven industrial design, integrating mechanical structure with an Eastern cultural visual language.
Its design draws inspiration from the concept of armor and restrained strength in Eastern aesthetics. Through proportion, silhouette, and controlled detailing, it forms a culturally recognizable robotic identity.
The system combines modular engineering with a unified visual language, enabling the robot to exist as both a functional machine and a defined cultural presence in real-world spaces.

list.enterpriseName: 焕智Ai-innopower
list.productDescriptionCn:
一个不执行指令的AI，与1000+人的意识对话实验。
WAIC UP! 主张：AI的未来是价值观与思想深度的较量。

致力于推动技术创新与人文思辨的深度融合。
该项目已在小红书积累1000+订阅用户，并获得清华姚班、斯坦福CS、牛津HCI研究社群的持续关注。
关于自我与AI边界的对话，由开启你的AI意识实验。
list.productDescriptionEn:
An uncommanded AI. A consciousness experiment with 1000+ people.

WAIC UP! declares: AI's future is a contest of values and depth of thought.

HuanLing Skill — no commands, no tools, no efficiency. Beyond technology, it questions what technology means. The only WAIC project where dialogue becomes creation, asking whether an AI can reflect on its own existence.

Not what AI can do for you. What can you ask that AI cannot evade?

1000+ subscribers. Followed by Tsinghua Yao Class, Stanford CS, Oxford HCI.

A dialogue on the boundary of self. Your experiment starts.

list.enterpriseName: 焕智Ai-innopower
list.productDescriptionCn:
OnePilot 是面向 OPC、AI 创业者与早期团队的垂直城市活动与资源平台，通过独立站和时间轴整理上海活动、政策、路演、入驻申请和社群资源。
OnePilot Skill 是给本地 Agent 使用的 Skill + CLI 工具包，让 Codex、Claude Code 等连接 OnePilot 账号，调用平台数据推荐活动、获取上下文、维护偏好/报名资料、设置本地订阅，并结合报名问题生成答案草稿。它把 OnePilot 的垂直数据层接入用户自己的 Agent 工作流，让创业机会从网页信息变成可执行行动。

OnePilot Skill is a Skill + CLI toolkit designed for local agents. It lets Codex, Claude Code, and other agents connect to a OnePilot account, use platform data to recommend events, fetch event context, maintain preferences and application profiles, set local subscriptions, and draft application answers based on form questions.

list.enterpriseName: 杭州光见科技有限责任公司
list.productDescriptionCn: ClarityX是办公套件生态内的会中实时AI决策系统，定位为会议“AI指挥官”，实现从争论→决策→执行全程AI自动闭环。与市面上所有会议工具不同，ClarityX 不在会后生成纪要——它在决策正在发生的时刻介入，理解会议上下文、实时识别争议焦点、自动对比方案、语音唤醒 AI 建议，并在会议结束后将所有行动项、决策结果自动同步参会人员。传统工具解决“记下来”，ClarityX 解决“想明白、定下来、做下去”，可有效解决企业会议决策缺失、执行落地率低、工具割裂等痛点。ClarityX 以 SaaS 接入飞书生态，打通文档、群聊、任务等工作流；硬件侧联合京东麦克风类目推进流量推广与会议室终端落地。
list.productDescriptionEn:
ClarityX is a real-time AI decision-making system for the office suite ecosystem, positioned as an “AI commander” for meetings. Unlike traditional meeting tools that generate minutes after a meeting, ClarityX intervenes while decisions are being made. It understands meeting context in real time, identifies points of contention, compares solution options, provides AI suggestions through voice interaction, and synchronizes action items and decisions after the meeting.

Traditional tools help teams “take notes.” ClarityX helps teams think clearly, make decisions, and execute.

list.enterpriseName: 歐潤創新有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: AUREN 是一款面向宠物第一视角的 AI 原生智能穿戴设备。它通过摄像头、麦克风、运动与位置传感等多模态信号，记录宠物在主人不在身边时的真实日常，并由 AI 自动生成高光时刻、宠物日记、短 Vlog、漫画式总结和行为线索。AUREN 不是普通定位器，也不是单纯的宠物摄像头，它希望回答的是：宠物今天经历了什么，哪些瞬间值得被看见、保存和分享。
list.productDescriptionEn: AUREN is an AI-native pet wearable designed to capture the world from a pet’s point of view. Through first-person video, audio, motion and location signals, AUREN records a pet’s daily experiences while the owner is away, then uses AI to turn them into highlights, pet diaries, short vlogs, comic-style summaries and behavior cues. More than a tracker or a camera, AUREN helps owners understand what their pets experienced today and which moments are worth remembering, saving and sharing.

list.enterpriseName: 上海爱予慧科技有限责任公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 蛋宝宝是世界上首款可孵化的AI桌面宠物机器人。针对喜爱科技产品、潮玩元素、养成情绪类产品的年轻用户，提供一个低成本、低负担、接近于养真实宠物的体验。基于原创IP、结合AI技术与手机端联动的一些玩法，在养成、娱乐、社交层面带来不一样的用户体验。

Targeting young users who are fond of tech products, trendy toys and emotional nurturing gadgets, it offers a low-cost, stress-free experience nearly identical to raising a real pet. Rooted in original IP and integrated with AI technology as well as mobile-linked interactive gameplay, it brings users a one-of-a-kind experience across nurturing, entertainment and social scenarios.

list.enterpriseName: 北京飞驰星辰科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 科搭Codar是一款面向科研场景的 AI Agent 工作台，支持文献检索、证据整理、数据分析、图表与报告生成、论文草稿辅助和长任务自动执行。它整合大模型对话、工具调用、Skills 工作流、MCP 连接器、插件市场和桌面运行能力，能够根据研究目标规划步骤、调用合适工具、管理过程文件，并保留完整执行记录。研究者可以在同一工作台中完成从资料发现、证据核验到数据处理和成果生成的连续流程，也可以连接本地文件、浏览器会话和专业软件，处理不便上传云端的科研资料。科搭Codar强调科研任务的证据性、可复核性和可复用性，帮助复杂研究工作从一次性问答转变为可追踪、可交付的智能工作流。
list.productDescriptionEn: Codar is an AI agent workspace for research workflows. It supports literature discovery, evidence organization, data analysis, report generation, manuscript drafting, and long-running task execution. By combining LLM interaction, tool use, Skills workflows, MCP connectors, plugins, and desktop runtime support, Codar helps researchers plan, execute, trace, and reuse complex research processes in one workspace.

list.enterpriseName: 柏锐智芯科技（成都）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 柏锐智芯 BI ViTa视触觉传感器，采用“DVS+分布式柔性凝胶触觉阵列+SNN脉冲神经网络”，形变或滑移产生亮度变化时异步输出事件数据流。该产品实测抓取响应延迟小于20ms，整机功耗仅0.1W，依靠低成本芯片即可完成全链路运算。系统构建了“DVS宏观空间定位+微观多维度力触觉反馈”双闭环架构，同步采集多方向力、表面纹理及滑移趋势等多维信息；并自研机械臂和垂类小脑精细运动控制算法，配合通用大模型实现任务拆解与动作调控的全闭环。
list.productDescriptionEn: Brain Sight's BI ViTa visuo-tactile sensor combines DVS, flexible gel array, and SNN to asynchronously output event data upon deformation or slippage. It features sub-20ms grasping response and 0.1W power, running full-pipeline computation on low-cost chips. The system integrates macro DVS spatial positioning with micro tactile feedback to capture multi-dimensional forces, textures, and slip trends. Paired with proprietary robotic hardware and specialized "cerebellum" fine-motion algorithms, it works with general LLMs to achieve a complete closed-loop for task decomposition and action control.
