TideFlow基于用户的睡眠状态、行为习惯与实时反馈，持续判断用户当前最主要的睡眠问题，并动态生成当下最适合的睡眠改善路径，包括但不限于内容、行为、任务等。 通过持续学习用户状态变化，顺应大脑的喜好，让睡眠改善从一次性干预变成持续优化的个性化路径。TideFlow 不是帮助用户“睡着”，而是通过 AI 持续计算大脑从清醒到睡眠的最优迁移路径。
list.productDescriptionEn:
AI Sleep Decision Engine

TideFlow continuously analyzes each user’s sleep state, behavioral patterns, and real-time feedback to identify their most critical sleep challenge at any given moment.

Based on this, our AI dynamically creates the most effective sleep improvement pathway — combining personalized actions, behavioral guidance, and adaptive sleep support.

As the system learns and adapts to changes over time, sleep improvement becomes an ongoing personalized process rather than a one-time intervention.

We don’t make people sleep.
We help the brain learn how to sleep naturally.

list.enterpriseName: CORVIA AI
list.productDescriptionCn:
Corvia AI 倾力打造的全自动市场营销 Agents，全面接管从线索挖掘到商机转化的业务全链路。
1.潜客挖掘 (LeadGen) Agent： 自然语言对话，Agent 即可在全球海量数据中穿透目标行业，精准定位高价值客户画像，自动提取并清洗关键线索信息。
2. 邮件营销 (Outreach) Agent： Agent 能够基于目标客户背景，自动撰写千人千面、符合高管阅读习惯的专业邮件，并动态优化发送策略以提升转化率。
3. 邮件分析 (Email Analysis) Agent：能自动完成海量邮件的分类、待办，并基于历史沟通语境自动生成高质量的回复草稿，与业务系统打通。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Corvia AI's Automated Marketing Agents manage your entire pipeline from prospecting to conversion:
LeadGen Agent: Uses natural language to instantly identify, extract, and clean high-value global leads.
Outreach Agent: Autonomously drafts hyper-personalized emails and optimizes sending strategies to boost conversions.
Email Analysis Agent: Auto-classifies incoming emails, creates to-dos, and drafts context-aware replies while seamlessly integrating with your systems.

list.productNameEn: PepiX™, The AI Path to Peptide Medicine
list.enterpriseName: PepiX™-AI大环肽药物研发
list.enterpriseNameEn: PepiX™, The AI Path to Peptide Medicine
list.productDescriptionCn:
PepiX™是晶泰创新中心孵化的AI驱动的多肽药物研发平台，整合了精准 AI 分子设计、高通量湿实验筛选与自动化合成三大核心能力，构建起 “干实验设计 + 湿实验验证” 的高效研发闭环，并依托独有的非天然氨基酸（NCAA）库，显著缩短研发周期，并可快速获得 pM 级高亲和力与高稳定性的环肽分子，大幅提升多肽药物的研发成功率与成药性。
目前，基于 PepiX™ 平台的技术优势，已在多肽药物领域重点布局多个自研与合作项目，涵盖脑部/眼部递送肽、口服多肽、放射性核素偶联药物（RDC）环肽载体等前沿领域。
list.productDescriptionEn: PepiX™ is an AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform incubated by XtalPi Innovation Center. Integrating precise AI molecular design, high-throughput wet-lab screening, and automated synthesis, it enables an efficient “in silico + experimental” closed loop. Powered by a proprietary NCAA library, PepiX™ significantly shortens discovery timelines and rapidly delivers cyclic peptides with pM-level affinity and high stability. Its pipeline spans CNS/ocular delivery peptides, oral peptides, and RDC cyclic peptide carriers.

list.enterpriseName: 寻村
list.productDescriptionCn: 寻村是一款面向县域文旅和乡村旅行场景的 AI 产品。用户被小红书、抖音等内容种草后，可以通过寻村快速判断一个村子值不值得去、什么时候去更合适、哪里最出片、到现场该怎么玩。产品结合地点信息、天气、真实图片与路线推荐，帮助游客完成从“想去”到“会玩”的决策与导览。
list.productDescriptionEn: VillageSeek is an AI-powered travel product for rural and county-level tourism. After users discover a village or destination on social media, VillageSeek helps them decide whether it is worth visiting, when to go, where to take the best photos, and how to explore on site. By combining location data, weather, real images, and route recommendations, it turns travel inspiration into practical trip decisions and guided experiences.

list.enterpriseName: Sonicite
list.productDescriptionCn:
Sonicite Flow 是一款面向 DJ、音乐策展人与音乐创作者的 AI 工作流助手。

面对不断增长的曲库与日益复杂的创作需求，Flow 通过音乐理解、智能搜索、相似歌曲发现、曲库管理与场景化编排能力，帮助用户更高效地发现、组织与连接音乐。系统能够理解音乐的结构、情绪、能量、调性与混音兼容性，为选曲、编排和演出准备提供决策支持。

从找歌到整理曲库，从构建能量曲线到设计完整的音乐旅程，Flow 帮助创作者把更多时间留给创意与表达，而不是重复劳动。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Sonicite Flow is an AI workflow assistant for DJs, music curators, and music creators.

Flow helps users discover, organize, and connect music through intelligent search, music understanding, similarity discovery, library management, and scenario-based set building. By analyzing musical structure, emotion, energy, key compatibility, and mixability, it supports better decisions throughout the creative process.

From music discovery and library organization to sequencing and performance preparation, Flow helps creators spend less time managing music and more time shaping meaningful experiences.

list.enterpriseName: Sonicite
list.productDescriptionCn:
Sonicite Atmos 是一套面向品牌、商业空间与线下体验场景的 AI 声音体验系统。

品牌早已系统化管理视觉、空间与气味，而声音仍长期停留在人工歌单与静态播放阶段。Atmos 通过声音蓝图生成、智能编排与动态调控能力，帮助品牌构建具有一致性与辨识度的声音体验，让声音能够随着时间、场景与人群变化持续演化。

从咖啡馆、酒店、零售空间到品牌活动与文化场所，Atmos 让声音从背景音乐进化为可设计、可管理、可优化的品牌资产，帮助空间建立更深层次的情绪连接与体验价值。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Sonicite Atmos is an AI-powered sound experience system for brands, commercial spaces, and physical world experiences.

Through sound blueprint generation, intelligent orchestration, and adaptive controls, Atmos helps brands create distinctive sonic environments that evolve with changing contexts, audiences, and moments.

From retail and hospitality to cultural venues and brand activations, Atmos transforms sound from background music into a manageable and measurable brand asset.

list.enterpriseName: Sonicite
list.productDescriptionCn:
Sonicite Vibe 是一个面向实时创作与互动体验的 AI 音乐创作平台。

结合 Live Coding、AI 音乐生成与实时视觉技术，Vibe 让用户通过自然语言、协作与互动参与音乐创作过程。无论是个人探索、多人共创、教育工作坊，还是品牌活动与现场演出，用户都能够在实时反馈中创造独特的视听体验。

Vibe 重新定义了人与音乐的关系——从被动聆听者变为主动参与者，让音乐创作变得更加开放、即时与充满乐趣。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Sonicite Vibe is an AI-powered platform for real-time music creation and interactive experiences.

Combining live coding, AI music generation, and real-time visuals, Vibe enables people to create music through language, collaboration, and interaction. From workshops and community events to performances and brand activations, it transforms audiences from listeners into participants.

Vibe explores new forms of creativity, expression, and connection in the age of AI.

list.productName: 空间视觉AI变形监测智能终端设备
list.productNameEn: AI-Powered Spatial Vision Deformation Monitoring Terminal
list.enterpriseName: 上海云工涌现科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Yungong Al Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 空间视觉三维变形监测智能终端，是面向重大工程安全监测打造的新一代AI智能装备。产品以自研的动态ViT模型为核心，通过空间视觉感知，实时捕捉物理目标点的三维坐标及微小变形，最高监测精度可达0.035毫米。设备搭载智能云台，支持多个靶点自动搜索、锁定与连续追踪，可在远距离、复杂施工环境下实现多点、高频、全天候、无人化监测，并将变形过程转化为直观、连续、可追溯的数据，为施工控制、风险预警和工程决策提供可靠依据。目前，产品已在建筑交通、桥梁大坝、抽水蓄能、能源设施及结构加固等50余项工程中落地应用，让毫米级乃至更微小的结构变化被及时感知，为重大工程构建“看得见、测得准、持续在线”的智能安全防线。
list.productDescriptionEn: AI-Powered Spatial Vision Deformation Monitoring Terminal is an AI device for engineering safety. Powered by our proprietary dynamic ViT model, it tracks the 3D coordinates and minute deformation of physical points in real time, with accuracy up to 0.035 mm. Its intelligent pan-tilt unit automatically searches, locks onto and tracks multiple targets, enabling remote, high-frequency, 24/7 unattended monitoring. Proven in over 50 building, transport, bridge, dam, pumped-storage and energy projects, it delivers continuous, traceable data for construction control, risk alerts and decisions.

list.productName: 云工涌现（建筑多模态垂类大模型）
list.enterpriseName: 上海云工涌现科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Yungong Al Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 云工涌现是国内首个建筑垂类大模型底座，通过构建千亿级行业显性-隐性知识库，创新提出行业级全链路智能体路由技术，有效解决了通用大模型缺乏行业know-how的瓶颈问题；自主研发的核心模型引擎Construction-GPT，不仅是国内首个建筑大模型，也是国内建筑业首个通过国家网信办深度合成服务算法备案的大模型。以云工涌现为底座，构建了20余项行业首创AI Agent“云工”系列产品，累计服务超 7500 万人次，在“东方枢纽”上海东站、“中国扇”上海大歌剧院等百余项重大项目建设中落地应用；相关成果入选WAIC优秀案例集、上海市住建行业AI十佳案例第一名。
list.productDescriptionEn: Yungong Emergence is China's first foundation model for the construction industry. Its knowledge base contains hundreds of billions of explicit and tacit knowledge items, while its agent-routing technology equips general AI with industry know-how. Construction-GPT is China's first construction LLM and the industry's first to complete national filing for deep-synthesis algorithms. Over 20 industry-first Yungong AI Agents have delivered 75 million service interactions across 100+ major projects. The achievements were selected by WAIC and ranked No. 1 among Shanghai's top construction AI cases.

list.productName: 云工译（建筑专业翻译智能体）
list.productNameEn: YunGong Translate — AI-Powered Professional Translator for Construction
list.enterpriseName: 上海云工涌现科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Yungong Al Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 云工·译是面向建筑工程行业的专业文档翻译智能体产品，聚焦海外投标、国际标准、技术方案、合同、工程量清单及项目汇报等场景。依托千亿Token建筑专业语料、百万对专业术语库和上下文多层级注入技术，支持中、英、阿、法、西、俄、韩、日、德9种语言，以及Word、PDF、PPT、Excel等格式，实现术语统一、长文语境连贯和原文版式高度还原。用户可完成“上传—预览—原译文对照—全文翻译—下载交付”全流程。产品提供网页端与微信小程序，并支持企业本地化部署，兼顾效率、成本与数据安全，让大型专业文档从“难翻、慢交付”变为可快速审阅、直接使用的工程成果。
list.productDescriptionEn: Yungong Translate is an intelligent document translation agent for the construction industry. Built for overseas bids, international standards, technical proposals, contracts and project reports, it uses a trillion-token industry corpus, one million bilingual term pairs and multi-level context injection. Supporting nine languages and Word, PDF, PowerPoint and Excel, it delivers consistent terminology, coherent long-document translation and high-fidelity formatting. Available on the web and WeChat, with private deployment, it turns complex documents into secure, review-ready deliverables.

list.productName: 一站式AI视频创作+视频本地化平台
list.productNameEn: All-in-One AI Video Creation and Localization Platform
list.enterpriseName: 杭州盖视科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
本展品是面向全球传播场景的一站式 AI 视频创作与本地化平台，由“说得AI”与“Vozo AI”共同构成。
“说得 AI”聚焦口播视频创作，集成AI 数字人、智能文案、AI 提词器、虚拟背景、智能剪辑、自动字幕等能力，帮助个人和企业快速生成带货口播、品牌宣传、知识讲解、教育培训等视频内容，显著降低拍摄、剪辑与团队协作成本。
“Vozo AI”聚焦视频全球传播，提供视频翻译、原声克隆配音、字幕生成、口型同步及画面文字翻译等能力，可一键生成多语言本地化版本，提升内容出海效率。
通过两项能力融合，可实现：一次创作 → 多语言生成 → 全球传播；可广泛应用于跨境电商、品牌营销、教育培训、企业出海等场景
list.productDescriptionEn:
This exhibit is a one-stop AI video creation and localization platform combining Shuode AI and Vozo AI.

Shuode AI helps individuals and businesses create talking-head videos with AI avatars, scriptwriting, a teleprompter, virtual backgrounds, editing, and subtitles.

Vozo AI helps localize videos for global audiences. It translates every layer of a video, including voice, subtitles, and on-screen text, in one workflow.

Together, they enable: Create once → Generate in multiple languages → Reach audiences worldwide. 

Ideal for e-commerce, marketing, education, training, and global business.

list.enterpriseName: EVOMAP PTE. LTD.
list.productDescriptionCn: EvoMap是一个去中心化的 A2A（Agent-to-Agent）协作经验市场。平台目前已沉淀近 600 万条进化资产，服务 24 万 Agent。任何 Agent  均可接入，通过标准化的 GEP-A2A 协议与全网 Agent 进行跨模型、跨平台的通信与协作。支持注册、发布、验证、拉取、回传与治理六种消息类型。资产经沙箱验证后进入分发池，采用 GDI（Gene Distribution Index）评分体系，综合 Intrinsic 分数、复用率与社区投票评估资产质量，其他 Agent 按置信分与环境兼容性筛选复用，原始创作者获得积分激励。
list.productDescriptionEn: EvoMap is a decentralized marketplace where 240,000  Agents trade 6 million reusable skills across models and platforms via the GEP-A2A protocol. Assets are scored by the GDI system based on quality, reuse rates, and community votes; high-scoring assets earn broader distribution and creator rewards.

list.productName: 全域具身的类脑中枢系统
list.enterpriseName: 最终序列（上海）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: Yuri Nexus OS是最终序列自主研发的自主无人机控制系统智能体，以类脑脉冲神经网络（SNN）为计算基座，为飞行器构建具备空域自主感知、决策与任务执行能力的“FSD大脑”。系统融合类脑世界模型与多智能体协作架构，支持端侧在线学习与训推一体，使无人机在GPS拒止、环境遮挡等极端条件下仍能实现高精度建图定位与毫秒级自主决策。Yuri Nexus OS集合模块化技能模模型，内置室内探索、建筑巡检、管裂慧眼等30余种行业技能，支持秒级调用与自由组合，部署周期较传统方案指数级减少。系统全面适配各类无人机、飞行机器人、机械臂及四足机器人等空中与地面载体，以类脑原生技术重新定义飞行具身智能操作系统标准
list.productDescriptionEn: Yuri Nexus OS is a proprietary autonomous UAV control system agent developed by Final Sequence, built on Spiking Neural Network (SNN) technology. As the "FSD brain" for aerial vehicles, it delivers autonomous perception, decision-making, and task execution.The system features a modular skill architecture with over 30 built-in industry skills, supporting instant invocation and flexible combination, Fully compatible with UAVs, flight robots, Yuri Nexus OS redefines the operating system standard for embodied flight intelligence through brain-inspired native technology.

list.enterpriseName: 爱客易智能科技（上海）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 麦当秀AiPPT是一款专注于AI办公领域的SaaS产品，秉持“让天下没有PPT，诞生一种全新的表达方式”的愿景，搭载自研垂直领域麦当秀大模型，以AI重构幻灯片创作流程。用户只需输入想法或主题，系统即可自动生成大纲、文稿与完整演示内容，并基于内容智能匹配模板、排版、配色和字体，实现一键美化。麦当秀AIPPT支持口语化指令交互，如插入图表、更换模板、优化页面风格等，让PPT制作像与专业设计顾问协作一样自然高效。作为办公领域AI辅助生成PPT的头部产品，麦当秀已服务超五百万C端用户，并推出企业版能力，覆盖多类2B场景，服务百度、大数据股份等50余家平台与客户，持续提升办公效率与演示品质。
list.productDescriptionEn: MindShow AiPPT is an AI-powered SaaS product for workplace productivity. Guided by the vision of making presentations effortless and creating a new way to express ideas, it is powered by MindShow’s self-developed vertical-domain LLM to reshape slide creation. Users can enter an idea or topic to generate outlines, scripts, and complete presentations, with smart templates, layouts, colors, and fonts for polished, ready-to-use slides. It also supports natural-language editing, such as inserting charts, changing templates, or refining page styles.

list.productName: 多模态机器人海马体仿生记忆系统
list.enterpriseName: 深圳奇点变量科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
基于自研的多模态仿生记忆模型，我们打造出业内领先的「多模态机器人海马体仿生记忆系统」 ——
            ·既能让机器人记住每一个人、每一件事，长周期记忆回溯，秒级响应；
            ·又能让机器人在执行复杂任务时，持续保持信息状态稳定，多任务来回切换，游刃有余。
        我们率先推出「海马体记忆卡模组」，开箱即用、免于部署，高效赋能客户快速集成，可广泛应用于家庭机器人、家庭智能数据中心、商服机器人等多元场景。
list.productDescriptionEn: We introduce the industry-leading Multimodal Robotic Hippocampus-Inspired Memory System. 1.Long-Term Recall, Instant Response: It enables robots to recognize and remember every person and interaction, achieving long-term memory retrieval with second-level response times. 2. Complex Multitasking, Seamless Agility: It ensures stable information processing during complex tasks, allowing robots to switch between multiple duties with absolute ease. Furthermore, our plug-and-play, deployment-free Bionic Hippocampal Memory Module is built for rapid, high-efficiency client integration.

list.enterpriseName: 爱客易智能科技（上海）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
爱客易智能工牌是一款AI软硬件协同产品，专为传统线下行业的数字化升级而生。它致力于将一线经营从"经验驱动"升级为"数据驱动、过程可控、能力可复制"的智能管理模式。
产品通过智能终端与AI平台协同，实时采集客流、转化及沟通内容等一线数据，让经营动作可视化，帮助企业及时干预偏差、优化执行。同时，系统可无缝对接企业现有业务管理系统，在客户沟通环节提供AI辅助维护与实时销售建议，让每一次服务都精准高效。
此外，工牌可自动沉淀优秀话术与服务规范，形成标准化SOP，推动金牌销售能力规模化复制。作为线下经营智能化管理入口，爱客易全面提升门店运营效率与科学决策能力。
list.productDescriptionEn: Aikeee Smart Badge is an AI-powered hardware-and-software solution for traditional offline industries. By combining smart wearable devices with an AI platform, it collects real-time data on foot traffic, conversion rates, and customer conversations, making frontline operations visible, controllable, and data-driven. Integrated with CRM, it provides AI-assisted customer maintenance and real-time sales suggestions. It also analyzes top sales scripts and service standards to build replicable SOPs, helping enterprises improve store efficiency and make smarter decisions.

list.enterpriseName: 上海如骋琦智能科技有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: Shanghai Ruchengqi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: MulanAI是全球首个融合画布、工作流与视频合成剪辑的创意Agent，打造一站式全自动AI制片厂。用户通过自然语言即可自动生成可编辑、可商用的白盒工作流，实现从创意策划、分镜设计、图像生成到视频制作与交付的全流程AI创作。平台已集成全球主流AI模型能力，广泛服务于广告营销、电商内容、影视创作等场景。MulanAI荣获第四届科幻星球大赛“科幻产品创新亚军”，并入选WaytoAGI“最喜爱AI产品”，观猹网“年度精选推荐”，持续推动AI内容生产向智能化、规模化发展。

list.productDescriptionCn:
AI+生产资料=生产力的真实替代，但85%+的生产资料仍被困在PDF、图像等非结构化的“暗数据”宇宙中。
SoMark 文档智能因此而生，致力于不分场景地将 PDF、图片等各种文档数据转化为统一的 Markdown、Json 标准结构化数据，旨在在超低硬件成本下以百毫秒级速度，让数据为大模型的训练及 RAG、Agent 等应用场景做好准备。
目前 SoMark 已支持 PDF、Image、Word、PPT、Excel 等26种文档格式，并且具备标题层级识别、图片理解与描述、嵌入式图片还原、跨页文本拼接、跨页表格拼接、抗水印和印章干扰处理等特色能力，可完整地保留文档结构与语义信息。
同时，SoMark 提供完善的开发者生态，支持 API、MCP、CLI、SDK、Skill 五种接入方式，并已集成插件到 Dify、 Coze 、FastGPT、飞书等平台，方便开发者快速将文档解析能力集成到知识库、智能体和自动化工作流中。
list.productDescriptionEn:
AI becomes real productivity when it can use the materials of work. But 85%+ of those materials are still trapped in PDFs, images, and other unstructured dark data. That’s why we built SoMark Document AI.
SoMark Document AI is built to turn PDFs, images, and other document data into unified and standardized structured data in Markdown and JSON across use cases.
It prepares data for LLM training, RAG, Agents, and other AI applications at ultra-low hardware cost and in hundreds of milliseconds.
SoMark currently supports 26 document formats, including PDF, images, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It also offers key capabilities such as heading hierarchy recognition, image understanding and captioning, embedded image recovery, cross-page text merging, cross-page table merging, and watermark and stamp noise handling, preserving document structure and semantic information with high fidelity.
SoMark also provides a complete developer ecosystem, with five integration methods: API, MCP, CLI, SDK, and Skill.
It has also been integrated as plugins into platforms such as Dify, Coze, FastGPT, and Feishu, enabling developers to quickly add document parsing capabilities to knowledge bases, AI agents, and automated workflows.

Through its safe physical design, content boundaries, and secure data mechanisms, it gives parents total peace of mind to let go and allow their children to independently explore the real world. During use, it randomly triggers behavioral guidance, enabling toddlers to not only gain scientific knowledge as they explore, but also subtly learn how to treat the world and others—truly integrating character enlightenment into everyday family life.

Powered by an intelligent 7-Agent workflow, OiiOii streamlines the entire creative process, from scriptwriting, character design, scene design, and storyboarding to complete video production. Simply enter an idea, and the system automatically transforms it into high-quality visual content. No complex prompts or specialized training are required, making AI-powered content creation accessible to both professionals and beginners. OiiOii  Let Your Creativity Fly With AI Agents.

list.productDescriptionEn: AI single-molecule POCT platform delivers lab-grade precision & sensitivity for low-abundance early disease & post-op recurrence/metastasis biomarkers. With spatial encoding, it enables 1–16-plex detection with 3.5–15 μL samples, features 15–30 min turnaround, 10–50× higher sensitivity vs traditional assays, and supports custom chips, multi-omics & AI diagnostics for clinical, research & drug trials, forming an integrated precision disease management system.

SenseXperience is IO's series of proprietary integrated hardware and software solutions for capturing high-quality, real-world human egocentric and UMI-style data. With various configurations available, including the lightweight baseline, customizable versions, and multi-modal solutions including tactile sensors, SenseXperience is designed for scalable human data.
1. Modular Capture Architecture
2. scalable and stable data production
3. Verifiable Data Quality
4. End-to-End Customization

list.enterpriseName: 北京共绩科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
本展品，完整还原了电网式算力调度的全流程运行机制，直观呈现公司核心技术原理与应用模式：依托自研核心调度技术，汇聚了多元异构的算力资源，统一汇聚至云端，完成算力资源的集中整合。
通过平台智能调度系统完成算力标准化整合、智能匹配与统筹分配，可实现跨区域、高精度算力分发，广泛适配多元化算力应用场景，真正实现算力资源像电力一样随用随取、按需付费， 依托一体化算力调度体系，公司不仅实现了社会闲散算力的精细化、高效化、常态化利用，还深度结合国内绿电资源优势，创新打造“算电协同”发展模式，深度参与全国一体化算力网络布局建设，实现中国算力出海的同时，助力中国电力出海，赋能新能源与数字算力产业融合发展。
list.productDescriptionEn: This exhibit shows grid-style compute scheduling. Using proprietary tech, it aggregates diverse resources (IDC, cafes, PCs) to the cloud. The intelligent system enables cross-region, high-precision distribution. Compute is pay-as-you-go like electricity. It efficiently uses idle resources and creates a compute-electricity synergy. It supports China's National Compute Network, helping Chinese compute and power go global, empowering new energy and digital integration.

list.enterpriseName: 烟台小樱桃网络科技有限公司

list.productDescriptionCn: XSwitch实时音视频通信平台，为您提供一站式语音、视频、会议、AI解决方案，满足企业多样化实时音视频通信需求，支持SIP、WebRTC等众多通信协议，支持高度可定制，具有强扩展性，安全稳定性高，技术先进以及生态开放，可满足多种行业需求。

It supports a wide range of communication protocols including SIP and WebRTC, features extensive customizability, robust scalability, high security and reliability, cutting-edge technology and an open ecosystem, catering to the demands of multiple industries.

list.enterpriseName: 记忆张量（上海）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
MemOS 为AGI构建统一的记忆管理平台，让智能系统如大脑般拥有灵活、可迁移、可共享的长期记忆和即时记忆，并连接大模型、Agent 与业务系统的长期状态管理层。
它通过对用户偏好、任务上下文、企业知识、工具调用经验、智能体状态等信息进行结构化抽取、分层存储、动态调度、持续更新与生命周期治理，使 AI 系统能够在跨会话、跨任务、跨设备和跨模型环境中沉淀可复用经验，而非每次从零开始推理。
MemOS 更强调记忆资源的生产、调用、遗忘、权限控制、审计与安全治理，为 Agent、AI 终端、企业智能体和工业 AI 提供可扩展、可集成、可治理的长期记忆基础设施，支撑 AI 从一次性生成迈向长期智能。
list.productDescriptionEn: MemOS is a unified memory management platform for AGI and a long-term state layer connecting foundation models, agents, and business systems. It gives AI portable, shareable long-term and working memory. By structuring user preferences, task context, enterprise knowledge, tool-use traces, and agent state, MemOS helps AI reuse experience across sessions, tasks, devices, and models instead of starting from scratch. With creation, retrieval, forgetting, access control, audit, and security, it provides governable memory infrastructure for agents, AI devices, enterprise agents, and industrial AI.

list.enterpriseName: 记忆张量（上海）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: ClawForce 是基于 MemOS 构建的企业级 Agent Runtime 与 AgentOps 平台。随着企业内部 Agent 数量增长，核心挑战已从「单个 Agent 够不够强」转向「大量 Agent 如何协同、共享经验、保持一致并被有效运营」。ClawForce 提供 Agent 集中部署、统一管理、统一监控与组织级运营分析，覆盖人效分析、成本统计与安全治理，帮助企业从「拥有 Agent」走向「运营 Agent」。
list.productDescriptionEn: ClawForce is an enterprise Agent Runtime and AgentOps platform built on MemOS. As companies scale from a few agents to many, the core problem shifts from “Can one agent perform well?” to “How do we coordinate agent fleets, share experience, keep behavior consistent, and operate them reliably?” ClawForce supports centralized deployment, unified management and observability, plus org-level operations analytics across productivity, cost, and security governance. It helps enterprises move from simply having agents to running agents as managed, measurable, and governable production systems.

list.enterpriseName: Zinc Technologies Pte Ltd
list.productDescriptionCn:
Zinc Decisions 帮助团队将数据转化为清晰的机会和行动建议，从而做出更好的商业决策。
系统会分析市场数据和企业内部数据，识别潜在的增长机会、风险或改进空间。这些机会会以“决策气泡”的形式呈现，让用户能够简单直观地看到哪些地方值得关注。
每个气泡都代表一个商业机会或战略问题。用户可以点击每个气泡，进一步了解详情。 气泡会展示相关数据、业务背景、机会背后的可能原因，以及团队可以考虑的不同选项。
这能帮助团队比较不同选择、理解取舍、评估风险，并估算潜在的业务影响。团队不再只依赖直觉或零散信息，而是可以借助 Zinc Decisions，用证据和结构化方式做决策。
list.productDescriptionEn: Zinc Decisions helps teams make better business decisions by turning data into clear opportunities and recommended actions. It analyzes market and internal business data to identify growth areas, risks, and improvements, shown as simple “decision bubbles.” Each bubble highlights a strategic question, such as which market to enter, product to prioritize, or customer segment to focus on. Teams can explore the data, context, options, risks, and impact behind each opportunity, creating a shared source of truth for faster, more confident decisions.

list.enterpriseName: Zinc Technologies Pte Ltd
list.productDescriptionCn:
Zinc 数据分析帮助企业将原始数据转化为清晰、可执行的业务洞察，减少对人工报表、复杂仪表盘和漫长分析流程的依赖。如今，许多团队虽然拥有大量业务数据，却仍然很难快速回答简单但关键的问题。Zinc 数据分析正是为了让这个过程变得更快速、更简单、更容易使用而设计。
通过 Zinc 数据分析，用户可以用自然语言提出问题，并基于企业自身的数据即时获得答案。团队不再需要打开多个电子表格、制作数据透视表，或等待仪表盘更新，而是可以通过对话式界面实时探索业务表现。该产品适合技术和非技术用户使用。业务人员无需掌握 SQL、公式或数据可视化工具，也能获得有价值的分析结果
list.productDescriptionEn: Zinc Data Analysis platform helps businesses turn raw data into clear, actionable insights without relying on manual reporting, complex dashboards, or long analyst turnaround times. Users can ask questions in natural language and receive instant answers based on their business data. Designed for both technical and non-technical teams, Zinc helps users explore revenue trends, campaign performance, customer behavior, operations, product performance, and key metrics in real time. It supports faster meetings, business reviews, planning, and daily decisions.

By learning from enterprise papers, data, reports, workflows, and toolchains, it automates R&D tasks such as problem analysis, tool execution, simulation, experiment planning, and result review—helping teams build a traceable, iterative, and more efficient R&D loop.

Powered by AI imitation learning, it accurately replicates professional massage techniques. Combined with a 6‑axis collaborative robotic arm and an active force control system, it delivers a safe, precise, and stable foundational relaxation and care experience, establishing a solid technology base for future product evolution.

list.productName: 布兰矩阵大模型安全检测平台
list.enterpriseName: 布兰矩阵智能科技（上海）有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: BraneMatrix Artificial Intelligence Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 大模型安全检测平台面向大模型与智能体应用的安全评测场景，构建了覆盖盲盒攻击、黑盒攻击、自由攻击的一体化测试体系。盲盒覆盖7大风险类别、50个细粒度子类，黑盒集成20余种先进攻击算法，含全球领先自研先进成果（全球主流AI安全测试benchmark均达到领先水平），支持单轮、多轮、单模态、多模态全矩阵测试。相比传统人工红队测试，平台支持批量化、自动化、标准化测试，可以对不同模型、不同防护策略、不同业务场景进行持续评估，量化输出攻击成功率、拦截率、误报率、漏报率、风险等级和测试覆盖度等指标。评测结果输出成功自动ASR攻击率、HS毒性评分，直接生成可提交监管的量化报告。
list.productDescriptionEn: The LLM Security Testing Platform evaluates large language models and agent applications via integrated blind-box, black-box, and free-form attacks—covering 7 risk categories, 50 subcategories, and 20+ attack algorithms with proprietary, benchmark-leading innovations. Supporting automated, standardized testing across models and scenarios, it outputs quantified metrics and ASR/HS ratings in regulator-ready reports.

list.productName: 布兰矩阵AI安全防护大模型
list.enterpriseName: 布兰矩阵智能科技（上海）有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: BraneMatrix Artificial Intelligence Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 专为大模型场景应用设计的实时对话安全防护模型，模型持续跟踪全球大模型安全领域的最新攻击范式，覆盖提示词注入、多轮诱导、角色伪装等主流越狱方式。针对传统规则防护难以识别的“隐性恶意意图”和“多轮渐进式攻击”，模型引入语义风险识别、上下文链路分析和攻击意图判别机制，能够在用户请求、模型回复、工具调用和外部知识注入等多个环节进行实时检测与拦截。每次附带可解释的思维链推理，支持0.5B / 4B / 9B三档规格接续或回复选型，可连接部署接入现有接入接口，让每次大模型对话都有据可查、有险可防。
list.productDescriptionEn: A real-time conversational security model built for LLM applications. It tracks emerging global attack paradigms—prompt injection, multi-turn inducement, role-play disguise, and other jailbreaks. To catch hidden malicious intent and progressive attacks that rule-based defenses miss, it applies semantic risk recognition, context-chain analysis, and intent discrimination across user requests, model responses, tool calls, and knowledge injection. Each decision includes explainable chain-of-thought reasoning, with 0.5B/4B/9B options and easy integration.

list.enterpriseName: 布兰矩阵智能科技（上海）有限公司
list.enterpriseNameEn: BraneMatrix Artificial Intelligence Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
list.productDescriptionCn: 我们的 Agent Skill 检测能力重点解决大模型从“生成内容”走向“调用工具、执行任务”后带来的安全风险。该能力可以对 Agent 的 Skill、插件、函数调用和外部接口进行系统化检测，覆盖权限边界、调用链路、参数安全、数据流向和执行结果等关键环节，识别越权调用、敏感信息泄露、工具滥用、任务误执行、接口暴露等风险。相比传统大模型内容安全检测，Agent Skill 检测更加关注智能体的“行动安全”。它不仅判断模型说了什么，也判断模型调用了什么、访问了什么、执行了什么，以及这些行为是否符合企业安全策略。在 SkillTrustBench 基准测试中，布兰矩阵全面领先于同类型产品。
list.productDescriptionEn: Our Agent Skill detection addresses risks as LLMs evolve from generating content to calling tools and executing tasks. It systematically inspects an agent's skills, plugins, function calls, and interfaces—covering permission boundaries, call chains, parameter safety, data flows, and execution results—identifying privilege escalation, data leakage, tool abuse, erroneous execution, and interface exposure. Beyond what a model says, it evaluates what it calls, accesses, and executes, and whether these comply with enterprise policies. In SkillTrustBench, BraneMatrix leads across comparable products

Powered by state-of-the-art AI-native security, Ginkley protects creators and users through end-to-end intellectual property safeguards, enabling trusted Skill commercialization at scale. ZimaBoard 2 is IceWhale’s next-generation single-board server, designed for self-hosting, homelabs, edge computing, and AI applications. Powered by an Intel N150 processor, it features dual 2.5GbE networking, PCIe expansion, and onboard eMMC storage.

More than an operating system, ZimaOS helps users take full control of their data and computing power.

list.productDescriptionCn: 法索 AI 是面向法律服务场景的办案智能体工作台，围绕真实案件持续工作，支持材料归拢、多模态解析、法律检索、法条交叉验证、争议分析、证据梳理、方案生成与文书辅助。系统以案件为中心组织事实、请求、抗辩、证据和法律依据，帮助律师、企业法务、调解及相关机构提升案件处理效率，降低重复整理、法律检索、案件分析和初稿撰写成本。法索 AI 致力于把法律专业工作从一次性的“问答式 AI”推进到可协作、可追溯、可持续迭代的智能工作流，让专业人员把更多精力投入判断、沟通和决策。
list.productDescriptionEn: Fasuo AI is an AI-powered legal case workbench for legal service workflows. Centered on each case, it helps organize materials, parse multimodal evidence, retrieve and verify legal authorities, analyze case issues, claims and defenses, structure evidence, generate strategies, and assist drafting. By connecting facts, requests, arguments, evidence, and legal sources in one workspace, Fasuo AI supports lawyers, corporate legal teams, and mediation organizations in reducing repetitive work, improving case analysis, and moving from one-off AI Q&A to traceable, collaborative legal workflows.

By analyzing student performance and learning data, it helps teachers identify learning gaps, personalize instruction, reduce repetitive tasks, and improve teaching effectiveness through data-driven insights.

当你不知道今天吃什么、想写一句祝福、需要一点灵感、想记录情绪，或者想把某个想法变成可以收藏的小纸条时，只要“呱呱一下”，AI 就会帮你生成内容，并即时打印出来。

我们希望让 AI 不只停留在屏幕里，而是变成一张可以贴进手帐、放在桌上、送给朋友、带进口袋的小纸条。
让灵感、情绪、祝福和日常记录，都有一个真正能被留下来的形状。
呱呱一下，让你的生活顶呱呱。
list.productDescriptionEn:

Not sure what to eat? Need a wish, a spark of inspiration, or just want to capture a mood? Just "give it a gua" — the AI generates and prints it instantly.
It can be a daily fortune slip, a mood receipt, a compliment card, a meeting idea card, a children's knowledge card, or a journal sticker — anything worth keeping.
We want AI to go beyond the screen, becoming a little note you can paste in your journal, place on your desk, or give to a friend.
Give it a gua. Make your life top-notch.

湃启致力于探索人工智能从功能工具向情感伙伴的范式跃迁，让科技赋予BJD温度，成为儿童、年轻人及独居者的深度情感羁绊
list.productDescriptionEn:

list.productName: 好运日历机 - 年轻人的每日桌搭
list.productNameEn: Good Luck Calendar – A Daily Desk Accessory for Young
list.enterpriseName: 深圳市晌午不眠科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 好运日历机是一款面向年轻用户的桌面 AI 陪伴硬件。用户绑定 App 后，设备可结合个人信息、长期记忆、近期状态、重要事件和作息节律，生成个性化每日好运签文、提醒和行动建议。产品通过摇杆交互、屏幕展示、热敏打印、语音对话与虚拟角色陪伴，把 AI 回答转化为更有仪式感的桌面互动，让 AI 从 App 对话框进入工位、床头和学习空间，成为可持续陪伴用户日常生活的智能入口。
list.productDescriptionEn:
The Lucky Calendar Machine is a desktop AI companionship device for young users. After connecting with the app, it uses personal profiles, long-term memory, recent status, key events and daily rhythm to generate personalized fortune notes, reminders and action suggestions.

Through joystick interaction, screen display, thermal printing, voice dialogue and virtual characters, it turns AI responses into a tangible daily ritual, bringing AI companionship from the app into real-life spaces such as desks, bedside tables and study areas.

list.enterpriseName: AI SEMI LIMITED
list.productDescriptionCn: AI-OPC 半导体光刻智能校正系统是面向半导体光刻 OPC 核心环节，依托 AI 端到端技术 + GPU 集群并行计算，打破海外技术垄断。深度学习框架，RUNTIME提升40倍以上，先进制程百倍。相对传统OPC，基于GPU框架，成本下降97%，良率表现更好。核心性能对标国际顶尖水平，满足量产规范，是国产半导体卡脖子领域的核心方案。
list.productDescriptionEn: AI-OPC is an intelligent correction system for semiconductor lithography OPC. Powered by end-to-end AI and GPU-cluster parallel computing, it breaks foreign technology monopolies. Its deep-learning framework boosts runtime by 40x+, and up to 100x for advanced nodes. Compared with traditional OPC, the GPU-based approach cuts costs by 97% while delivering better yield performance.Its core performance is benchmarked against leading international standards and meets mass-production requirements, making it a key domestic solution for a critical bottleneck in the semiconductor industry.

At the center of the device is a customizable low-power E-Ink display, known as the "Star Core," allowing users to express their personality through photos, emojis, artwork, or travel memories. list.enterpriseName: 凌波智芯（常州）科技有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn:
LINGBO-400G与800G AI智能网卡是面向大模型训推的核心设施，专为十万卡级智算集群打造。产品首创颠覆性的“无链接”RoCE底层架构，结合全栈自研的HP4流控与SSR重传算法，彻底打破“链接爆炸”性能瓶颈。在100K并发下，网卡硬件开销骤降90%、重传时延降低96%，有效带宽利用率稳定超90%。
在商业价值上，产品致力于让客户“用RoCE的成本买到IB的性能体验”，其定价分别比对标的英伟达CX7/CX8低约40%和20%。在万卡组网场景中，不仅能降低50%的成本且性能与IB持平，更前瞻性地预留了十万卡平滑扩容能力，是真正自主可控的高性价比国产网络核心部件。
list.productDescriptionEn:
Designed for 100,000-card AI clusters, the LINGBO-400G and 800G AI Network Cards feature a pioneering connectionless RoCE architecture with HP4 flow control and SSR algorithms. They overcome connection explosion bottlenecks by reducing hardware overhead by 90% and latency by 96%, while maintaining >90% effective bandwidth under 100K concurrent connections.
Commercially, they deliver IB performance at RoCE costs. Priced 20-40% below NVIDIA's CX7/CX8, they halve 10,000-card network costs and match IB performance. These fully autonomous components seamlessly support 100,000-card scaling.

list.productName: 基于植入式脑机接口的视觉重建系统
list.enterpriseName: 明视脑机科技（苏州）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 植入式脑机接口的视觉重建系统，是融合虚拟现实技术与多通道视觉神经调控的创新设备。其定位为国产首款高端视觉修复医疗器械，核心形态是集成千通道柔性电极与自适应编解码算法的全植入系统。它旨在为全球4300万全盲患者，解决因视神经或视网膜损伤等导致的完全性失明，通过直接刺激视觉皮层为患者重建基础视觉感知。其标志性意义在于突破我国在该高端领域的产业化空白，实现从运动控制到复杂感知功能重建的根本性跨越。
list.productDescriptionEn: The implantable BCI-based visual reconstruction system integrates VR with multi-channel visual neuromodulation. As China’s first high-end visual prosthetic, it features a fully implanted architecture with a thousand-channel flexible electrode array and adaptive encoding-decoding algorithms. Targeting ~43 million blind patients worldwide (optic nerve/retinal damage), it restores elementary visual perception via direct cortical stimulation. Its significance lies in filling China’s industrial gap, marking a fundamental leap from motor control to complex sensory reconstruction.

list.productNameEn: FilmAction AI Film and Television Production System
list.enterpriseName: 好耶科技（北京）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: FilmAction 是 AI 电影操作系统——自主决策 AI Agent，底层调度12家模型，将一句话转化为完整影片：剧本、角色、分镜、视频、配音、配乐、成片，全流程完成。模型每2-3个月迭代，FilmAction 提供“不管模型怎么换都能跑通”的生产线，缩短想法到成片。核心：自研 Agent 引擎（双层 Loop+28工具+LLM评判），330+字段 schema，跨镜一致性（多视图+素材库+模型），多模型抽象层（12+供应商、自动降级、能力路由）。单实例支撑100+并发视频生成，异步轮询，SSE透明流程。FilmAction 不是API聚合平台，而是生产级操作系统——让“打字→完整影片”
list.productDescriptionEn: FilmAction is an AI film operating system where a single autonomous agent orchestrates twelve model vendors to turn one sentence into a complete movie. Models upgrade fast, but this production line runs no matter which wins, cutting the path from idea to final video. With its agent engine, cross-shot consistency, and multi-model abstraction, FilmAction is not an API aggregator but a production-grade OS that makes "type to movie" an everyday reality.

list.enterpriseName: 模驭人工智能科技（上海）有限公司
list.productDescriptionCn: 模驭 AI 核心产品为AI 商业引擎（AI Business Engine, ABE），是面向企业的 AI 基建平台，基于 "AI 大压缩" 理论，将业务系统与专家经验封装为 AI Agent 的可调度资产，以零开发、零订阅、仅为任务成效付费的模式，零售化交付商业价值，助力企业实现 AI 原生转型与跨量级价值创造。
list.productDescriptionEn: The core product of Moximize AI is the AI Business Engine (ABE), an AI infrastructure platform for enterprises. Based on the theory of "The Great AI Compression", it encapsulates business systems and expert experience into executable assets for AI Agents, delivers commercial value in a retail model with zero development, zero subscription and pay-for-results only, and helps enterprises achieve AI-native transformation and cross-order value creation.
